fdroid:com.activitytrace.name: Activity Trace
fdroid:com.activitytrace.summary: Find something you saw on your phone — privately and on-device.
fdroid:com.activitytrace.description:
Ever see something on your phone and then struggle to find it again?
 ActivityTrace creates a private, searchable memory of your Android activity.
 Search notifications, captured screen content, and indexed files from one place.
 No Internet permission. No cloud. No account. No telemetry.
 Your data stays encrypted on your device.
 Find what you saw — one searchable timeline of notifications, screen content and files
 Search naturally — type "yesterday", "last week" or plain keywords
 Filter precisely — by app ( in:signal ) or content type ( type:notification ), with prefix matching, ranked results and highlighting
 You control retention — choose how long data is kept and block individual apps
 See when and where — statistics about captured activity over time
 Encrypted at rest — SQLCipher AES-256-CBC + Android Keystore
 Theme support — system default, light, dark, or OLED black
 Demo mode — try ActivityTrace with fictional data, fully separate from your real activity
 Privacy isn't a promise — it's an architecture. ActivityTrace has no Internet permission, so there is no hidden analytics endpoint, no cloud sync, and no telemetry waiting to be disabled. Your data cannot leave your device.
 Free and open source software (GPL-3.0-only). Distributed via F-Droid: no Google Play Services, no proprietary dependencies, no AI or ML components.

fdroid:com.anchor.software.name: Anchor
fdroid:com.anchor.software.summary: Connect Android and Linux for messages, files, notifications, camera, and more.
fdroid:com.anchor.software.description:
Anchor connects your Android phone or tablet directly to your Linux desktop.
Use the devices you already own together:
• Read SMS and MMS conversations on your desktop and send replies you initiate
• Mirror phone notifications and control active media
• Sync clipboard content and transfer files
• Use your phone camera as a Linux webcam
• Extend or view your desktop display on Android
• Control your desktop with remote touch and keyboard input
Private by design
Anchor has no account, advertising, behavioral analytics, or cloud storage for your personal content. Devices pair using certificate fingerprints. Control messages, camera video, and display video travel directly between paired devices over mutually authenticated, certificate-pinned TLS.
You stay in control
Sensitive features are optional. Anchor explains SMS/MMS, contacts, camera, and notification access before you enable them. You can exclude individual notification apps, unpair desktops, clear local histories, and delete the desktop's local message cache.
Linux companion required
Most features require the free, open-source Anchor desktop app on a compatible Linux system. Both devices generally need to be able to reach each other on the same local network. Hardware and desktop-environment support varies; see anchor-software.org for downloads and compatibility information.

fdroid:com.bookstash.app.name: BookStash
fdroid:com.bookstash.app.summary: A private, offline-first reader and library for web fiction and books.
fdroid:com.bookstash.app.description:
BookStash is a private, local-first reader and library for web fiction and books. Your device is the database: no accounts, no servers holding your data, no subscriptions. You add what you want to read, it is downloaded to your own device, and it is yours — offline, private, forever.
BookStash gathers stories into one clean, offline library you fully own. It is built for the reader who wants their shelf — curated by them, stored by them — not another feed.
 Principles 
* Local-first. Everything lives on your device in an on-device database. The app does its own downloading; there is no central server.
* You own your data. Back it up, export it, move it. It never lives on someone else's computer.
* Private by default. Nothing about what you read leaves your device.
* Polite to sources. Each device only fetches its owner's own library, at a gentle, rate-limited pace.
* Free and open. GPLv3. No paywalled features, no ads, no tracking.
 What it does 
* Library — your downloaded works on three shelves (fanfic, web serials, books), grouped by fandom or series, with search and include/exclude tag filtering.
* Discover — track tags from supported sources; BookStash surfaces new matching works on each sync. Filter by completion status, and set per-shelf excluded tags.
* Reader — clean, distraction-free reading with adjustable fonts; remembers your place, and moves between chapters and works in a series.
* What's New — see newly fetched and saved works at a glance.
* Series — follow a series and pull every work in it.
 Sources 
BookStash reads publicly available works from sites such as Archive of Our Own, Royal Road and Scribble Hub, and book metadata from public catalogues. It fetches only your own library, on your device, at a polite pace.
 Status 
Early development. Expect rough edges while features stabilise.

fdroid:com.javimetallab.papercript.name: PaperCript
fdroid:com.javimetallab.papercript.summary: Encrypted passwords on printable QR cards. No network, stores nothing.
fdroid:com.javimetallab.papercript.description:
PaperCript stores your passwords on paper, encrypted .
 You encrypt a password with your master password, the app turns it into a card with a QR code, and you print an A4 sheet of cut-out cards. To get a password back, you scan its QR and type the master password.
 Losing the paper costs you nothing: a card is worthless without the master password. Keep them in a drawer, split them up, or leave a copy at a friend's place.
 scrypt key derivation, AES-256 + HMAC-SHA256 (encrypt-then-MAC)
 No network permission: the app cannot open a socket
 Stores nothing: no passwords, no master password, no history
 No screenshots (FLAG_SECURE), sensitive clipboard cleared automatically
 Built-in password generator
 QR codes read with ZXing, no proprietary libraries
 Available in English, Spanish, Catalan, Galician, Basque, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai and Hindi.

fdroid:dev.astraedus.nudge.name: Nudge
fdroid:dev.astraedus.nudge.summary: Privacy-first app blocker with breathing exercises and delay-to-open
fdroid:dev.astraedus.nudge.description:
App blockers ask for Accessibility Service permissions — the most powerful permission on Android. It can see everything on your screen. Most app blockers are closed-source with vague privacy policies. Nudge is different.
Nudge is open source, requests zero internet permissions, and keeps all your data on your device. No analytics. No telemetry. No data leaving your phone. Ever.
Features:
* Delay-to-open — wait through a breathing exercise or countdown before opening distracting apps
* Hard blocking — completely block apps you don't want to access
* Daily time budgets — allow 30 minutes of Instagram per day, then block
* App groups — create a "Social Media" group, configure once, apply to all
* Schedule-based rules — block social media 9-5 on weekdays
* In-app blocking — block Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts without blocking the whole app
* Grayscale mode — make blocked apps less appealing by forcing grayscale display
* Usage stats — see where your screen time actually goes
The delay/breathing modes are the core idea. They don't lock you out — they insert a moment of intentional friction that breaks the automatic habit loop driving most mindless phone usage.
Zero internet permission is declared in the manifest — verifiable, not a promise.

fdroid:nz.diaswarm.ayni.name: Ayni
fdroid:nz.diaswarm.ayni.summary: See the glucose of someone who shares it with you
fdroid:nz.diaswarm.ayni.description:
See the glucose of someone who has chosen to share it with you. Ayni is a viewer — and only that.
* **No insulin, no pump, no closed-loop code.** If you're looking for an artificial pancreas, this isn't one.
* **Private by design.** Readings travel directly phone-to-phone, sealed before they leave the sender — no account, no server, no one in the middle who can read them. Sharing ends the instant the sender revokes your key.
* **One scan to pair** — the person sharing scans your code and hands back their own address in the same motion.
* **Every reading shows its age.** A follower's real danger isn't an error on screen; it's a stale number that looks current.
Ayni is Quechua for *reciprocity*: your phone carries other people's sealed records so that theirs carry yours when your phone is away — and no phone can read what it holds for anyone else.
To share your own data you build the AndroidAPS add-on yourself, from the project's repository; it is deliberately not distributed.

Wike is a Wikipedia reader for the GNOME Desktop.

 Other features are: bookmarks with multiple lists, article table of contents,

flathub:com.jetbrains.RustRover.name: RustRover
flathub:com.jetbrains.RustRover.description:
RustRover is a commercial IDE by JetBrains aimed at providing an ergonomic environment for Rust

flathub:com.lowfuelmotorsport.LFMApp.name: LFM App
flathub:com.lowfuelmotorsport.LFMApp.description:
The official desktop app for Low Fuel Motorsport (LFM). Free essentials for every driver; LFM
 Plus unlocks advanced racing tools and livery workflows.
 Free for everyone:
 Race Hub: browse LMU daily, weekly and special events, upcoming sessions, track info and
 requirements
 AC Sync: install required Assetto Corsa mods with one click and keep selected series content
 updated automatically
 AC Sync history, so you know what changed
 Inbox with news, stream updates and changelogs
 With LFM Plus:
 Sign up and manage race entries from the app, including car and livery choice where supported
 Upload personal and team liveries and keep your local ACC liveries in sync
 Upcoming races drawer, next race widget and race notifications
 Sign in with Steam to get started. The games run through Steam Play (Proton); the app finds
 their folders automatically. Voice chat and the in-game overlay are not available on Linux yet.

flathub:com.p1security.diagng.name: DiagNG
flathub:com.p1security.diagng.summary: Client for mobile baseband Diag interfaces
flathub:com.p1security.diagng.description:
DiagNG is a general purpose client purpose for the diagnostic interface of Qualcomm Snapdragon
 basebands, present on a large part of Android phones and various USB modems.
 It can be considered as a sequel for QCSuper, and also takes large inspiration from SCAT. Like
 these tools, it allows to capture 2G/3G/4G/5G air interface network traces and save them to the
 GSMTAP/PCAP format, so that you can visualize these in Wireshark.
 It is an experimental, Linux-first, open-source, interoperable, brand-new way to connect to
 baseband USB diagnostic interfaces; whether for pedagogic or security research purposes.
 It should eventually support other basebands such as Samsung Exynos processors, and why not
 other protocols such as AT commands.
 Features:
 Connect a Linux raw SPI port.
 Connect a Linux raw USB interface.
 A sleek GTK 4/Adwaita-based UI.
 SPI and USB connections are safely connected to the Python UI through a privileged Rust daemon,
 using a Polkit/DBus-based interface to secure privileged actions, to ensure good integration
 with Flatpak.
 Wireshark plug-in management and automated installation for GSMTAP v3/5G RRC decoding (taken
 from SCAT).
 Gather phone-related information through ADB, with shortcuts to enable the QCDM USB interface
 easily.
 Import DLF or QMDL files in order to enable interoperability with other software.
 Support basic QCDM (Qualcomm diagnostic monitor) log registration.
 Support basic QCDM 2G/3G/4G/5G log conversion to GSMTAP/PCAP (without advanced features such
 as SIB decoding, reassembly).
 Flatpak packaging for good integration to the Linux desktop.

flathub:com.zoho.Notebook.name: Notebook
flathub:com.zoho.Notebook.summary: The most beautiful note-taking app across devices
flathub:com.zoho.Notebook.description:
Different types of notes should be treated differently. Each Note Card type is designed to complement the type of note you're taking.
 Safely and securely share your notes with friends and co-workers. Share notes and collaborate securely with the people you trust—and only them.
 This is the Notebook you'll never lose because it syncs to the cloud and across your devices. It's always backed-up and always up to date.

flathub:io.github.subhra74.Muon.name: Muon
flathub:io.github.subhra74.Muon.summary: Graphical SFTP client and terminal emulator with helpful utilities
flathub:io.github.subhra74.Muon.description: Muon is a graphical SSH client. It has a enhanced SFTP file browser, SSH terminal emulator, remote resource/process manager, server disk space analyzer, remote text editor, huge remote log viewer and lots of other helpful tools, which makes it easy to work with remote servers. Muon provides functionality similar to web based control panels but, it works over SSH from local computer, hence no installation required on server. It runs on Linux and Windows. flathub:io.github.vinser.pixyne.name: pixyne
flathub:io.github.vinser.pixyne.summary: Quickly review photo folders, safely delete bad and similar shots, fix the shooting dates
flathub:io.github.vinser.pixyne.description:
Pixyne application has a simple and intuitive interface:
 - With a click on photo you can mark to drop it in the trash.
 - In a list view, clicking on a row button opens the corresponding photo.
 - In advanced mode you may set or correct the EXIF shooting date, crop and ajust photo.
 - Pixyne automaticaly stores the current state of the folder so you can undo changes at any time. This is useful when working with a large number of photos and when you need to close the application in order to continue working later.
 - Made changes will not actually be applied until you save.
 - When you save changes, you can change all file names to EXIF shooting date format.

flathub:io.liri.Calculator.name: Liri Calculator
flathub:io.liri.Calculator.description:
Liri Calculator is a Material Design application that solves mathematical equations.
 At first it appears to be a simple calculator with only basic arithmetic operations.
 However it features a flexible expression parser with support for symbolic
 computation, a large set of built-in functions and constants and works with different
 data types like numbers, big numbers, complex numbers, fractions, units and matrices.

flathub:net.biniou.LeBiniou.summary: User-friendly, powerful music visualization / VJing tool
flathub:net.biniou.LeBiniou.description:
Le Biniou works with music, voice, ambient sounds, whatever acoustic source you choose.
 When you run Le Biniou it gives an evolutionary rendering of the sound you are playing.
 You are given two options to run Le Biniou: You can manage entirely the sequences and choose your own series of pictures from the default library, your colour scales, the kind of alteration you want to apply or you can let Le Biniou's artificial intelligence run on its own.
 Forget the old visualizations you are familiar with, discover a new multidimensional – spatial and chromatic – way of comprehending music and sounds for either artistic, recreational or didactic purposes.

 It is designed to be as simple as possible and has some unique features to

 Brasero can create, copy and burn Data and Audio CD/DVDs.

firefox-addons:385621.name: DuckDuckGo Search & Tracker Protection
firefox-addons:385621.summary: ⚡Protects your data. Private search with optional AI, private browsing, and ad blocking.
firefox-addons:385621.description:
At DuckDuckGo, we believe the best way to protect your personal information from hackers, scammers, and privacy-invasive companies is to stop it from being collected at all. That's why millions of people choose DuckDuckGo over other browser extensions to protect their searching and browsing. Our built-in search engine is like Google but never tracks your searches. Our browsing protections, such as ad tracker blocking and cookie blocking, help stop other companies from collecting your data. While our optional integrated AI features, Search Assist and Duck.ai , are private and never use your data to train AI. Oh, and our browser extension is free — we make money from privacy-respecting search ads, not by exploiting your data. Take back control of your personal information with the browser extension designed for data protection.  
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS  
Protect Your Searches by Default: Install the extension and we’ll set your default search engine and homepage to DuckDuckGo Search, so you can easily search online without being tracked.  
Shield Your Browsing History: Our 3rd-Party Tracker Loading Protection blocks most trackers before they load, greatly exceeding what most browsers offer by default. 
Chat Privately With AI: Duck.ai lets you have private conversations with 3rd-party AI models, anonymized by us and never used to train AI.   
Secure Your Email (Optional): Use Email Protection to block most email trackers and hide your existing email address with @duck.com addresses.  
Automatically Enforce Encryption: Shield your data from network and Wi-Fi snoopers by forcing many sites to use an HTTPS connection.  
Escape Fingerprinting: Make it harder for companies to create a unique identifier for you by blocking attempts to combine info about your browser and device.  
Block Tracking Cookies: prevents most 3rd-party cookies from tracking you as you browse from site to site.  
We feature many protections not available on most browsers and extensions, even in private browsing mode, including protection from link tracking, Global Privacy Control, and more. 
You don't need to wait to take control of your personal information! Join the millions of people using DuckDuckGo to protect their everyday searching, browsing, and emailing. 
Read more about our free Tracking Protections at  https://help.duckduckgo.com/privacy/web-tracking-protections  
Privacy Policy:  https://duckduckgo.com/privacy/  
Terms of Service:  https://duckduckgo.com/terms  
Note about 3rd-Party Tracker Protection and Search Ads: while there are some limitations following search ad clicks, viewing ads on DuckDuckGo search is anonymous. Learn more here  https://help.duckduckgo.com/privacy/web-tracking-protections

firefox-addons:969149.name: Tab Limiter
firefox-addons:969149.summary: Limit the number of tabs a given window can have (i.e. set a maximum number of tabs on a per-window basis) and automatically open additional tabs in a different window.
firefox-addons:969149.description:
This add-on lets you prevent any additional tabs from being opened in a given window. If you try to open a tab in that "tab limited" window (say by clicking a link), the new tab will "bounce" and open in a different window instead. 
The main use case is to have a window that only ever has one tab open in it. For example, a tab with an email or chat website that you want to always be able to access really easily by just switching to its window (rather than having to switch to its window and then to its tab). Like a pinned tab, but going further than just pinned.
To use the add-on, right-click on a web page to reveal the context menu, and then select "Tab Limiter" > "Limit this window to N tabs" to prevent additional tabs from being opened in that window. You can "unlimit" the window using the same context menu item.
When you try to open tabs in a "tab limited" window, they "bounce" and are opened in the "overflow window". If there is no overflow window yet, a new one is opened. You can change which window is the overflow window by right-clicking and then selecting "Tab Limiter" > "Open bounced tabs in this window" in the context menu.
There is never more than one overflow window at a time. Well, except private/incognito windows are handled correctly, so that private/incognito tabs are opened in a private/incognito overflow window. So it is possible to have two overflow windows, one regular and one private/incognito.

bluejetty:00027022:ios.description:
Grokio is a family of dating-social communities that help you explore your identity, connect with others who truly understand you--and find where you belong.
Join unique communities like Grommr, Feabie, Chasable (Chasabl), Ferzu, and Pupspace, communities that celebrate acceptance, body positivity and alternative lifestyles.
PUPSPACE
A new pup play community for human pups, handlers and anyone who loves getting into the pup headspace, coming soon!
GROMMR
A gainer-encourager community for gay and bisexual men who enjoy gaining, bigness and a larger than life attitude.
FEABIE
A feedism community for everyone who loves fat admiration, feeding and a mindset for growth.
FERZU
A furry community for everyone in the furry fandom. Furries of every size, shape and species are welcome!
CHASABLE
A chub-bear community for gay and bisexual men that celebrates plus-size men and body positivity.
Whether you’re looking for dates or friends who share your fandom, your passions or your kink, there’s a Grokio community for you.
EXPLORE your community by curating your own newsfeed--share, comment and connect with other like-minded folks.
CONNECT with people--near you or across the world--who share your interests, your passions and your lifestyle.
BELONG to a community that understands you--build one-of-a-kind friendships and relationships, attend community events and find yourself. 
Grokio strives to create welcoming spaces for people of every size, shape, gender identity and sexual orientation. Our communities are body-positive and lifestyle-positive spaces that welcome those who identify as BBW, BHM, bears, chubs, chasers, admirers, gainers, encouragers, feeders, feedees, furries, pups, handlers and more.
Grokio communities are for those of age 18 or older. Photos that display public nudity or are sexually suggestive content are strictly prohibited.
View our Terms of Use and Membership Agreement here: https://grokio.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/4/topic/9630ea01-2d5c-4b27-8406-acde947fe307

bluejetty:00131496:ios.description:
Enjoy the Free Sudoku Puzzle Game, Brain Games for people who are a fresh start and advanced! Thousands of Sudoku Puzzles Game to play and solve. Download and start the Daily Challenge!
The Sudoku - Brain Games has many different Sudoku puzzles and contained four different levels such as Easy, Medium, Difficult, and Expert to help you to choose the appropriate level for you!
There are easy levels of daily Sudoku puzzles to train your brain and Medium or hard Sudoku levels are also waiting for you. The game has the functions that to add or remove notes by turning on the memo during gameplay. Did you make a mistake? Of course, there are undo and hints functions! Don't give up!!
-Highlights-
9*9 & 3*2 blocks: 9x9 and 3*2 grids with simple design
Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert: Four perfectly balanced difficulty levels: 
-Features-
Note Mode: Turn on the note mode to take notes like a piece of paper. The memo is automatically updated itself while you fill in the block
Auto-Check: Find your mistakes and challenge yourself or use auto-check to see your mistakes in real-time.
Daily Challenge: Complete daily challenges and earn special trophies!
Hint: Use the hints function when you are stuck.
Number-first input: Tap and hold a number to lock it and you can use it for multiple cells.
Dark Theme: Perfect for you to play Sudoku before bed.
-Other additional functions-
Game stats: There is a stats feature for each difficulty so that you can examine the game what played at any time. (Statistics can be reset).
Unlimited Undo: Did you make a mistake? Get it back fast!
Autosave: If you leave Sudoku incomplete, it will be saved. Keep playing anytime.
Eraser: Eliminate all mistakes!
Train your brain anytime and anywhere with the Sudoku - Brain game. If you like Sudoku, we welcome you. Come and try it out! Investing your spare time in Sudoku is very helpful for your mental health. Challenge yourself how quickly you can solve problems!
We always carefully check all reviews. Please leave your feedback on why you like this game or suggestions for improvements! Thank you and have fun with Sudoku Puzzle Game!

bluejetty:00088243:ios.name: nPerf internet speed test
bluejetty:00088243:ios.summary:
More than a simple speed test, nPerf brings you the best and the fullest mobile connection quality measurement tool up to 1 Gb/s speeds! 
Full QoS test: In few seconds, test your bitrate speed, latency, browsing speed and video streaming q
bluejetty:00088243:ios.description:
More than a simple speed test, nPerf brings you the best and the fullest mobile connection quality measurement tool up to 1 Gb/s speeds! 
Full QoS test: In few seconds, test your bitrate speed, latency, browsing speed and video streaming quality on your mobile device.
Comparison function: Compare your results with those of others users and for each provider with a real time barometer.
Interactive map: Check network coverage and carriers performances in your area.
A sliding menu (hamburger icon on top left corner) allows you to start every test separately:
- Speed test
- Browsing test - website loading speed
- Streaming test
All your results are saved in an history with all tests locations on a map. Easily share your results on social networks with nPerf sharing pictures which present a useful summary of your test. Customize your application by switching the background theme using the Settings.
nPerf relies on an homemade top technology and a wordwide high speed servers network which can deliver the bitrate you need for speed tests. With nPerf, you do not blow up your data plan: with many optimizations, testing consumes up to 2 times less data than competing speed tests. In addition, a data indicator will notify you if the monthly threshold you can set in the menu Settings is exceeded.
All connection types can be tested over 1 Gb/s speeds !
2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, Wimax, WiFi & Ethernet speed test.
All WiFi technologies are supported. WiFi 802.11 a/b/g/ac dual-band, tri-band & quadri-band
All LTE technologies are supported. LTE, LTE Advanced dual-band, tri-band & more
Test your connection, diagnose connectivity issues and keep your Internet service provider and carriers honest!
WE NEED YOU
We are looking for speed test servers:
If you represents an hoster or ISP company and want to support nPerf project by providing a speed test server, please contact us.
We are looking for translators:
Your native language is not supported yet? You want to contribute to the nPerf project? Contact us if you want to translate nPerf in your language. You'll get a lifetime premium subscription on all platforms.

bluejetty:00180981:ios.description:
Play a unique Labyrinth Journey, as you discover classic square mazes and move on to circular or even triangular ones. Journey through the constellation mode and discover every Maze's secret.
Ever wanted to get lost among the stars or lost in a Maze. With the new Constellation mode, we bring you the best of both. 
Solve labyrinths to unlock stars in the constellation. 
Once all the stars have been collected, watch as the hidden constellation magically flourishes in front of you. Enjoy the magical journey through the labyrinth of stars and discover all of the constellations.
------------------
Play classic square mazes/labyrinths or discover many more original ones: circular, triangular, hexagonal, or even bunny, guitar or tree-shaped mazes. 
Challenge yourself with seven different game modes that include our unique intertwined labyrinths with teleportation portals.
Progress through the constellations and unlock over 100 combinations of maze sizes, types, shapes, and game modes.
---------------------
EASY TO PLAY
Swipe to guide the light through the maze and find the exit
SIMPLE AND RELAXING
Relax with small mazes or try to solve more advanced ones
DIVERSE LEVEL DESIGN 
 Master 4 types of mazes: square, triangular, hexagonal, and circular
GAME MODES
Start with classic mazes and unlock five extra game modes: time-limited
restricted moves
token collection
intertwined mazes with teleportation portals
BEAUTIFUL ARTWORK
Try our funny shaped labyrinths
Explore over 3 000 uniquely designed mazes with vivid colors and soothing music.
----------------------
This game has been made by a small team of three independent developers. All your suggestions and feedback to help us improve the game are welcome.
Enjoy this new title brought to you by Infinity Games, a market expert in minimal and relaxing gameplay! We are excited to bring you more and more features in future updates.
Check us out at: https://infinitygames.io

bluejetty:00185373:ios.name: Hungry cat: puzzle for family
bluejetty:00185373:ios.summary:
Food is within sight, but getting it to the hungry orange cat takes a little physics. Hungry Cat is a physics puzzle game about removing blocks, activating mechanisms and making the food reach the cat.
REMOVE THE RIGHT BLOCK
Tap ice blocks
bluejetty:00185373:ios.description:
Food is within sight, but getting it to the hungry orange cat takes a little physics. Hungry Cat is a physics puzzle game about removing blocks, activating mechanisms and making the food reach the cat.
REMOVE THE RIGHT BLOCK
Tap ice blocks to make them disappear. Look at the setup before you tap: removing a support can send the food falling or rolling along the boards.
SET THINGS IN MOTION
Trigger pushers and use the objects in the level to move the food. A stone can set other objects in motion, too. Figure out how the parts interact to get dinner moving in the right direction.
GET PAST THE HAZARDS
Keep the food away from spikes and electrical hazards on its way to the cat. Choose which blocks to remove and which mechanisms to activate.
Think through the puzzle, start the chain of motion and feed the cat!

bluejetty:00022142:ios.description:
Blending psychology and learning, the mission of Leaderly is to bring continuous leadership development to anyone, anywhere, anytime.
Leaderly changes the dynamic of leadership training from one-to-many, to one-to-one, by re-wiring the brain to adapt leadership as a mindset, lifestyle and learnable habit. 
Our technology uses a special blend of behavioral sciences, personalization, and machine learning to help any individual grow their own leadership skills and knowledge on a regular and reinforcing basis. And we made Leaderly FUN! 
Whether you are leading yourself or leading a team, the Leaderly system stays with you, and helps you grow along the way.
Quite simply, Leaderly is a personalized and persistent program for adapting leadership habits according to your style, goals and personality.
Blended behavioral algorithms bring a specialized program that allows a person to explore all the dimensions of leadership and continually practice those tiny behaviors that make all the difference. 
Built for organizations, Leaderly brings continuous leader development to groups of any size, with rich analytics, learnable moments and a wide range of in app polls and surveys designed to increase knowledge and motivation.
Unlock your next level of leaders today!
Leaderly is a subscription based self-help program that continuously delivers insights and inspiration for your growth as a person. The subscription provides you access to the full range of content, questions and algorithms that are based in psychology, behavioral sciences and leadership development.
Terms of use www.leaderlyapp.com/terms.

bluejetty:00062745:ios.summary: The Tamil Qur'an includes the most popular Qur'an translation in Tamil, two English Translations (Saheeh International & Muhsin Khan), all major hadeeth books (Bukhari, Muslim, Ibn Majah, Tirmidhi, Abu Dawood and Nasai) with English transla
bluejetty:00062745:ios.description:
The Tamil Qur'an includes the most popular Qur'an translation in Tamil, two English Translations (Saheeh International & Muhsin Khan), all major hadeeth books (Bukhari, Muslim, Ibn Majah, Tirmidhi, Abu Dawood and Nasai) with English translation and Arabic and Transliteration in English and Tamil.
Features:
• Complete Qur'an in crystal clear Arabic Font.
• Complete Qur'an Translation in Tamil with Foot Notes.
• Two English Qur'an Translations (Saheeh International & Muhsin Khan).
• Qur'an Transliteration for entire Qur'an in English and Tamil Transliteration.
• Ability to read the footnotes for Tamil translation while reading the translation.
• Search the Qur'an Content (Arabic), Translation (English & Tamil) and Footnotes.
• Search Translation/Qur'an Content from Spotlight - iOS Search Bar and directly go to the selected verse in the app.
• Prayer Times for any location with the options to share today's prayer times and to print monthly prayer times.
• Get Prayer Times Notifications five times a day and a notification for sunset and sunrise.
• View Qibla/Kaaba Direction from any location. 
• Bookmark the Qur'an Verse and the Footnote.
• Go to any verse while reading the explanation.
• Go to any verse just by selecting the Sura and Verse number.
• Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, Saud ash-Shuraym, Saad al-Ghamdi, Al-Hussayni Al-'Azazy (with Children), Maher al-Muaiqly, Salah Bukhatir, Sahl Yasin and Abdur-Rahman as-Sudais's complete Qur'an Qirath Streaming over the Internet.
• Tamil Qur'an App also comes with a beautiful Today Widget which displays Qur'an/Hadeeth from the authentic curated content of the large collection.
• Qur'an Word By Word: Word By Word meaning of Quran in Tamil and English.
• Print Qur'an Verse, Translation or any content from Today Widget to AirPrint compatible printers.
• Content from Today Widget can also be shared to any social media as image or text by tapping on the Today Widget. 
• Tamil Qur'an Translation Recitation.
• Auto Scrolling of Qur'an Translation - App will automatically scroll to the currently playing verse.
• Stream Qirath to Apple TV.
• Share single or multiple Qur'an verse or translation to any social media or app as text or image. 
• Baby Name : Search, copy and share baby names.
We would appreciate your reviews of the app to make this app superior.
Share this app with your friends.
Follow Us on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/TheTamilQuranApp

bluejetty:00127490:ios.description:
What is Dream Zone ?
· Gorgeous love interests!
· Breathtaking stories!
· Sensual scenes!
· Unique cards to collect!
Dream Zone is a dating simulator and a series of exciting interactive stories for guys. Create your character and choose your story. Flirt, search for your true love, start a slow fire in a long term relationship or dive right into fast-paced passion - it’s totally up to you! In this thrilling game for men you are free to live your dreams and unleash your passion.
What do you do IF:
· Your female boss craves your company?
· The girl next door is too scared to be alone and asks to spend the night with you?
Who will you choose?
· A former A-Grade student of a respectable family
· OR a spoiled Insta-diva with an explosive personality?
In Dream Zone you will become the youngest billionaire, a vlogging star on the rise, a world champion, or a renowned scientist. You choose your path in Dream Zone: The Dating Simulator & Interactive Story App!
If you like life simulation games, dating games, and choices games / episode games - Dream Zone is something to check out.
Twisted storylines, romance and drama in our original stories:
The Impossible Game
A mysterious voice message from the past has got you caught up in the game of billionaires. Can you make it to the finale and find out what is going on? Will you stay your former self or change your life once and for all? You decide! The game is on.
Half Human
You are an ordinary guy, you and your geeky friends go to an ordinary school called Cleveland High. But what if the students around you aren’t human? What if everyone you’ve known all your life is a robot? How do you survive in a world that has become foreign to you?
Devil's Deal
Life just keeps getting worse every hour, but then a stranger offers you a once-in-a-lifetime deal. Will you accept it?

bluejetty:00157237:ios.description:
As humans, we’re hardwired for connection. Belonging to a community makes us feel safe and helps us thrive. 
But so often, living with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) can make you feel physically and emotionally isolated. Not only can it be hard to do things you loved before your diagnosis, but it can also feel like no one understands what it’s like.
Until now.
Our mission is to cultivate a space powered by the RA community and empowered by each other. From one-to-one chats to conversation forums, we make connecting easy. This is a safe place to find and receive advice, to seek and offer support, and to discover the authentic stories of members, just like you.
Bezzy RA is a free online platform bringing new meaning to the word “community.” 
Our aim is to create an experience where:
- everyone feels seen, valued, and understood
- everyone’s story matters
- shared vulnerability is the name of the game
Bezzy RA is a place where you are more than your RA. It’s a place where, finally, you belong.
HOW IT WORKS
Social-first Content

FEATURES:
• Stay informed with South Florida's best source of news, sports, business, and ent
bluejetty:00175057:ios.description:
Now there's a simple, elegant and customizable way to get all of the Sun Sentinel's exclusive, in-depth local reporting on your iPhone and iPad.
FEATURES:
• Stay informed with South Florida's best source of news, sports, business, and entertainment
• Sign up for push notifications to get the latest news from our newsroom as soon as stories break
• Enjoy exclusive videos and photo galleries
• Edit the section list to be in your preferred order
• Save must-read stories, photos and videos for when you have the time to enjoy them
• Keep track of what you've read and what you haven't with Progress Report
• Turn your device sideways for an entirely different visual view of the news (iPad only)
• Get the latest breaking news from our newsroom in your notifications
• Share stories easily with Twitter, Facebook, or email
• Offline reading: Download and read content offline
• See your progress: Articles that have been read are greyed out to make your reading experience more efficient 
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
• Download the app to enjoy a sampling of free stories each month. For full access, try a free month of Unlimited Digital Access to the app, the Sun Sentinel website, and our eNewspaper; then it's only $19.99 a month. Make sure to create a registration while in the app so you'll be able to log in to the website and eNewspaper when you visit them in web browsers.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• Your subscription automatically renews each month unless auto-renew is turned off within your Account Settings at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Your iTunes account will be charged $19.99 for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
• You can read our Privacy Policy here: http://www.tribpub.com/privacy-policy/
• You can read our Terms of Service here: http://www.tribpub.com/central-terms-of-service/
• Questions about your subscription, including adding or removing Web access to the Sun Sentinel website from your app access, can be directed to Customer Service: 954-393-0111.
CRASHES / PROBLEMS?
We've been working hard to fix any and all crashes in the app. If you're still experiencing crashes or freezes after installing this update, please contact us at mobile@sun-sentinel.com. A quick email to our support team helps our developers identify and resolve crashes faster.

bluejetty:00017191:ios.name: Spider Solitaire Mobile
bluejetty:00017191:ios.summary:
Discover the Ultimate Spider Solitaire Experience: Win Every Time!
Prepare to conquer the classic card game with Spider Solitaire Mobile, where every deal is guaranteed to be solvable! Unlike other Spider Solitaire games that leave you fru
bluejetty:00017191:ios.description:
Discover the Ultimate Spider Solitaire Experience: Win Every Time!
Prepare to conquer the classic card game with Spider Solitaire Mobile, where every deal is guaranteed to be solvable! Unlike other Spider Solitaire games that leave you frustrated, we've meticulously crafted winnable deals for all game modes:
- 1 Suit: Master the basics with single-suit challenges.
- 2 Suits: Up the ante with a mix of two suits for a strategic twist.
- 4 Suits: Embark on the ultimate challenge with all four suits in play.
- Level Mode: Test your skills with 100,000 levels of increasing difficulty.
- Daily Challenges: Put your abilities to the test with fresh puzzles every day.
Features to Enhance Your Gameplay:
- Guaranteed Solutions: Rest assured that every deal offers at least one winning strategy.
- Portrait and Landscape Orientation 
- Unlimited Hints: Get a helping hand when you need it without any penalties.
- Unlimited Undos: Experiment freely and correct your mistakes effortlessly.
- Intuitive Controls: Drag-and-drop or tap to move cards seamlessly.
- Clear Visuals: Unmovable cards are highlighted in gray for easy identification.
- Immersive Sounds: Enjoy soothing sound effects and background music that enhance the experience.
- Simple and Engaging: Learn the rules quickly and immerse yourself in the addictive gameplay.
- Visual In-Game Help
- Enhanced Statistics and many achievements to unlock
- Vibrations
- Out of moves alerts
- Designed for both Tablets and Phones
- Offline highscores
- Stylus support
- Online leaderboards to compete with people everywhere
- Cloud Save, so you can always pick up where you left off. Your data will be synchronized across your multiple devices.
HOW TO PLAY
- The goal of the game is to create sets of cards that start with a king, queen and jack and end with an ace. Completed sets of cards will be automatically removed from the board and you score points. In order to win you have to remove all the cards from the board.
- Drag-and-drop cards or simply tap on the cards to move them on an eligible column.
- In games with more than one suit, in order for a set to be complete, all the cards in that column need to be in order and of the same suit. When you are successful in building a set, these will be automatically removed from the board. 
- You are allowed to mix different suits as long as the cards are in a descending order. But you cannot move the stacks, unless they're of the same suit.
- If you ever get empty columns you can place any card or any stack there.
- When you run out of useful moves, tap on the stock pile at the bottom of the screen to be dealt a new row of cards.
- You can only deal a new row of cards when all the columns are filled. Place at least one card on every column to be allowed to be dealt new rows of cards.
If you have any technical problems, please email us directly at support@gsoftteam.com. Please, don’t leave support problems in our comments – we don’t check those regularly and it will take longer to fix any issues that you might encounter. Thank you for your understanding!
Last but not least, a big THANK YOU goes out to everyone who has played Spider Solitaire Mobile!

bluejetty:00152444:ios.description:
Spirit Wars is a free-to-play fantasy idle RPG set in the vast, darkness-corrupted World Tree of Aeria. As a ""Savior"" summoned from another world, you'll encounter and lead a legion of unique Guardians—each with distinct personalities and abilities - fighting nightmarish enemies and eliminating the roots of evil. Enjoy idle progression—your team grows offline, gathering resources and unlocking skills—paired with strategic depth via an innovative skill sequence system. With massive welfare rewards, including free summons, daily login bonuses, and easy access to full-collection achievements, the journey to save Aeria is both relaxing and rewarding. Spirit Wars blends casual idle gameplay with rich fantasy storytelling—no grind, just pure adventure. Are you ready to answer Aeria's call?
[Game Features]
●Guardians Unite: Synergy & Strategy 
Forge bonds with Guardians across six realms, gather guardians with unique styles from all sectors, unlock powerful class-faction collaboration. Dominate Corruption-ridden battlefields through tactical positioning and strategic alliances!
●Relaxed Progression: Effortless Adventure
Level up your heroes with automated AFK battles—just set it and forget it! Earn massive Mythic rewards while you rest, making every adventure a breeze.
●Innovative Tactical Combat: Infinite Combinations
Master our innovative skill sequencing system and customize your battle formations. With limited skills but endless strategic possibilities, craft a unique combat style that’s all your own.
●Effortless Summons: Overflowing Rewards, Grand Haul
Start with 100 free summons and dive into mini-games packed with prizes. From bountiful draw resources to unlocking every Guardian, collect all Guardians faster than light! Your collection goals are within reach.
●Dimensional Quest: Boundless Adventures, Endless Fun
Experience unique dimensional journeys through Aelia's six realms! An unparalleled dimensional adventure experience, paired with various generous rewards will keep your hands full, and enjoy an unprecedented level of fun!

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/spiritwarsofficial/
Discord: https://discord.gg/6NeKgbrXP8

bluejetty:00127703:ios.description:
Biznis m-bank je mobilna aplikacija elektronskog bankarstva OTP banke, za pravna lica i preduzetnike. Jednostavna za korišćenje, omogućava brz i lak pregled svih računa i online dnevno bankarstvo u vašem mobilnom telefonu. Aplikacija omogućava pristup Biznis e-bank aplikaciji na svakom računaru i internet pretraživaču, bez potrebe za instaliranjem bilo kakvih dodataka.
Aplikacija nudi sledeće opcije:
• pristup biznis e-bank-u na svakom računaru i internet pretraživaču bez potrebe za instaliranjem bilo kakvih dodataka
• pregled transakcija po svim računima i biznis karticama
• plaćanje naloga u okviru dinarskog i deviznog platnog prometa
• preuzimanje izvoda
• kreiranje šablona za česta plaćanja
• devizne prilive
• IPS plaćanja
Za sve informacije, na raspolaganju Vam stoji Kontakt centar OTP banke na 011 30 11 552 i 011 30 11 555. 
OTP business m-bank is OTP banka’s mobile app for e-banking, intended for legal entities and entrepreneurs. Easy to use, it allows for a quick and simple viewing of all accounts, as well as for online daily banking with your mobile phone. The application provides access to the Business e-bank application on any computer and Internet browser, without the need to install any add-ons.
The application offers the following options:
• access to business e-bank application on any computer and browser without the need to install any add-ons
• overview of transactions on all accounts and business payment cards
• executing payment orders within the RSD and FC payment system
• statements download
• creating templates for frequent payments
• FC inflows
• QR payments
For further information, the OTP bank’s Contact Centre is at your disposal on 011 30 11 552 and 011 30 11 555.

Step into the fast-paced world of Goods Frenzy - Sort Puzzle, the match-3 game that puts your sorting skills to the ultimate test! Dive into a colorful store packed with goods and race against the clock to match and sort items before time runs out. Align three or more matching goods to clear them off the shelves and rack up points in this exhilarating puzzle adventure
With a huge variety of goods to sort, from snacks and groceries to unique items, every level keeps you on your toes. Enjoy the satisfaction of matching and sorting as you challenge yourself to beat the timer and unlock new puzzles filled with even more goods.
Features:
Fast-paced match-3 gameplay that tests your sorting skills under pressure.
A wide array of colorful, high-quality goods to match and sort in each puzzle.
Dynamic levels that grow more challenging, adding to the thrill of sorting and matching.
Special boosters to help clear shelves and achieve higher scores.
Compete on leaderboards and show your prowess as the ultimate sorter in the frenzy.
How to Play:
Swipe and move goods to align three or more matching items horizontally and clear them from the board.
Complete sorting puzzles within the limited time to progress to the next level.
Use strategic matching to create chain reactions and score bonus points.
Take advantage of special store-themed power-ups to sort goods faster or extend your time.
Meet level goals to earn stars and unlock exciting new challenges.
Can you handle the rush and master the art of sorting in Goods Frenzy - Sort Puzzle? Join the frenzy and start matching now!

Dive into a colorful store packed with goods and race against the clock to match and sort items before time runs out. Align three or more matching goods to clear them off the shelves and rack up points in this exhilarating puzzle adventure

With a huge variety of goods to sort, from snacks and groceries to unique items, every level keeps you on your toes. Enjoy the satisfaction of matching and sorting as you challenge yourself to beat the timer and unlock new puzzles filled with even more goods.

Features:

Fast-paced match-3 gameplay that tests your sorting skills under pressure.
A wide array of colorful, high-quality goods to match and sort in each puzzle.
Dynamic levels that grow more challenging, adding to the thrill of sorting and matching.
Special boosters to help clear shelves and achieve higher scores.
Compete on leaderboards and show your prowess as the ultimate sorter in the frenzy.
How to Play:

Swipe and move goods to align three or more matching items horizontally and clear them from the board.
Complete sorting puzzles within the limited time to progress to the next level.
Use strategic matching to create chain reactions and score bonus points.
Take advantage of special store-themed power-ups to sort goods faster or extend your time.
Meet level goals to earn stars and unlock exciting new challenges.

Can you handle the rush and master the art of sorting in Goods Frenzy - Sort Puzzle? Join the frenzy and start matching now!

bluejetty:00033086:ios.description:
The ocean covers more than 70% of our planet, yet most of the life within it remains undiscovered. FathomVerse is changing that, one dive at a time.
FathomVerse invites everyone to take part in real ocean exploration and discovery. Through interactive mini-games, FathomNauts identify animals in real underwater photos and contribute to a growing library of labeled images that helps scientists catalog and understand marine life. 
With FathomVerse, you can:
- Be among the first to review real imagery collected in the ocean.
- Learn to identify more than 70 groups of marine animals.
- Help train AI models by labeling animals in underwater images.
- Participate in quests, earn badges, and track your scientific contributions.
- Save and share your favorite ocean images in a personal gallery.
Whether you're a lifelong ocean lover or simply curious about what lives in the depths, FathomVerse makes it easy to contribute to meaningful scientific research.

bluejetty:00015229:ios.description:

In Worlds' Ash, Memories Echo.
Welcome to The World Senlo.
On April 1st, 1116, in the Senlo calendar, at 13:46, a colossal rift materialized above the northern district of Hailin City. Through it tumbled a fragmented world, leading to an intersection of realms at this very spot...
Soon after, crystals emanating unknown energies formed amidst the ruins. Research into these crystalline entities unveiled a group of individuals awakening to special abilities due to the influence of these mysterious crystals, known as “Echomancer”.
Humanity was thrust into a new era, one coexisting with unknown energies, belonging to the age of Scientific Electronics Experiment and Development (S.E.E.D.).
Ash Echoes is an interdimensional real-time combat RPG that intersects multiple worlds. Developed with the advanced Unreal Engine, the game is rooted in a unique and expansive universe. It harmoniously blends 2D and 3D art styles, creating a rich tapestry of exquisite and varied visual experiences. The characters are diversely crafted, embodying multi-faceted personalities and stories. Innovative in its strategic combat and abundant in interactive and exploratory gameplay, Ash Echoes sets a new standard for RPGs. 
As the Director of S.E.E.D., you will encounter visitors from different realms, unite to face unprecedented threats, and unravel the mysteries that have set this world in motion.

bluejetty:00000551:ios.description:
Build muscle. Get stronger. Compete. Fight. Become a champion.
Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump is a gym and bodybuilding game where you start as a skinny beginner and work your way toward a powerful physique. Train your muscles, increase your strength, compete in challenging events, customize your athlete and take your hard-earned power into the boxing ring.
BUILD YOUR DREAM PHYSIQUE
Step into the gym and start your transformation. Train your chest, shoulders, biceps, triceps, abs and legs through a variety of workouts and interactive training challenges. Increase your strength, lift heavier weights and watch your character grow bigger and stronger as you progress.
COMPETE IN 5 DISCIPLINES
Training is only the beginning. Test your strength and physique in five different competitions:
Jerk
Push
Bench Press
Arm Wrestling
Bodybuilding
Improve your performance, beat your records, challenge your rivals and fight for the top spot.
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Take your training and competition online.
Online Boxing PvP lets you fight other players over the Internet in competitive boxing battles.
Wi-Fi Boxing PvP lets you challenge players connected to the same Wi-Fi network and fight head-to-head.
Online Gym Multiplayer lets you enter the gym with other players and train together online.
BECOME A BOXING STAR
Take the strength you build in the gym into the ring. Enter Career Mode and rise from an unknown amateur to a boxing star. Face unique opponents, master jabs, hooks and uppercuts, use powerful combinations and climb your way toward heavyweight glory.
TRAIN, COMPETE AND PROGRESS
Body Transformation: Watch your character's physique change as your strength and training progress increase.
Gym Training: Work different muscle groups and develop your strength through a variety of exercises.
Strength Competitions: Test your power in Jerk, Push and Bench Press challenges.
Arm Wrestling: Challenge opponents and prove your strength.
Bodybuilding: Build an impressive physique and compete to show your progress.
Boxing: Enter the ring, combine punches and defeat your opponents.
Career Mode: Progress through your boxing career and become a star of the ring.
Supplements and Boosts: Use energy drinks, protein powder and gainers to temporarily improve performance and progression.
Gear and Customization: Collect boxing gloves and other items to customize your character.
Leaderboards and Achievements: Compete for high scores and compare your results with players around the world.
Energetic Music and Stylish Graphics: Train, compete and fight in a dynamic gym and boxing environment.
FROM SKINNY BEGINNER TO CHAMPION
Build your body. Develop your strength. Master the competitions. Challenge other players. Step into the ring and prove what you can do.
Are you ready to start your transformation?
Download Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump and begin your journey through fitness, bodybuilding, strength competitions, multiplayer and boxing.
IN-APP SUBSCRIPTIONS
Optional premium subscriptions are available in the game, offering exclusive bonuses and faster progression.
SUPPORT
Your feedback matters to us. Contact us through our official support channels.

bluejetty:00078060:ios.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest news and weather in the Buffalo and Western New York region on the all-new free WGRZ2 app from WGRZ. 
Our app features the latest breaking news that impacts you and your family, interactive weather and radar, and live video from our newscasts and local events.
LOCAL & BREAKING NEWS
• Receive real-time notifications for breaking news
• Read the latest news as it happens in your area
• Explore exclusive investigative stories
• Browse photos, news clips, and raw video
LOCAL WEATHER
• Daily and hourly forecasts for your city
• The latest forecasts from our meteorologists
• Interactive radar maps
• Automated hyperlocal severe weather alerts
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video newscasts and breaking news from WGRZ
PERSONALIZATION
• Discover and dive into topics that matter to you
• Favorite topics to receive personalized updates
Other Features:
• Share stories & videos directly with your friends and family
• See the latest updates and behind the scenes photos from your favorite anchors and reporters
• Get information on school delays & closings as they happen
• Cast videos and livestreams directly to your TV or streaming device, so you can lean back and enjoy your favorite programming on your biggest screen.
This is the official app of WGRZ2 and WGRZ.com, the NBC affiliate serving the Buffalo and Western New York region.
Got feedback? Let us know how we can make this the best app experience for you! Send us a note at appfeedback@tegna.com.

bluejetty:00088870:ios.description:
WikiTrip is your self-guided audio tour guide for anywhere you go — powered by Wikipedia. Just start moving — walk, drive, or ride — and WikiTrip reads aloud the stories behind the places you pass. No tapping, no reading. Hands-free, eyes-up, always learning.
PERFECT FOR
• Road trips — let the landmarks narrate themselves as you drive
• City walks & sightseeing — turn any street into a guided tour
• National parks & scenic routes — hear the history around you
• Everyday commutes — discover what you've walked past for years
HOW IT WORKS
Start WikiTrip and go. The app finds the most interesting Wikipedia articles nearby and reads them to you in a natural AI voice. A smart algorithm picks articles based on editorial quality, content length, and proximity.
TAP THE MAP
Curious about a specific place? Tap anywhere on the map to hear about it instantly.
13 AI VOICES
Choose from 13 expressive voices powered by OpenAI.
19 LANGUAGES
English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, and Icelandic.
YOUR HISTORY
Every article you hear is saved with a link to the full Wikipedia page.
SET YOUR PACE
Adjust the minimum distance and time between articles to match your journey.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00072985:ios.summary:
Do you want to pass the DKT Australia Learner's Test on your first attempt? You need to pass the DKT Test to obtain a driving license in Australia.
With this application, you will progress faster than any other traditional method, as you w
bluejetty:00072985:ios.description:
Do you want to pass the DKT Australia Learner's Test on your first attempt? You need to pass the DKT Test to obtain a driving license in Australia.
With this application, you will progress faster than any other traditional method, as you will be able to practice and prepare for the Driver Knowledge Test which is also known as Learner's Test. The test contains questions that are asked in the real DKT Test Australia and have been created from the official DKT Australia manual.
If you are searching for a handbook, booklet, manual, or practice material for the DKT Australia test then this is the best app for you. 
Test your knowledge by practicing topics. The Australian DKT question bank is divided into 10 categories. This free version contains the following categories:
- Car DKT
- Rider Knowledge Test
- SMV Rider Knowledge Test
- Rigid DKT
- Combination DKT
Application features:
- 370 questions to practice.
Realistic: Like the real test, our practice tests are based on the official Driver Knowledge test.
- Detailed explanations: When you make a mistake, the app instantly notifies you if your answer is wrong and why. Understand and remember every wrong answer.
- New questions every time: To keep you focused, we assign questions and answers randomly every time the practice test begins.
- Questions as per the official Learner's test.
- Score calculation as per the official DKT Learner's Test for Australia.

bluejetty:00092274:ios.description:
The guide to all your favorite outdoor activities, OuterSpatial connects you with other like-minded adventurers and the organizations that protect and manage your favorite outdoor places.
Use OuterSpatial to discover new places, navigate while on the trail, and share your adventures with others who love to play outside. OuterSpatial makes getting outside easy by putting information about amazing destinations — including curated articles, events, directions, photos, maps, and brochures — right at your fingertips.
# Features
- Browsable, up-to-date library of outdoor recreation information maintained by our partner organizations.
- Beautiful maps designed specifically for outdoor usage (both day and night).
- Transit, biking, walking, and driving directions to trailheads, campgrounds, and other locations.
- Information about in-person and virtual events.
- Real-time updates about on-the-ground conditions.
- Challenges to motivate you to experience the outdoors in new and exciting ways.
- Tools to help you contribute back to your favorite organization and share your outdoor experiences with others.
# Communities
OuterSpatial includes communities for all states and territories in the United States states as Alberta in Canada. Additionally, the following sponsored communities are currently available:
- Bend: Bend, Oregon
- CA State Parks: California-wide
- Daycation: Portland, Oregon
- Martha's Vineyard: Massachusetts
- National Recreation Trails: USA-wide
- Trails LA County: Los Angeles County, California
# Partner Organizations
We partner with hundreds of the world’s best parks and recreation organizations, including:
- Alaska State Parks (AK)
- Bend Park and Recreation District (OR)
- California State Parks (CA)
- City of Bloomington (IN)
- Five Rivers MetroParks (OH)
- Los Angeles County Department of Parks and Recreation (CA)
- Miami County Park District (OH)
- Midpeninsula Regional Open Space District (CA)
- Nevada State Parks (NV)
- North Dakota Parks & Recreation (ND)
- Ohio Department of Natural Resources (OH)
- Society for the Protection of New Hampshire Forests (NH)
- San Francisco Crosstown Trail (CA)
- State of Hawai'i Department of Land and Natural Resources (HI)
- U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USA-wide)
- Visit Utah (UT)
- Yosemite National Park (CA)
Interested in joining OuterSpatial? Shoot us an email at sales@outerspatial.com. We’d love to hear from you!

bluejetty:00099824:ios.summary:

Blocks ads in Safari
wBlock leans on Safari's own content blocking, s
bluejetty:00099824:ios.description:
wBlock is a free, open-source ad blocker for Safari. It blocks ads and trackers all over the web with more than 750,000 filter rules, and it never asks you to subscribe.
Blocks ads in Safari
wBlock leans on Safari's own content blocking, so pages come up clean and fast. Lists like AdGuard Base and EasyList refresh in the background, and you pick which ones run.
Handles the sites filters can't
Built-in userscripts get past anti-adblock walls and pop-ups. You can drop in your own userscripts and userstyles as well, and Return YouTube Dislike is one tap away.
Zap anything you don't want to see
The element zapper lets you tap a cookie banner or overlay and hide it, and wBlock remembers it next time you visit.
Light on memory
wBlock sits at about 40 MB of RAM when idle, so Safari stays quick.
Your call on every site
Turn blocking off for a site with one tap, or pause wBlock for a while when you need to. Settings sync over iCloud and can be saved to a file.
Private by design
wBlock collects no data and needs no account. The code lives on GitHub, so anyone can look at what it does.
Free for good
No subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

listings.name: wBlock: Ad Blocker for Safari
listings.description:
wBlock is a free, open-source ad blocker for Safari on Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro. Block ads and trackers with up to 750,000 Safari content-blocking rules. No subscription or in-app purchases.

Safari ad blocking
Choose recommended filter lists or add your own by URL, text, or file. Regional lists cover websites in your language. Optional filters handle cookie banners and other annoyances. Lists update automatically, and you can inspect the rules each list produces.

Userscripts and userstyles
Run built-in scripts such as AdGuard Extra and Dark Reader, or import your own userscripts. UserCSS themes support plain CSS and USO, along with Less and Stylus. Return YouTube Dislike is available in the catalog.

Native video controls
Optional Tube Cleaner and Player Cleaner bring Safari's native video controls to supported players, with Picture-in-Picture and background audio. Tube Cleaner includes SponsorBlock settings for YouTube. DeArrow is available separately for alternative titles and thumbnails.

Control each website
Turn filtering or userscripts off for a site from Safari's toolbar popup. Use the Element Zapper to hide an unwanted overlay. Limit individual lists to selected websites or exclude sites, including domain patterns such as amazon.*. Pause blocking when you need to.

Privacy settings
Tracking-parameter removal cleans supported links. Opt in to Global Privacy Control to send websites your privacy preference. An optional toolbar count shows supported blocked requests; it is not a complete count of everything Safari blocks.

iCloud sync and backups
Sync filter lists and settings across your devices, including custom filters and userscripts. Export a local backup when you want one. On Mac, scheduled filter updates can run while the app is closed.

Free and open source
wBlock collects no data and requires no account. Its GPL-3.0 source code is available on GitHub. All features are free.

bluejetty:00035248:ios.description:
Everyone deserves the benefits of moving smarter. That’s why we created Aaptiv, an AI-powered audio and video fitness app that creates hyper-personalized workout plans and on-demand classes led by expert trainers to help you crush your fitness goals. Whether you’re a fitness guru or just getting started, Aaptiv can create the perfect workout tailored just to you via the Pear ecosystem.
FEATURES:
SmartCoach: With Aaptiv, you become the star of your own fitness journey. Our SmartCoach feature, powered by AI, acts as your trusty pocket personal trainer. It starts by asking you a series of questions to understand your age, physical ability, and goals. Armed with this information, SmartCoach creates a tailor-made workout plan that's just right for you. It's like having a dedicated personal trainer that's always by your side, pushing you to greatness!
Audio & Video Workouts: With over 10,000 on-demand audio and video workouts at your fingertips, boredom is simply not an option. Aaptiv covers it all, from running and walking to elliptical sessions, strength training, stretching, yoga, and even rowing. We're constantly adding new classes to keep things fresh and exciting because we believe that variety is the spice of fitness!
Stats: We know that progress is key to staying motivated, so we've included the awesome Stats feature in the app. Keep track of your accomplishments, monitor your improvements, and celebrate your victories over time. It's your personal dashboard of success!
Heart Rate Zone Training: Take your workouts to the next level by pairing Aaptiv with a smart device to measure your heart rate. Our heart rate-based workouts provide on screen feedback, helping you stay in the optimal heart rate zone for maximum effectiveness. 
Programs & Challenges: These multi-week programs are tailored to specific fitness goals, whether you're aiming to conquer a 5K, build some serious muscle, or shed those extra pounds. Stay committed by completing the workouts in the program and watch your transformation unfold!
Music: Need some epic tunes to keep you motivated? Aaptiv has you covered! Choose to listen to your own music while our trainers' voices guide you through the workout, or tap into our specially curated playlists that are guaranteed to get your blood pumping and energy soaring.
Community Feed: Fitness isn't just a solo journey—it's a community-driven adventure! Capture your sweaty selfies and share your progress with other like-minded individuals in our vibrant Community Feed. Get inspired, motivate others, and revel in the support of your fellow fitness enthusiasts.
Get unlimited access to all classes for USD$14.99/month or USD$99.99/year. We also offer a 100% money back guarantee for the annual plan within 30 days, no questions asked.

Singing and dancing while learning is at the heart of the concept. The songs teach about good habits, emotions, words, numbers, notes, colors, always in a fun and entertaining way. It’s the perfect mix to live, laugh and love in the magical musical world of Lea and Pop.
Lea is a 5 year old girl who has what it takes to be an artist. She loves to dance, to sing and all the musical universe that surrounds her. At just one year old, Pop is very playful, clumsy and curious and is able to recognize the baby songs and follow the rhythm of the most popular kids ongs, especially while dancing. 
OFFLINE
When you connect to WiFi, Lea and Pop will automatically download the best baby songs, top kids songs and educational kids cartoons so they can watch the entire series offline (no internet connection needed).
Perfect for road trips, flights, waiting rooms and more.
NO ADVERTISING
There are no third-party advertising so nothing can distract your kids while listening our nursery rhymes, learning the ABC or watching favorite kids cartoons.
FREE TRIAL
You can get all the kids rhymes, baby songs and children cartoons for free during your 3-day or 7-day trial period followed by a subscription. 
You won’t be billed until 24 hours prior to the end of your free trial period.
We suggest to try the app before purchasing a monthly or annual plan.
WATCH ON TV
Watch best baby nursery rhymes, children songs, cartoons and shows for kids on your AirPlay or GoogleCast compatible TV. 
KID-FRIENDLY AND SAFE
Delightful age-appropriate preschool and kindergarten children show brought to you by our passionate team of early childhood educators.
This app is designed to provide a safe viewing experience. There’s built-in Parent Control feature for you to manage what your juniors have access to.
“Parent lock” button allows babies to actually touch the screen without interrupting the playback.
This app is designed with your little one in mind – kid-friendly interface makes it easy and safe to use even for toddlers.

bluejetty:00022172:ios.developer: Beijing Visual & Sense Technology Co., Ltd.
bluejetty:00022172:ios.summary:

The game style practice lessons will take you from
bluejetty:00022172:ios.description:
Get Started in 5 mins, Beginner to Pro in 10 Days !
PopuMusic App introduces an interactive guitar & ukulele playing experience, which will keep you entertained, hooked and craving for it.
The game style practice lessons will take you from beginner stage to an expert level in no time.
Skip the boring and tedious practise and level up in an entertaining way.
With the learning by playing settings, you will jam with friends or perform on stage very soon.
As Easy as Catching a Ball
Gamified guitar lessons in strumming, plucking, chord switching, and more!
When you play a note with guitar & ukulele, PopuMusic App instantly evaluating whether or not you’ve played correctly.
Get Started With Chord and Chromatic Practise
Visualize the invisible notes dancing on the screen. 
Neither need to know the sheet music, nor load the burden to remember everything.
Don’t worry, you know where you are, and what’s coming next with PopuMusic’s smart readings displayed on the screen.
Learn the Complex Chords with Ease
Playing a song is so difficult, but once you master a few chords, feel free to learn to play a song.
The secret behind is that you can combine the chords you’ve learned as the way you want, and even create a new song. 
PopuMusic make it easier by helping you make progress with chords learning step by step.
Interactive Video Tutorials
You may forget what we learned in the class, but PopuMusic has specially designed a series of learning tutorials for your reference to check and review anywhere anytime.
Explore Immersive Song Library & Play Game
The journey starts by choosing a song from the PopuMusic song library.
PopuMusic's weekly updated song library, imagine you can keep playing from one of your favorite songs to another. Enjoy more than 100s of US and EU pop songs.
Sitback, relax and start playing as the lead singer on stage!
Learn at Your Own Pace
Make yourself comfortable and confident by adjusting the chord or the songs playing speed with PopuMusic
Smart Tuning
Different from the tuning devices, we have integrated the tuning process and metronome into our smart PopuMusic App. Tap into the music tools, and follow the interactive guidance.
Chords and Fingering Dictionary
PopuMusic App has a strong chords dictionary, which including most chords inversions and scales, and all of these can be shown with LED indication.
This is a powerful tool, even for a Pro guitar player.
Switch Between Lights Modes
When you are composing a new song, you can turn on the light up mode with Poputar & Populele, it’ll help you visualize the chords that you’re writing.
Complex chords and ingenious patterns can all light up at once based on your will.
In Poputar & Populele dazzling mode, PopuMusic helps you create cool frequency-playing performances based on rhythm.
LEDs change in strength and shape to enable you to spot the difference and practice.
Populele & Poputar Switch in One App
You can also switch instruments between Poputar and Populele smart ukulele, learn and play more than two music instruments with one App. We will have PopuPiano in the future.
Level Up with Sheet Music 
After you are confident about the notes, rhythm and its fingering, we can definitely move to the next step - the sheet music. As you can see we’ve made the long way pavement before you can naturally enter this step.
Record and Share
Track your personal guitar learning journey and see how you make progress step by step! And share to your families and friends.
Thousands of songs with same simple chords, master the knack with PopuMusic!

bluejetty:00100087:ios.summary: With just a single product photo, Pixury helps you create professional product images and promotional videos. Whether you are an e-commerce seller, a social media creator, an entrepreneur, or a small business owner, Pixury empowers you to i
bluejetty:00100087:ios.description:
With just a single product photo, Pixury helps you create professional product images and promotional videos. Whether you are an e-commerce seller, a social media creator, an entrepreneur, or a small business owner, Pixury empowers you to instantly generate eye-catching visuals that make your products stand out on social platforms and online marketplaces—driving more attention, engagement, and sales.
Traditionally, producing high-quality product photos and ad videos requires complex design software, professional editing skills, or outsourcing to expensive designers. This process is time-consuming and costly. With Pixury’s cutting-edge AI technology, everything becomes simple and efficient. All you need is one ordinary photo of your product—Pixury takes care of the rest: background removal, background replacement, model generation, marketing poster creation, and even ad video production. Everything can be done in just a few taps.
Key Features
 - One-Click Story Video: Turn a single product photo into a cinematic, multi-scene promotional video. Just upload your image, choose a style, and let the AI do the heavy lifting. Whether you are showcasing jewelry, apparel, food, or cosmetics, Pixury instantly crafts a dynamic, story-driven commercial ready for your audience.
 - AI Photo Editing: Automatically remove unwanted backgrounds, replace them with custom scenes, add shadows, or erase distracting objects—making your product look sharp and professional.
 - AI Model Generation: Place your product into realistic lifestyle scenarios or on virtual models without the need for expensive photo shoots.
 - AI Posters & Marketing Images: Access a wide range of professional templates tailored for e-commerce and social media. Simply insert your product image and instantly create stunning promotional visuals.
 - AI Video Generation: No video editing skills required. Choose from trending ad or social media video templates, and Pixury will generate high-quality promotional videos for your brand.
 - Batch Processing: Quickly create multiple product images or videos at once, saving time and boosting efficiency.
Who Is It For?
Pixury is designed for anyone looking to improve their product presentation:
 - E-commerce sellers (Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, Taobao, Pinduoduo, etc.) who want polished product images and ad creatives.
 - Social media creators (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and more) looking to produce engaging product content effortlessly.
 - Small business owners and entrepreneurs who want professional-quality marketing visuals without breaking the budget.
With Pixury, you don’t need complicated tools or external teams. All it takes is your smartphone to create stunning product photos and promotional videos anytime, anywhere. Bring your ideas to life, showcase your products to the world, and turn every visual into a sales opportunity.
Pixury — Your AI-powered design assistant for product photos and videos. Simple, professional, and effective.
