bluejetty:00035612:ios.description:
Play the CLASSIC Rummy card game on your iOS device! Made by MobilityWare – the leading card and parlor game developer – this easy to learn card game is perfect for fun and relaxation. Play Rummy how YOU want to play!
How to win is simple: play all your cards before your opponents!
But victory is both challenging and rewarding against opponents with adaptive skill levels. Precision, strategy and quick thinking are needed to master the game. Lay off your cards and play your sets and runs to win the game! We’ve also included clear tutorials to help you learn the game of Rummy at your own pace. Relax and train your brain as you compete in the game of Rummy!
RUMMY FEATURES:
Play the fun and relaxing version of Rummy
- Hop into the classic Rummy gameplay you know and love
- Learn the game of Rummy in a low pressure, easy to learn environment!
- Experience the first MobilityWare game with JOKERS!
- Drop in drop out gameplay means Rummy is ready to play whenever you are!
- Use expressive emojis to let your opponent know you are winning big!
- Play offline – bots are available to play whenever and wherever
- Need help? Use the unlimited hints and undos!
New feature: Leagues!
- Take on several groups of players as you work your way through the ranks!
- Learn advanced gameplay techniques as opponent skill increases alongside yours
- Perfect your game and earn rewards!
Introducing Special Opponents!
- Face off against a colorful new competitor every month and earn unique boosters, hats, emotes, and avatars.
- Embrace the rivalry and become the champion you were meant to be.
The classic Rummy game, for beginners and Pros alike
- Over 300 titles to earn and collect!
- Track your high scores across several games
- Push for a new personal best with each hand of classic cards you play!
- Improve your play with deep statistics. Watch as you improve your strategy through each game!
Play Rummy how you want to
- Choose your preferred settings
- Choose either portrait or landscape to play
- Never lose a game with save states, even when the app closes!

bluejetty:00072993:ios.name: Watt for Smart Devices
bluejetty:00072993:ios.summary: Watt is the ultimate companion app for TP-Link smart home devices, Kasa Smart and Tapo. Available for iOS, iPad, and macOS, Watt offers unique and user-friendly features to make your life easier. With its modern and clean design, you can no
bluejetty:00072993:ios.description:
Watt is the ultimate companion app for TP-Link smart home devices, Kasa Smart and Tapo. Available for iOS, iPad, and macOS, Watt offers unique and user-friendly features to make your life easier. With its modern and clean design, you can now control all your smart devices with just one app.
(Watt does not support Security Cameras from Kasa or Tapo)
With Watt, you can monitor your energy consumption with daily updated, simplified graphs. The app supports voice control with Siri, allowing you to turn devices on and off, create events with shortcuts, and check the current status of your devices. Watt also has a Night Mode feature to turn off device LEDs and a Reset Stats feature to erase statistics.
Watt supports a wide range of smart devices, including Smart Plugs with Energy Monitoring, Smart Plugs, Smart Bulbs, and more. The app provides an overview of all active devices on the home screen and offers charts for runtime and energy consumption, as well as cost estimates. Watt also supports the concept of spaces/rooms for easy device management.
Now you can go even smarter with our unique features while navigating in a more cleaner and modern look. Watt are you waiting for?
~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Unique Features
~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Watt gives you unique and simple features to make your life easier. And the best part is controlling everything with just one app.
CHARTS
Simplified graphs, updated daily, with all information about your energy consumption, both in watts and in your specific money currency.
Export the dataset of the chart to CSV ("Excel")
VOICE CONTROL with SIRI 
Control your devices with a little help from Siri, turn on & off devices, one or several at once, create events with shortcuts, know the device's current status.
USABILITY
The experience of the app was designed based on the user's needs, with intuitive navigation, simple design, and relevant updates, all of this in the same app, we are able to provide the best experience for users
NIGHT MODE
Turn off the device led and have better sleep.
RESET STATS
Reset all the statics (Runtime and consumption)
KASA & TAPO
One single app to control the two product lines from TP-Link
WIDGETS 
Check consumption and chart directly from your home screen
-----------#- Supported Devices -#-----------
KASA - Smart Plug with Energy Monitoring: EP25, HS110, HS300, KP115, KP125, KP125M
KASA - Smart Plug: HS100, HS103, HS105, HS107, KP100, KP105, KP200, KP303, KP400, KP405, EP10, EP40
KASA - Smart Switch: HS200, HS210, HS220, KS200M, KS200, KS220M, KS230, ES20M,
KASA - Smart bulbs: KL50, KL50B, KL60, KL110, KL110B, KL120, KL125, KL130, KL135,KL400, KL420, KL430, LB100, LB110, LB120, LB130, LB200, LB230
TAPO - Smart Plug: P100, P105, P110, P115, P125, P125M, P410M, TP10, TP11, TP15
TAPO - Smart bulbs: L430C, L510, L520, L530, L535, L610, L630, L900, L920, L930, TL13, TL31, TL33, TL61, TL62, TL63, TL135
Take control of your electricity cost using the Watt!!!
Check all your Smart Plug with Energy Monitoring consumption in real-time.
If you want to have a look at the Roadmap for the app:
https://watt-app.com/
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated, endorsed, or supported by Tp-Link in any way, Kasa and Tapo are trademarks of Tp-Link. Watt for Smart Devices is a third-party application intended to work with smart home devices from Tp-Link and by doing that offers the Tp-link IoT Community another way to control devices and explore new features.
Icons provided by Icons8
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms & Conditions:
https://www.watt-app.com/privacy/watt_terms_conditions.html

bluejetty:00150127:ios.description:
ParqEx’ s marketplace enables non-commercial parking owners (e.g. residential, non-profit, and business parking spots) to rent their underutilized parking spots to drivers on an hourly, daily, weekly or monthly basis. For parking spots secured behind gates/garage doors, ParqEx’ s Access+ technology lets owners grant controlled access to their secured parking spots through the convenience of the ParqEx app.
LOOKING FOR A PARKING SPOT? SAVE MONEY! 
Get access to exclusive private parking based on your current location or search by address. Contact individual parking spot owners and ask any specific questions you may have. Reserve your ideal spot with the tap of a button and park your car by the hour, day, week, or month.
> EXCLUSIVITY
Access an exclusive inventory of private parking spots, unavailable anywhere but on ParqEx.
> CONVENIENCE
When you need a parking spot, just open the app, find and book your spot! Reserve from anywhere, at any time.
> COMMUNITY
When you book a spot on ParqEx, you support your community and help alleviate neighborhood parking crunches.
GOT A PARKING SPOT? MAKE MONEY!
Have a parking spot? Rent it out on the ParqEx app when you’re not using it, by the hour, day, week, or month – it’s up to you. Our customer service team takes care of the rest. Money is deposited into your account at the end of every week. Not only will you be making supplemental income, but you’ll also be helping solve your neighborhood parking crunch.
 > INCOME
Parking owners are paid out 80% of the rent received for their parking spot each week. It’s that simple.
 > COMMUNITY
Help the parking crunch in your neighborhood by renting out your unused parking spot.
 > CONTROL
You decide whom you rent your spot to and when.

bluejetty:00150103:ios.developer: Inova Solucoes em Tecnologia e Gestao
bluejetty:00150103:ios.summary: O aplicativo FAZ Digital Curitiba - Estar Curitiba Digital foi criado para substituir o cartão de papel no estacionamento rotativo nas ruas de Curitiba. Em apenas alguns cliques, o usuário da capital consegue ativar o Estar Curitiba Digital
bluejetty:00150103:ios.description:
O aplicativo FAZ Digital Curitiba - Estar Curitiba Digital foi criado para substituir o cartão de papel no estacionamento rotativo nas ruas de Curitiba. Em apenas alguns cliques, o usuário da capital consegue ativar o Estar Curitiba Digital - Estacionamento Regulamentar Eletrônico. É simples e prático!
Cadastre-se e pague com Cartão de Crédito, Débito ou Boleto. 
Baixe agora e tenha em mãos o aplicativo FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico! 
O que é o Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico?
O app FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico foi autorizado pela Urbanização de Curitiba (URBS) para substituir o cartão em papel para estacionar no estacionamento rotativo das vias públicas de Curitiba. Agora, o motorista escolhe a vaga no estacionamento rotativo e rapidamente pode ativar ou efetuar a renovação do Estar Digital - Rotativo Eletrônico.
FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico:
Em apenas 4 passos, você compra tempo de estacionamento rotativo (Estar Digital) na capital: 
- Pare seu carro na vaga escolhida do Estacionamento Rotativo Estar Digital; 
- Cadastre-se no aplicativo em menos de um minuto; 
- Insira a placa, setor e o tempo de permanência; 
- Pague por cartão de crédito, cartão de débito ou boleto. 
Pronto! Você acaba de comprar um crédito no Estar Eletrônico - Rotativo Digital! 
E se eu precisar de mais tempo? Como faço?
Com apenas dois toques, você estende seu cartão e consegue renovar tempo no Estar Digital Curitiba da URBS. Clique em “Quero + tempo” e depois é só “Confirmar”.
Não se preocupe! 
O app FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico avisa quando o seu crédito estiver perto de expirar!
Toda essa praticidade pelo mesmo preço!
A fiscalização da URBS também é digital! Você não precisa deixar mais nada no para-brisa do seu veículo ao encontrar vagas para estacionar.
O valor para comprar o crédito do Estar Digital Curitiba é o mesmo do cartão em papel. É moderno e sem complicações! E você não paga nenhuma taxa adicional para terceiros. 
Mais segurança e comodidade!
Toda a comunicação entre nosso app do Estar Eletrônico Curitiba e os servidores é feita de forma blindada e segura. Seus dados do cartão de crédito possuem proteção extra, com uma camada de segurança adicional. 
Tudo isso com uma interface intuitiva e amigável! Você não perde a paciência comprando o cartão em papel, não perde dinheiro com taxas extras de terceiros e ainda não perde tempo renovando a vaga em estacionamento rotativo! É só garantir o seu crédito no Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico.
Quando crédito do Estar Digital Curitiba deve ser utilizado?
O nosso aplicativo do FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico deve ser utilizado para regularizar o Estacionamento Rotativo - Estar Eletrônico do seu veículo quando a placa de sinalização da via indicar a obrigação da ativação dos créditos para estacionamento.
Com o app para uso do Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico da Urbanização de Curitiba (URBS) você substitui o antigo papel nas vagas de estacionamento rotativo. É só comprar crédito do Estar Eletrônico e caso necessite, pode renovar o crédito digital, adicionando mais tempo no estacionamento eletrônico diretamente pelo aplicativo do Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico.
Agora, o motorista escolhe a vaga no estacionamento rotativo e rapidamente pode ativar ou efetuar a renovação de crédito no Estar Eletrônico Curitiba.
Baixe agora o app FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico e facilite sua vida!

Em apenas alguns cliques, o usuário da capital consegue ativar o Estar Curitiba Digital - Estacionamento Regulamentar Eletrônico. É simples e prático!
 
Cadastre-se e pague com Cartão de Crédito, Débito ou Boleto. 
 
Baixe agora e tenha em mãos o aplicativo FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico!  
 
O que é o Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico?

O app FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico foi autorizado pela Urbanização de Curitiba (URBS) para substituir o cartão em papel para estacionar no estacionamento rotativo das vias públicas de Curitiba. Agora, o motorista escolhe a vaga no estacionamento rotativo e rapidamente pode ativar ou efetuar a renovação do Estar Digital - Rotativo Eletrônico.
 
FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico:
 
Em apenas 4 passos, você compra tempo de estacionamento rotativo (Estar Digital) na capital: 
 
- Pare seu carro na vaga escolhida do Estacionamento Rotativo Estar Digital; 
- Cadastre-se no aplicativo em menos de um minuto; 
- Insira a placa, setor e o tempo de permanência; 
- Pague por cartão de crédito, cartão de débito ou boleto. 
 
Pronto! Você acaba de comprar um crédito no Estar Eletrônico - Rotativo Digital! 
 
E se eu precisar de mais tempo? Como faço?
 
Com apenas dois toques, você estende seu cartão e consegue renovar tempo no Estar Digital Curitiba da URBS. Clique em “Quero + tempo” e depois é só “Confirmar”.
 
Não se preocupe! 
O app FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico avisa quando o seu crédito estiver perto de expirar!
 
Toda essa praticidade pelo mesmo preço!
 
A fiscalização da URBS também é digital! Você não precisa deixar mais nada no para-brisa do seu veículo ao encontrar vagas para estacionar.
O valor para comprar o crédito do Estar Digital Curitiba é o mesmo do cartão em papel. É moderno e sem complicações! E você não paga nenhuma taxa adicional para terceiros. 
 
Mais segurança e comodidade!
 
Toda a comunicação entre nosso app do Estar Eletrônico Curitiba e os servidores é feita de forma blindada e segura. Seus dados do cartão de crédito possuem proteção extra, com uma camada de segurança adicional. 
 
Tudo isso com uma interface intuitiva e amigável! Você não perde a paciência comprando o cartão em papel, não perde dinheiro com taxas extras de terceiros e ainda não perde tempo renovando a vaga em estacionamento rotativo! É só garantir o seu crédito no Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico.
 
Quando crédito do Estar Digital Curitiba deve ser utilizado?
 
O nosso aplicativo do FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico deve ser utilizado para regularizar o Estacionamento Rotativo - Estar Eletrônico do seu veículo quando a placa de sinalização da via indicar a obrigação da ativação dos créditos para estacionamento.

Com o app para uso do Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico da Urbanização de Curitiba (URBS) você substitui o antigo papel nas vagas de estacionamento rotativo. É só comprar crédito do Estar Eletrônico e caso necessite, pode renovar o crédito digital, adicionando mais tempo no estacionamento eletrônico diretamente pelo aplicativo do Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico.

Agora, o motorista escolhe a vaga no estacionamento rotativo e rapidamente pode ativar ou efetuar a renovação de crédito no Estar Eletrônico Curitiba.
 
Baixe agora o app FAZ - Estar Digital Curitiba - Rotativo Eletrônico e facilite sua vida!

bluejetty:00094971:ios.description:
The exclusive app for eligible Grouper members: At Grouper, our mission is to encourage healthy living through meaningful social connections and shared experiences. We believe that fostering a sense of connection and belonging leads to happier, healthier lives. Eligible Grouper members enjoy no-cost access to a diverse network of people, group activities and events designed to keep you active and engaged.
Not a Grouper member yet? Visit https://hellogrouper.com/join-a-group/ to check your eligibility or give us a ring at (833) 445-2400 to learn more.
Grouper communities are crafted by our members, for our members. These communities offer exclusive events, engaging challenges to keep you active, opportunities to share your achievements, and the chance to meet a vibrant group of fellow enthusiasts.
Included among Grouper’s exclusive events: activities like group walks, pickleball socials, virtual classes, book clubs, and hosted talks on healthy aging led by health professionals and experts. These gatherings are designed to keep you active, informed, and connected.
Our values—growth through new experiences, commitment, belonging, and inclusivity—ensure that every member feels welcomed, supported and dedicated to their health and overall life goals. Joining comes at no cost to you.
Eligible Grouper members will discover the below communities to start, with additional ones becoming available as we grow:
Active Living: Join a vibrant group that values staying physically active, connecting with others, and embracing a healthy lifestyle.
Arts & Crafts: Bring your ideas to life in Arts and Crafts, where you can find inspiration, learn new skills, and share your latest projects.
Aquatics: Let's make a splash! Learn new techniques, share your workouts, and connect with other water lovers.
Bowling: No gutter balls here! Strike up some fun, talk technique, and be challenged to roll your best game.
Cycling: Ride the road and pedal into fun with our cycling community, where you’ll be inspired to challenge yourself, go further, and connect with fellow riders.
Dance:Let’s groove together! Find your rhythm with fellow dancers who love to learn new moves and get lost in the music. 
Gardening: Let’s grow and bloom together! Celebrate your green thumb wins and swap planting tips with fellow gardening enthusiasts.
Golf: Tee up some fun! Connect with fellow golfers, share tips, and enjoy golf on and off the green.
Pets: Make every moment of play paws-itively unforgettable! Join our community to engage in fun challenges and celebrate how your pets keep you active.
Pickleball: Serve up some fun! Rally with fellow pickleballers and share tips so your next game is your best game.
Snow Sports: Gear up for snow adventures! Challenge yourself to get out there and learn new skills while connecting with fellow outdoor enthusiasts.
Walking: Let’s go one step further together! Challenge yourself to rack up more steps while celebrating milestones with the most supportive walking community out there.
To learn more about our policies and member guidelines, please review our Member Terms of Service here: https://hellogrouper.com/app-terms-of-use/, and our Community Guidelines here: https://hellogrouper.com/community-guidelines/.

重磅升级：火花思维课程全新升级为火花新思维。
以AI时代学习能力发展需求为导向，通过可视化、结构化与迁移式学习方式，帮助孩子从“学知识”走向“会思考、会表达、会解决问题”，构建面向未来的儿童思维能力培养体系。
核心功能：科学工具助力成长
- 火花6问：一站式答疑。
bluejetty:00023554:ios.description:
火花新思维家长端是一款专为家长设计的集内容、工具、服务于一体的督学伴学平台。通过在线小班直播，趣味故事互动，激发孩子学习兴趣，一站式满足孩子数理思维、中文素养、外语等多学科的学习需求。让孩子快乐学习，快乐成长！
重磅升级：火花思维课程全新升级为火花新思维。
以AI时代学习能力发展需求为导向，通过可视化、结构化与迁移式学习方式，帮助孩子从“学知识”走向“会思考、会表达、会解决问题”，构建面向未来的儿童思维能力培养体系。
核心功能：科学工具助力成长
- 火花6问：一站式答疑。支持问专家、问老师、问顾问、问客服、问AI、百万宝妈智囊团，快速解决家长疑问，提供专业教育支持。
- 火花百科：丰富的知识库，涵盖逻辑思维、科学、历史、文化等领域，拓宽孩子视野，激发学习兴趣。
- 个性化学情监控：AI智能分析，科学量化进步轨迹，帮助家长全面掌握学情。
重点特色：私人定制学习规划，重塑孩子思维能力
- 新应用：学-练-测评闭环，融入社会热点与探究迁移，从“会知识”到“会应用”；
- 全新思维系统：看懂数理→讲清思路→解决问题→举一反三，闭环培养，让思维层层进阶；
- 小班直播：动态分层教学，匹配孩子最近发展区，2分钟1次与老师1对1互动，每个孩子都是主角；
- 可视化思维路径：通过结构化、图形化表达方式，将抽象学习概念转化为可视化路径，使学习从“知道结果”走向“理解过程”；
- 专业老师：名师严选，7轮筛选才能符合上课资格，把最好的第八次课堂献给孩子；
- 督学伴学：专业老师全程跟踪学习情况，提供针对性辅导建议，确保学习效果；
- 家长社区：与其他家长交流经验，分享育儿心得，共同助力孩子成长。
学科培养：多维度能力提升
- 火花新思维：以逻辑关系、建模分析、益智策略为核心，培养孩子独立思考与解决问题的能力。
- 中文素养：以积累文化素养为基础，培养语言应用能力和人文思想洞察能力。
- 火花编程：通过AI + 真人双师教学，趣味闯关、贴合新课标、专属辅导答疑、练创结合，培养逻辑思维与创新创造能力。
- 外教1v1：通过“一对一沉浸对话”，帮助孩子在真实交流中建立语言逻辑，提升表达力与沟通能力，从“不敢说”到“敢说”，从“能说”到“会说”，在自然互动中收获表达的自信与乐趣。
-中教小班课：采用小班互动模式，实时关注引导孩子掌握科学的学习方法，让学习更轻松有效。
服务承诺：
无忧退课 快速退款；
同时：
1、不向学前儿童、中小学生提供校外学科类培训服务；
2、承诺不为违规学科培训提供便利； 
3、采取技术措施限制用于违规学科培训； 
4、在下载页等显著位置声明不为违规学科培训提供服务；
5、提供书面承诺不对学前儿童直接提供服务； 
6、采取技术措施限制学前儿童注册直接使用； 
7、在下载页等显著位置声明不面向学前儿童直接提供服务； 
下载火花新思维家长端，开启孩子的科学思维成长之旅！
立即体验，让孩子在快乐学习中收获收获受益终身的思维能力与学习自信！

Solo Cam is a vintage film camera.
It simulates several classic vintage film cameras in the history of photography, faithfully reproducing the colors and textures of film photography.
The simulated cameras include 135 film cameras, 135 pocket film cameras, 120 film cameras, disposable film cameras, Polaroid cameras, as well as some classic digital cameras.
Additionally, a photobook feature is provided, allowing you to view your own photography works in a book-like album format.
Cameras include:
- 135 film cameras: F OM1, F M6, F S3, F LX, F RF
- 135 pocket film cameras: P GR, P CT3, P LC
- 120 film cameras: M 503, M 28, M 617, M 612, M 67
- Disposable film cameras: D Fun, D Ace, D Pld
- Polaroid cameras: Ins One, Ins Mini, Ins Wide
- Digital cameras: DI GR2, DI GR3
Effects include:
- Datestamp watermark

bluejetty:00149119:ios.summary: Ruby Glint is your all-in-one app to identify rock, crystal, mineral and gemstone in seconds. Take or upload a photo of any rock or crystal, and instantly get accurate results. Ruby Glint helps you recognize over 6,600 types of stones, crys
bluejetty:00149119:ios.description:
Ruby Glint is your all-in-one app to identify rock, crystal, mineral and gemstone in seconds. Take or upload a photo of any rock or crystal, and instantly get accurate results. Ruby Glint helps you recognize over 6,600 types of stones, crystals, minerals, and gemstones using advanced rock identification.
Found a rock while exploring and want to know what it is? Are you curious about the crystals, minerals, and gemstones in your collection? Ruby Glint is the best app to identify rocks, crystals, minerals, gemstones, and stones. Take a photo and get instant results. Learn the name, properties, and value of each stone. Explore crystal meanings, find out where rocks come from, and build your own collection. If you love rocks and gemstones, this crystal and mineral app is made for you.
Rock, Crystal, Mineral, and Gemstone Identifier
Snap a photo of any rock, stone, crystal, or mineral to identify it quickly. Our powerful rock identifier and gemstone scanner matches your photo with thousands of known stones and crystals. Perfect for crystal collectors, mineral enthusiasts, and anyone curious about the rocks they find.
Learn About Every Stone
Each identification result gives you detailed information: scientific name, hardness, color, composition, and formation. Learn where each rock, crystal, or mineral is commonly found. From quartz crystals to rare gemstones, Ruby Glint’s crystal identifier makes geology easy to explore.
Rock and Mineral Location Map
Discover where others are finding crystals, gemstones, and minerals using our interactive rock map. See what stones are scanned in your area, or add your own discovery to the crystal and mineral community. Best map for rockhound.
Crystal and Mineral Learning Modules
Want to learn more about rocks, crystals, and stones? Explore guided lessons on gemstone grading, mineral types, crystal healing, and more. Build your knowledge and become confident in identifying every stone you come across using powerful stone identifier features.
Global Gemstone Marketplace
Buy and sell gemstones, crystals, and mineral specimens with collectors worldwide. Browse listings, filter by stone type, and connect with trusted buyers and sellers through our gemstone trading platform.
In-App Chat and Offers
Ask sellers about specific stones or crystals. Make offers directly and keep all communication secure inside the app. Ideal for crystal traders, gemstone collectors, and rock enthusiasts.
Crystal and Mineral Collection Tracker
Keep a digital record of your rocks and minerals. Organize your stone collection by type, location, or notes. Ruby Glint helps you track every crystal and gemstone you identify or collect.
Crystal Meanings and Healing Uses
Learn the spiritual and healing properties of popular crystals and stones. Explore chakras, birthstones, zodiac gems, and how crystals have been used across cultures for centuries.
Ask a Rock Expert
Have questions about a gemstone or mineral? Submit photos and get insights from experienced collectors and crystal specialists. Great for getting a second opinion or confirming rare finds.
Built for Every Rock and Crystal Lover
Whether you're a beginner in rockhounding, a mineral hobbyist, a crystal lover, or a gemstone trader, Ruby Glint helps you identify, understand, and enjoy every stone you find.
Download Ruby Glint today to identify any stone, explore its value, and connect with the global gemstone community.

support@rubyglint.com

https://rubyglint.com

bluejetty:00134162:ios.description:
Smarter Training. Superior Results. Train under one of 3 programs intelligently built by Jack Hanrahan. His proven system of training includes strength training, cardio and mobility to get you stronger, fitter and moving better.
The programs are easy to follow and fully guided by Jack. They are continuous and change every month to build on your progress.
Start rebuilding your fitness with a free 7-day trial.
BUILD WELL ROUNDED FITNESS
All our programs include a healthy dose of strength training, cardio and mobility: the 3 pillars of a well rounded fitness plan.
-The strength training prioritizes free weights and is based on movement patterns to build muscle and strength in a balanced and functional way.
-Cardio training balanced low and high intensity methods to maximize aerobic fitness.
-Mobility routines keep your joints healthy and moving well.
EASY TO FOLLOW: STRUCTURED & GUIDED WORKOUTS
All our programs are fully structured and guided by Jack.
Strength workouts feature high quality exercise demos and tutorials giving you full confidence in your form. They include rest timers, weight guidance and weight logging so you can track your progress.
Choose from more than one cardio method, whether you want to hit the road or stay inside and do one of Jack’s ever popular anti-HIIT bodyweight circuits. You’ll be guided on the length and intensity of your workouts to match your current fitness and improve your aerobic fitness steadily over time.
Follow along mobility routines are embedded in your weekly program and you’ll also find short ad hoc routines for those moments you need some extra movement: such as after prolonged sitting or when you first wake up.
CONTINUOUS TRAINING
The training doesn’t stop until you do. All our programs are continuous and the workouts will change every month to build on your progress. The perfect blend of consistency and variation to maximize results and keep your training enjoyable.
CUSTOMIZED PLANS
Choose a plan according to your:
-Ability: From beginner-advanced. We’ve got you covered
-Equipment: Full gym to home gym and everything in between
-Schedule: From 3-7 days per week
A PROGRAM FOR EVERY GOAL
PRGRM.Rebuild - for intermediate - advanced gym goers who are serious about building muscle and strength and keen to be fit and healthy.
PRGRM.Thrive - for beginner - intermediate gym goers looking for a well rounded and sustainable fitness routine that will get them strong, fit and moving well.
PRGRM.Adapt - suitable for all fitness levels. This program is your solution to effective strength training at home with minimal equipment. Resistance band workouts complimented by cardio workouts and mobility routines.
MOBILITY LIBRARY
Access Jack’s growing library of mobility routines which can be streamed to your laptop or TV in the comfort of your home. Designed to give you that much needed #SelfCare
TESTIMONIALS
“Jack thank you so much for this app! The content is awesome! Even with the gym closure disrupting things, I still made amazing strength progress and the anti-HIIT was a life saver without my normal cardio outlets!”
“After 8 weeks of Rebuild+, so many have noticed that my legs have gotten bigger and my body feels a thousand times better overall!”
“After two years of lifting I would always feel drained and very rarely could I go through a day without needing a nap. But ever since I started on Rebuild+ I’ve never felt better. No more joint pains!” 
PRICING TERMS
PRGRM is free to download. Ongoing use requires a subscription to one of our premium plans, billed monthly, quarterly or annually. Customers who choose the annual billing cycle are eligible for a 7 day trial period. Unless cancelled or auto-renew is turned off 24 hours before the next billing date or 7-day trial end, you will be billed automatically after every payment period to renew your plan
Uses Apple Health to track progress
ToS at https://api.ongo.app/tos or privacy policy at https://api.ongo.app/privacy

Photo Vault will help you lockdown your photos, contacts, passwords, and browser with the PIN protection.
You can secure your secrecy and precious memories for yourself. Photo Vault app give you a safe place to store all your photos, videos, passwords, contacts and internet browser information.
> Use Photo Vault for these purposes:
- Preserve great and precious photos gallery and albums
- Store your contact information
- Store all your passwords and never forget them
- Browse the Internet, without leaving any traces
> Basic Feature:
- Wonderful UI
- A secure and easy-to-create PIN
- Create photo albums and store your images library
- Save your videos, photos, albums into vault
- Store passwords, surf the web
Disclaimer:

Check out our online courses, and get ready to learn new skills and thrive.
A VAST RANGE OF PREMIUM COURSES
Choose from classes on professional development, business, wellness, creative skills, food, writing, home & lifestyle, sports & gaming, music, photography, and more—all featuring MasterClass’s cinematic storytelling.
200+ EXPERT INSTRUCTORS. THOUSANDS OF LESSONS.
Each class is broken up into bite-size lessons. Quit doomscrolling and binge a whole class—or learn new skills in just 5 to 10 minutes.
EDUCATION THAT’S ACCESSIBLE ANYWHERE
Watch on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple TV. For on-the-go learning, switch to audio mode or download select classes to build skills offline.
BOOST YOUR CAREER WITH BUSINESS LEADERS
Access business training courses taught by top leaders, including Martha Stewart, Mark Cuban, Bob Iger, Rich Paul, Sir Richard Branson, and Anna Wintour.
IMPROVE YOUR HEALTH & WELLNESS
Tap into expert-led educational videos on healing and boosting your gut, brain, and skin, plus courses on everything from menopause to meditation. 
COOK TO IMPRESS WITH WORLD-CLASS CHEFS
Enjoy immersive cooking classes with culinary titans like Gordon Ramsay, Roy Choi, Dominique Crenn, Massimo Bottura, Wolfgang Puck, and Thomas Keller.
FINISH YOUR BOOK WITH BESTSELLING WRITERS
Break through blocks and get your work out in the world with writing courses from Malcolm Gladwell, Margaret Atwood, James Patterson, Amanda Gorman, David Sedaris, R.L. Stine, and more.
LEARN TO BE LEGENDARY FROM ICONIC ARTISTS
Hone your creative skills with the likes of Amy Poehler, John Legend, Mindy Kaling, Issa Rae, RuPaul, Steve Martin, Shonda Rhimes, and Helen Mirren. Music lessons and photography courses are also available.
LEVEL UP YOUR GAME WITH ALL-STAR ATHLETES
Find out how champions like Lewis Hamilton, Serena Williams, Steph Curry, Wayne Gretzky, Tony Hawk, and Simone Biles (plus legendary coaches like Geno Auriemma and Mike “Coach K” Krzyzewski) train and win.
NEW CONTENT ADDED REGULARLY
Extend your online learning journey with new classes, playlists, and even offers to meet with our instructors. 
ANNUAL MEMBERSHIP TERMS

No refunds for partially unused periods. To cancel or update payment information, go to your App Store Subscriptions.

• All your
bluejetty:00065284:ios.description:
Are you tired of personal finance apps that are overloaded with features you don't need? GreenBooks isn't like that. It is powerful enough to do all the money management tasks you need, but with none of the complexity you don't.
• All your accounts, in one place
GreenBooks makes it easy to keep track of all of your accounts in one place. It makes tasks you do everyday such as entering transactions super easy and fast.
• Privacy focused. No advertisements. 
GreenBooks keeps our users’ best interests in mind. It does not collect data and does not sell user information to third-party platforms. Maintaining privacy and delivering optimal user experience is our highest priority. 
• Define your own spending categories
The key to money management is to put your transactions into categories, that way you can see where your money goes. GreenBooks lets you easily create your own categories.
• View the breakdown of your spending by category
The Breakdown chart shows you where your money is going, by breaking down your expenses and incomes by categories. Now you can answer the question, "where did all my money go?"
• Keep track of bills and subscriptions
Scheduled transactions let you keep track of all of your recurring bills. Set reminders so you never forget to pay them, and when your bills are due, log the payment with a tap.
• Reconcile your accounts easily
It's easy to reconcile accounts in GreenBooks with your bank. New transactions are marked as pending with a yellow flag, just tap the flag to clear it. You see both the ledger and cleared balance of your accounts at any time. 
• Split transactions
If you spent money in a store but they don’t all belong to the same category, simply split the transaction into multiple categories.
• Passcode protection
Easily protect your data with a PIN.
• Connect to banks or enter manually. It’s your choice.
GreenBooks has the ability to connect directly to the bank (via the Mac app), however, it is not necessary. You can enforce good spending habits by entering transactions manually. 
• Use GreenBooks for Mac for even more power.
GreenBooks for Mac has advanced features such as connecting to banks, editing multiple transactions at once, creating long-term budgets, viewing your net worth and spending trends over time. Data is automatically synchronized with the iPhone app via iCloud.
• More Useful Features
Multi-currency support, Dark Mode, data export, and other fantastic features…
TESTIMONIALS
“I guess I have tried them all, but this is without a doubt the easiest one I have ever used. It is self-explanatory in every way.” - @Silver Reed
“GreenBooks is the best checking account register of the many I've tried. It's straightforward, and easy to use, and I can customize the categories to my household. “ - @Flo Stock
“Excellent for keeping track of day-to-day income and expenditure. It is straightforward and easy to use and a great help for domestic budgeting. I wouldn't want to be without it.” - @dave6376
“Most of the other money apps were too cumbersome and complicated for my needs. This one is simple and easy to use, and looks beautiful.” - @ AgnePalamarc
Take control of your money. Try GreenBooks today!
Got questions? Email support@greenbooks.app anytime.
For more information, visit our website https://greenbooks.app

bluejetty:00061739:ios.description:
The TaxDome Client Portal is your accounting firm’s secure client portal, giving you one place to access requests, exchange documents, stay connected, securely sign documents, and complete payments with your accountant or tax professional from anywhere.
Use the app to see what’s waiting for you, submit information, review work, sign forms, and manage payments, all in one guided, secure experience.
What you can do using TaxDome as your secure accounting client portal
NOTE: Your accountant and/or bookkeeper must sign up for TaxDome before you can work with them through the TaxDome Client Portal
SUBMIT INFORMATION TO YOUR FIRM
Respond to requests from your accounting firm by scanning and uploading documents, scanning receipts, and completing organizers or questionnaires directly from your phone or tablet.
Business clients can also respond to bookkeeping requests and upload receipts on the go.
ACCEPT SERVICES & ENGAGEMENTS
Review and e-sign engagement letters or proposals when your firm begins new work or offers additional services.
REVIEW, APPROVE & SIGN WORK
When your firm completes your taxes or other work, review the documents, approve the work, sign required forms, and pay your invoice in one guided flow, all from the app.
STAY CONNECTED WITH YOUR FIRM
Message your accountant securely, share files within chat threads, track tasks that require your input, and receive push notifications when your firm needs action, so you never miss a deadline.
MANAGE INVOICES & PAYMENTS
View invoices sent by your firm, make one-time and recurring payments, and access your payment history. 
MANAGE MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS
Easily switch between multiple accounts when needed. For example, couples or clients managing more than one business all within the same app.
BUILT FOR SECURITY AND EASE OF USE
Protect your information with secure login using Face ID, fingerprint authentication, or two-factor authentication (2FA), depending on your device. Your data stays protected while you interact with your firm from anywhere. Backed by accounting-specific SOC2 Type II certification and multiple internationally recognized compliance standards for data protection and secure best practices.

Command historical warships in World of Warships: Legends, an AAA cross-platform game with gamepad support. Step aboard legendary vessels like the Yamato, Bismarck, Iowa, Atlanta, and Massachusetts from WW2 as you engage in battles on the high seas. In World of Warships: Legends, you'll find an impressive roster of more than 400 historical warships representing 10 diverse nations. Choose and command the warship that aligns most with your personal style as you navigate and engage in epic battles.
Participate in naval battles, command destroyers, cruisers, aircraft carriers, and battleships. Choose your strategy game and dominate the waters with three distinct warship classes at your disposal. Take command of the fleet and make your battle simulator the best naval combat. Whether you prefer to strike swiftly, support your team, or unleash devastating firepower, there's a warship class that suits your preferred tactics.
Prepare for war action across a variety of multiplayer game modes. Engage in intense Arena battles, climb the ranks in Ranked battles, or embrace chaos in the Brawl mode where anything goes. With thrilling PvP gameplay, you'll face off against skilled opponents from around the world in intense 9v9 battles, testing your strategic skills and teamwork. 
But the excitement doesn't stop there. Join our events, such as Halloween, New Year, and Anniversaries, where you can experience unique games and earn rewards. Celebrate in style and participate in limited-time events that add a touch of limited and seasonal flair to the already thrilling game.
Dazzle your foes not just through tactical expertise but also with your customization possibilities. Accumulate unique camos, skins, and exclusive commanders through collaborations with renowned franchises. Shine on the battlefield with distinct visual upgrades that transform your warship into a true reflection of your style.
Rest assured, you won't need to empty your wallet to savor all that World of Warships: Legends provides. We believe in rewarding our players, which is why we offer a system of free rewards. Play the war game for free and earn valuable in-game currency to unlock new warships, upgrades, and customization options. Should you wish to enhance your experience further, our in-game store offers a variety of goods for purchase. 
Engage yourself in breathtaking graphics, strategy games, and the thrill of naval combat. WoWs: Legends is the ultimate mobile game experience for history buffs, WW2 warships, strategy enthusiasts, and competitive players. Set sail, forge alliances, and conquer the seas. Download World of Warships: Legends and embark on your journey to become a legendary naval commander.

listings.description:
Command historical warships in World of Warships: Legends, an AAA cross-platform game with gamepad support. Step aboard legendary vessels like the Yamato, Bismarck, Iowa, Atlanta, and Massachusetts from WW2 as you engage in battles on the high seas. In World of Warships: Legends, you'll find an impressive roster of more than 400 historical warships representing 10 diverse nations. Choose and command the warship that aligns most with your personal style as you navigate and engage in epic battles.

Participate in naval battles, command destroyers, cruisers, aircraft carriers, and battleships. Choose your strategy game and dominate the waters with three distinct warship classes at your disposal. Take command of the fleet and make your battle simulator the best naval combat. Whether you prefer to strike swiftly, support your team, or unleash devastating firepower, there's a warship class that suits your preferred tactics.

Prepare for war action across a variety of multiplayer game modes. Engage in intense Arena battles, climb the ranks in Ranked battles, or embrace chaos in the Brawl mode where anything goes. With thrilling PvP gameplay, you'll face off against skilled opponents from around the world in intense 9v9 battles, testing your strategic skills and teamwork. 

But the excitement doesn't stop there. Join our events, such as Halloween, New Year, and Anniversaries, where you can experience unique games and earn rewards. Celebrate in style and participate in limited-time events that add a touch of limited and seasonal flair to the already thrilling game.

Dazzle your foes not just through tactical expertise but also with your customization possibilities. Accumulate unique camos, skins, and exclusive commanders through collaborations with renowned franchises. Shine on the battlefield with distinct visual upgrades that transform your warship into a true reflection of your style.

Rest assured, you won't need to empty your wallet to savor all that World of Warships: Legends provides. We believe in rewarding our players, which is why we offer a system of free rewards. Play the war game for free and earn valuable in-game currency to unlock new warships, upgrades, and customization options. Should you wish to enhance your experience further, our in-game store offers a variety of goods for purchase. 

Engage yourself in breathtaking graphics, strategy games, and the thrill of naval combat. WoWs: Legends is the ultimate mobile game experience for history buffs, WW2 warships, strategy enthusiasts, and competitive players. Set sail, forge alliances, and conquer the seas. bluejetty:00033212:ios.description:
Wave AI Note Taker: Audio and Phone Call Recorder for Transcription, Note-Taking & More
Whether you're in a business meeting, classroom lecture, or on a call, Wave ensures you never miss a crucial detail.
With its seamless background audio recording, intelligent summaries, and powerful AI transcription, Wave simplifies meetings for maximum productivity.
Put AI into action today to capture, organize, and share your conversations.
WHAT CUSTOMERS SAY
"Honestly don't know how this app can do such a good job with taking notes of technical stuff and acronyms and things, but it does."
"Wave took down the people names, and somehow they were able to tell who is who when they spoke and they would put down the person name and 98 times out of 100 they were correct."
"Wave did capture all notes from the last two very complex design sessions and it very neatly clearly succinctly gave me a summary with next steps in the way it organized the notes was fantastic."
KEY FEATURES OF WAVE AI
Audio Recording & Transcription
- Wave works in the background, continuously capturing conversations without interrupting your workflow. Ideal for in-person meetings, lectures, and personal notes.
- Convert your recorded audio or phone calls into accurate, shareable text. Perfect for meetings, interviews, and dictation. Say goodbye to manually taking notes.
- Seamlessly record phone calls through the app and automatically generate detailed transcriptions and summaries, keeping your conversations organized and easy to reference.
Intelligent Summaries
- Wave's AI technology converts lengthy conversations into concise summaries, giving you the key takeaways at a glance. Focus on what matters most with actionable lists, notes, and to-dos.
Privacy & Security Focus
- With Wave, your recordings and transcriptions are fully secure. You control your data—easily export or delete any files when needed.
Unlimited Recording Time
- Wave allows you to record as much as you want, whether it's a short dictation or a long in-person meeting. You'll never have to worry about running out of time mid-conversation.
Easy Organization and Sharing
- Wave's intuitive interface lets you categorize and organize your recordings into easily searchable lists or memos, making it a perfect tool for students, professionals, and everyday use.
- Share your transcribed audio or text via URL, PDF, iMessage, and more. Keep your team, clients, or family in the loop with just a few taps.
- Set up Siri shortcuts or use the Action Button to instantly start recording a new meeting or note on the go.
Flexible Use Cases
- For professionals who need accurate meeting minutes or summaries of discussions. Wave is built for seamless recording of face-to-face conversations, making it easier to stay present and engaged.
- Students and educators record and transcribe lectures, classroom discussions, and personal study sessions with ease. Organize your notes for easy review before exams or group projects.
- Journalists use Wave to capture interviews with clear audio and convert them to text for easier editing and article writing.
- Whether you're using it as a notepad, memo recorder, or to capture important moments from your phone calls, Wave is versatile and easy to use for every type of user.
DESIGNED FOR MAXIMUM PRODUCTIVITY
Wave helps you get more done in less time:
- Boost productivity by focusing on the conversation, not on taking notes.
- Stay organized with searchable transcriptions and notes—easily find any word or topic without scrubbing through audio files.
- Export and share important meeting notes, memos, or interviews instantly to streamline your workflow.
Get Started with Wave Today

listings.description:
The KUPA name is now synonymous with high-quality electric nail filing equipment. Kupa is devoted to producing quality products to nails salons everywhere.

KUPA has implemented a four-point plan to develop several proprietary products:

1. Middle-Market Electric Nail File Machine. The MANIPro Original® was developed to be a middle-market product in the KUPA product line. It brings to manicure tables the basic features expected from a KUPA product without additional costs. Superior-Grade Carbide Bits. When the nail industry needed high-quality and competitively priced bits to use with electric nail files, KUPA initiated the use of Precision Carbide Bits. Many of the industry’s current carbide designs were developed by KUPA.

2. The Newest E-File. At present Kupa offers an extensive line of E-Files for every level of nail technician. The newest model is the Portable MANIPro Passport® with the “first ever Acetone Resistant Control Box”. Nail Professionals everywhere have spoken and have voted the MANIPro Passport® the #1 electric nail file for nail professionals by readers in both the Nails Magazine Readers Choice Awards and NailPro Magazine Awards.

3. Professional Enhancement Line. A complete collection of nail enhancement products – Artfinity (Nail Embellishments), Divinity (Acrylic Nail Extension Products), Gelfinity (Hard Gel Nail Extension Products) and Dipfinity (Dipping Products) are KUPA’s exciting newly created product lines. We aim to fill the void left by dealers that are not authorized retailers of Creative Nail Design or OPI products.

4. Our Website. Kupa has developed an extensive website featuring our E-files and Enhancement Products, as well as informative “how to” educational videos that can be viewed on Kupa TV through our YouTube channel free of charge. https://www.youtube.com/user/KupaInc

KUPA will continue to create and launch proprietary products that meet the needs of nail technicians. Future products will incorporate technology from within and outside of the nail industry to make the nail technician’s life more convenient, portable, safe and cost-effective. Over the next few years, KUPA will also be developing electronic articles and guides to help nail technicians improve their business as well as their nail-filing skills.

bluejetty:00028689:ios.name: Botan: Plant Care, Identifier
bluejetty:00028689:ios.summary: Identify over 30,000 types of plants around you! Plant identification has never been so easy. Simply point the camera and snap any flower, leaf, mushroom, tree, or load a photo from your gallery to know its name and get all the most helpful
bluejetty:00028689:ios.description:
Identify over 30,000 types of plants around you! Plant identification has never been so easy. Simply point the camera and snap any flower, leaf, mushroom, tree, or load a photo from your gallery to know its name and get all the most helpful information.
Imagine this: you're walking through your garden or yard, and suddenly, you see a new plant growing. What is this? Is it a weed or a herb? Should you pull it up or let it flourish? You quickly take out your smartphone with the Botan app, snap a pic, and instantly see everything you need to know.
Want to become the best plant parents?
Your favorite plant doesn't look healthy. What do you do? How do you bring a plant back to life? Take a picture with Botan and learn vital information such as care tips and how to recognize your plant's disease. You also get information on how to cure it – Botan gives you everything you need to become the best doctor for your houseplants.
Main features:
Accurate Plant Identifier
Identify over 30,000 plant species with 98% accuracy. Simply take a photo or add an image from your gallery and Botan will help you identify which plant it is.
Plant Disease Diagnosis & Therapy
Bring the plant back to life! Why doesn't the plant look healthy anymore? Perhaps the care plan was incorrect, or the plant got sick. Botan will check it out in a few clicks! Take a picture of a diseased plant and the Botan app will help you identify if your plant is healthy or determine the type of disease and give advice on the treatment and prevention of diseases. Become a real plant doctor with Botan.
Plant Care Tips & Reminders
Plant care has never been so easy and convenient! How much water does a plant need to be healthy? How often does it need to be repotted? Botan will send notifications when it's time to water, fertilize, trim and repot your plant. In the Botan app, you can set up smart notifications – specify the date of the last watering and a convenient reminder time.
Light Meter
Does your plant look unhealthy? Perhaps it does not have enough light or it has too much. Botan will help you select the perfect place in your home for the plant. It's so convenient and easy! You need to point the camera to where the flower is located, and we will tell you if the lighting is suitable.
Ask a Botanist
Do you have questions about plant care? Our plant care experts will help you solve any problem! Just write a message to the chat, and we will help you with any problem. Now Botan is your pocket plant consultant!
Toxic Plant Warning
Identify toxic plants around you and get warnings to help your pets, children, and family stay safe.
Plant Information
Get complete information on how much water, light, and fertilizer your plant needs to stay healthy. You will be a real plant parent! Thanks to Botan, all your questions will be answered! Immerse yourself in the world of plants with Botan!
Create your plant collections!
Have you gotten the name of a plant, but forgot it? With the Botan app, you no longer have to remember the name of a plant. Now, you can keep your whole gallery on plants in the Botan app, so you can check information any time you want!
Helpful Articles
How to protect plants from wilting? What plants are dangerous for children and animals? Find out all this and more!!
Terms of use: https://tou-botan.botanapp.com
Privacy policy: https://pp-botan.botanapp.com

bluejetty:00137266:ios.summary: Are you ready to dive into the twisted mind of a serial killer? Join Officer Audrey Parker in the most gripping episode “Death Mask” of the “Word of the Law” detective games absolutely for free! Assemble your wits, sharpen your investigativ
bluejetty:00137266:ios.description:
Are you ready to dive into the twisted mind of a serial killer? Join Officer Audrey Parker in the most gripping episode “Death Mask” of the “Word of the Law” detective games absolutely for free! Assemble your wits, sharpen your investigative skills, and unearth the truth before The Sculptor turns his next victim into a lifeless masterpiece, so your task is to explore clandestine locations to unearth hidden objects and solve puzzles, getting closer to unveiling the enigmatic criminal's identity.
Officer Parker is on call! A sculpture was found in a city park. Hate to scare you, but just one day ago, it was a living person. The perpetrator, who treated the victim so cruelly, is known all over the city as The Sculptor. He has already sculpted three victims into perverted masterpieces of art. So, he tries to spread the message: silence will be rewarded with blood. What could be more confusing than solving serial murders? Oh, you'll see. Investigations work as a litmus test for all kinds of liars and hypocrites. Audrey Parker won't cope unless you are on her side! Help her to:
· INVESTIGATE THE CRIME!
Investigate a series of heinous crimes through a blend of hidden object challenges, mind-bending puzzles, and brain games. Uncover mystery case files, solve intricate riddles, and piece together the evidence to stop The Sculptor's horrifying spree!
· EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Setting off to this detective investigation you will solve intricate puzzles, challenging brain teasers and play various hide and seek games. Explore multiple picturesque locations for hidden objects, search and find mysteries and secrets to earn achievements and highlight your success as a professional investigator!
· GATHER COLLECTIBLES!
Sharpen your observation skills to spot elusive collectibles scattered throughout the city. Every detail matters in this race against time to prevent The Sculptor from creating a haunting garden of lifeless statues!
· UNLOCK BONUS CHAPTER!
Unlock the secrets of hidden lairs and delve into clandestine locations to unearth the motives driving The Sculptor's sinister actions. Only by deciphering his cryptic messages can you hope to thwart his deadly plans.
Are you up for the challenge? The clock is ticking in the free version of “Word of the Law: Death Mask” investigation!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames

- View accounts. 
- Pay bills and transfer funds. 
- Deposit checks. 
- Use Card Controls to set alerts, restrictions and turn your debit card off and on. 
- Manage your debit and credit cards stored online with popular service providers like Amazon and Netflix. 
- Pay people instantly with Zelle®.

With a business login, you can benefit from 
- ACH and wire options 
- Flexible user management 
- Security – Positive Pay and ACH Positive Pay 
- Remote deposit and mobile deposit 
- Easy access to services like eLockbox, SurePayroll and bill pay 
- Transfer funds 
Additional service fees apply.

bluejetty:00079042:ios.description:
Looking for a campground for a future camping trip, or need to find a campsite now, for tonight? Use ReserveAmerica's mobile app to search for available camp and RV sites, yurts, cabins and more in state, federal, and private parks and campgrounds across the U.S. Search by location, date, or amenities, and display search results on a map... View campground details, reviews and photos... Even save your search settings to make finding your next campsite as easy as opening the app! 
Features: 
* Search for available campsites by multiple criteria:
- Near your current location 
- Near a city or address 
- By name of campground, park, or facility 
- The activities and amenities you like 
- By arrival date and length of stay 
* Filter campgrounds and parks by site features: 
- Type of site (RV, Tent, Trailer, Day Use) 
- Equipment length 
- Electric hook-ups 
- Driveway 
- Waterfront 
- Pets allowed 
- Accessibility needs 
* Display search results on a map or in a list 
* Mark campgrounds as favorites
* View campground details, including photos 
* Get driving directions 
* Read summaries of available campsites 
* Reserve your selected campsite through the App or via the call center
* Contribute pictures of the campgrounds taken by you
* 3D Touch Features (Peek at location of the site on the map and pop to see search results in a map)
This is the official camping app from ReserveAmerica.com, part of Aspira. Learn more about Aspira’s outdoor recreation technologies at AspiraConnect.com.

Caution: IDV has not been tested or certified for clinical use. It is NOT approved as a medical device. It cannot be used for primary diagnosis in medical imaging.

bluejetty:00043264:ios.summary:
Are you ready to survive the chaos and become the ultimate hero?
A mysterious world of monsters, darkness, and nonstop danger is waiting for you in XP Hero. Trapped in a deadly realm with no way back, your hero must fight, survive, and gro
bluejetty:00043264:ios.description:
Are you ready to survive the chaos and become the ultimate hero?
A mysterious world of monsters, darkness, and nonstop danger is waiting for you in XP Hero. Trapped in a deadly realm with no way back, your hero must fight, survive, and grow stronger through every battle, every challenge, and every new threat. Step into an action-packed rpg game where only the strongest can survive the endless danger ahead.
- Features 
▶ Face Powerful Enemies
Danger is everywhere, and every enemy is ready to attack. Enter intense battle stages filled with monsters, traps, and fast-moving threats. Your hero must fight through each wave, survive every challenge, and defeat every enemy to move forward. In this dark survival game, every battle matters.
▶ Unlock Powerful Weapons & Combat Styles
Arm your hero with powerful weapons and discover the best way to fight. From blades to firearms, every loadout changes the flow of battle and gives this action game a fresh feel. Use each skill at the right moment, adapt to different enemy patterns, and build a combat style that matches your strategy. The more you fight, the stronger your hero becomes.
▶ Explore a Mysterious World
Step into ruined lands, shadowy dungeons, and abandoned battlefields as you explore a dangerous fantasy world. Every area brings a fresh challenge, stronger enemy types, and more rewards for your hero. This rpg game gives you new places to explore, new ways to fight, and new dangers to survive.
▶ Challenge Massive Boss Fights
Every great hero must face a powerful boss. Prepare for massive boss fights filled with deadly attacks, intense battle moments, and high-risk survival action. Each boss battle is a true test of timing and power. Fight hard, survive every attack pattern, and defeat each boss to earn rewards and prove your hero can become a true legend.
▶ Upgrade Your Hero
Power up your hero with progression systems that let you build your strength over time. Upgrade weapons, improve abilities, unlock a new skill, and build the right setup for every challenge. A smart upgrade can change the outcome of a tough battle, help you fight longer, and make it easier to survive against stronger enemies.
▶ Fast-Paced Action Gameplay
This is more than a simple action game. XP Hero combines fast combat, rewarding progression, and endless excitement in one addictive game loop. Jump into every battle, fight to survive, and play through nonstop waves of danger. Every game delivers fresh action, intense battle moments, and more chances to fight your way forward.
Ready to play, fight, survive, explore, and upgrade through chaos?
Lead your hero across an endless world of danger, defeat every enemy, conquer every boss, and build your path to become a living legend in this action game.
If you have any issues or suggestions during gameplay, feel free to contact us at the email below.

Do you want to get paid to deliver packages on your schedule? Are you looking to make money or earn a side income using your sedan, minivan or SUV? Do you want to deliver packages but not carry food orders or people? Jitsu lets you find paid package delivery routes in your area. You can earn money driving when you want, where you want.
Driving with Jitsu is easy: Sign up, tell us about yourself and your vehicle, pass a background check, and you can start driving.
Delivering packages with the Jitsu Driver App is easy
- A complete tutorial that shows you how to find delivery opportunities, pick up routes, complete deliveries, and get paid
- Advance route booking lets you know when and where you'll be driving up to 2 days in advance including guaranteed pay ranges for those delivery routes
- Fast and convenient package label scanning so you can load your vehicle efficiently
- Optimized and flexible routing so you don't waste time or fuel. You can even change the order of delivery stops to fit your schedule.
- Verified drop-off pins and photos so you can be sure you're delivering to the right place
- Ability to contact the customer to get clarifications about the drop-off location
- Real-time support from our Dispatch team (chat or phone)
- Weekly pay with the option to get paid early

bluejetty:00017283:ios.description:
Hidden fees are scary, that’s why Ticket Club doesn’t have them.
Other ticket retailers sneak surprise fees into every purchase, which quickly pile up and cost you more. With Ticket Club, you’ll save every time. Get a premier membership and you won’t pay a dime in service fees. Ever. 
---- WIDE SELECTION ----
Ticket Club sources its tickets from one of the world's largest and most reliable exchanges. You’ll get the same great seats you would elsewhere, for much less. 
---- 100% GUARANTEE ----
Once your order is accepted, we guarantee your tickets will be valid and shipped in time for the event.
---- WHY IT WORKS ----
Ticket Club offers the same great tickets to the events you love at competitive prices. With a Premier membership, the price you see is the price you pay. Join our club and you’ll skip their fees. It’s that simple.
---- CUSTOMER REVIEWS ----
My family and I had a great night at the Atlanta Braves game! The tickets we purchased were very reasonable and the ballpark experience was incredible. Even got to witness a walk off Home run!
Cheapest price for the same tickets by far. I checked seatgerk event-brite and tick.pick resale site and these were the cheapest.
I went to seatgeel like normal and was fixing to pay $80+ in service fees. I looked around and got the same exact tickets without the service fees! 
They have an amazing selection of tickets, especially well-priced re-sale tix for broadway shows.
Ordered tickets to the MLB game (Nationals vs Marlins) online while in Washington, DC. No additional fees were charged on top of the listed price!
I had no problems receiving my etickets and I saved about $20 per ticket compared to other sites like seatgreek or stub hub.

bluejetty:00019355:ios.name: Puzzlerama - Fun Puzzle Games
bluejetty:00019355:ios.summary: Puzzlerama is a collection of the best puzzles in the store: Lines, Tangram, Pipes, Blocks, Dots, Shikaku, Unroll, Unblock, Sokoban and Bridges all in one game. It is the definitive stop for puzzle lovers, with more than 4,000 levels to rel
bluejetty:00019355:ios.description:
Puzzlerama is a collection of the best puzzles in the store: Lines, Tangram, Pipes, Blocks, Dots, Shikaku, Unroll, Unblock, Sokoban and Bridges all in one game. It is the definitive stop for puzzle lovers, with more than 4,000 levels to relax, unwind and sharpen your logic skills. Better than any brain training, these Zen puzzles have no time limits but almost infinite fun! Puzzlerama merged all the king puzzles in a collection that will keep your mind active and entertained for hundreds of hours. And more puzzle games will be added in the future.
Puzzlerama collection currently includes:
- Lines – Number Link -
Lines is a classic free Japanese game also known as Number Link or Arukone. You have to connect the pair of dots of the same color so the lines do not cross or overlap. The entire board must be filled. 
- Color Fill – Tangram -
Color Fill is based on Tangram, the classic Chinese dissection puzzle. The goal is fill the entire board by dragging the geometric shapes. Color Fill is a great reasoning puzzle that trains your spatial intelligence and your geometric skills. 
- Pipes – Plumber -
Pipes, also known as Plumber, is a rotation puzzle where you have to connect all the pipes to let the water flow through the pipeline. Tap the pipes to rotate them and connect the pipes of the same color. Pipes starts easy, but different pipelines and other twists makes it challenging in later difficulties. Don´t worry, there is no risk of flooding; the liquid is safely contained inside the pipeline!
- Block Puzzle -
Block Puzzle is as simple yet extremely addicting puzzle game about blocks. Similar to Color Fill, the goal is to complete the entire board by dragging the block pieces. Blocks can´t be rotated, and the board changes horizontally and vertically every level, with different number of rows and columns each time. An hexa mode will be added in the future.
- Shikaku -
Shikaku, also known as rectangles, is another classic Japanese game from the same inventor of Sudoku. Shikaku is played on a square or rectangular grid with some numbered cells. The objective is to divide the grid into different areas, each of them containing 1 numbered cell and the exact number of squares indicated in that numbered cell. Later Shikaku introduces new concepts and cells that keep it interesting and challenging.
- Unroll -
Unroll is a unique thought-provoking brain teaser inspired by slide puzzles. Move the tiles to form a path that connects the green and red tiles and watch the ball roll. Unroll features 250 levels in 5 difficulties or packs. Unlock the fun now! 
- Unblock -
Unblock is a deceivingly simple yet challenging sliding block puzzle game. The objective is to move the blue block to the exit, by sliding the horizontal blocks side to side or the vertical blocks up and down. Wooden pieces, cars or even a mouse, unblock has come in different variations but none of them equals Puzzlerama´s. Don´t worry if all the pieces seems interlocked, just move them out of the way!
- Bridges -
Bridges, also known as Hashi, consists on a series of islands that need to be connected following a couple simple rules. You can only connect two horizontally or vertically adjacent islands, you can connect a pair of island with only 1 or 2 bridges and each island should be connected the indicated number of times. Bridges can´t cross each other and all islands have to be connected in a single configuration. In the future we will include an extreme version with the possibility of diagonal moves.
- Sokoban -
Sokoban is the classic game about moving boxes. Push the boxes until all the boxes are over the red dots. Same as the original version, this Sokoban is quite challenging.
Privacy Policy: https://maplemedia.io/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://maplemedia.io/terms-of-service/
SUPPORT: contact@maplemedia.io

• Attraction-only focus – modernist masterpieces, hilltop bunkers, beach day-trips, mountain viewpoints & more

Pin must-see attractions and rearrange on the fly. Need a last-minute tweak? Ask the AI to reshuffle around beach weather, crowd levels, or sunset cable-car rides—no spreadsheets required.
-----
Whether you’re a first-timer or a frequent visitor, our AI-enhanced guide turns Barcelona into a personalized adventure—no restaurant listings, no hotel clutter, just pure must-do magic. Download now and build the trip that’s 100 % you!

Why Limit
* Blocks distractions by default – every tap becomes intentional.

Download Limit and enjoy your apps – mindfully.

bluejetty:00175870:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00175870:ios.description:
LOCKED OUT OF YOUR CAR RADIO? GET YOUR CODE IN SECONDS
Stop driving in silence. Recover your original radio code instantly without paying expensive dealership fees. 100% Success Rate or your money back.
WHY USERS CHOOSE THIS APP You changed your battery or disconnected the terminals, and now your stereo asks for a PIN. Dealerships can charge expensive fees for this code. We do it for a fraction of the cost, directly from your phone.
KEY FEATURES:
• Instant Unlock: Receive codes for most Japanese, American, and European car models in seconds. • Money-Back Guarantee: If the code doesn't work, we refund you fully. • Human Support: Stuck? Chat with our experts directly in the app.
COMPATIBILITY We support a wide range of manufacturers. We can recover codes for Civic, Accord, CR-V, Pilot, Odyssey, Focus, Fusion, Escape, Golf, Jetta, Passat, and many more.
Our database includes support for major brands such as Ford, VW, Chrysler, Jeep, Dodge, Nissan, Fiat and others compatible with the serial number formats listed below.
HOW TO UNLOCK YOUR RADIO
Find the Serial: Scan the label on the radio casing. (For some models like Civic or Focus, you can find it on the screen by holding buttons 1 & 6).
Generate: Enter the serial in the app.
Play: Receive your 4-digit code and enjoy your music again.
WHERE IS MY SERIAL NUMBER?
• Screen Method: Common on newer models. Hold buttons 1 & 6 (or 2 & 6) and look for a code on the display. • Label Method: Most stereos have a sticker on the top or side of the metal casing. You may need to slide the radio out to see it. • Glovebox: Some vehicles have the code printed on a sticker inside the glovebox.
SERIAL NUMBER REFERENCE We support the following serial formats:
• U2201 L1290 (Audio Units with screen display) • V003261 or M066558 (V/M Series radio code) • T00AM123456 (Chrysler/Dodge/Jeep labels) • AUZ / VWZ (VAG Group labels) • BP0515... (Blaupunkt radio code)
DISCLAIMER This app is an independent tool for lawful owners. We are not affiliated with any car manufacturer. All brand names and trademarks appear solely for compatibility identification purposes.

Mobius® is an innovative control platform for your EcoTech Marine products. A core rethinking of how products connect and function make Mobius one of the simplest and smartest control apps you'll ever use.
Manage multiple tanks and get quick status updates from dashboard widgets.
Easily create Scenes that are accessible to run from the dashboard. Scenes make repetitive tasks as simple as tapping a button.

- Auto Mode: Tell us the additive you're dosing and how much, we'll take care of when based on proven best practices.
- Manual Mode: You're in control. Specify dosage and duration or rate.
- Continuous Mode: Set a dosing rate, and your Versa will dose as long as it has power.
- Easy Calibration
- Keep track of how much additive is left in the containers, so you don't run out.

bluejetty:00023825:ios.summary:
Design your perfect speaker box — skip the math and jump straight to building.

bluejetty:00023825:ios.description:
Design your perfect speaker box — skip the math and jump straight to building.
Speaker Box Lite calculates subwoofer and speaker enclosures for you: sealed, ported (bass-reflex), 4th & 6th order bandpass, passive radiator, and transmission line. Get optimal volume and tuning recommendations, then see your box in full 3D with auto-generated blueprints and cut sheets.
BUILT-IN SPEAKER DATABASE
Search 5,000+ drivers from 300+ brands — Thiele-Small parameters load with one tap. Can't find yours? Add it manually in seconds.
DESIGN IN 3D
Place speakers and ports, add braces and dados, choose materials — and watch your enclosure come together. Design custom waveguides for tweeters and ports — conical, elliptical, hyperbolic and radial horn profiles included.
SIMULATE BEFORE YOU BUILD
Frequency response, phase, group delay, cone excursion and SPL plots. Compare enclosure variants side by side and pick the one that sounds right — before you cut a single board.
COMPLETE SYSTEMS
Multi-way boxes with subs, mids and tweeters. Full crossover designer: low-pass and high-pass filters (Butterworth, Linkwitz-Riley and more), series and parallel notch, Zobel, RC and RL contour networks, plus L-Pad attenuation.
EXPORT & BUILD
Export cut sheets and blueprints for every panel. 3D-print custom ports and waveguides via STL, or export the whole enclosure and its parts as STL. Send parts to CNC in STEP format for precision cutting.
YOUR PROJECTS EVERYWHERE
Free account keeps projects in the cloud — start on your phone, continue on the web at speakerboxlite.com.
Upgrade to PRO for unlimited projects, offline database access and all advanced features.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Account Settings.

bluejetty:00170156:ios.description:
HeartWell: Your Trusted Heart Health Companion
Take charge of your cardiovascular health with HeartWell, the ultimate health monitoring app designed to offer professional-grade insights into your heart's performance. Using advanced optical heart rate monitoring technology, CardioPrime provides real-time heart rate measurements and valuable health data to empower you to live a healthier, more active life.
Key Features:
Heart Rate Monitoring: Powered by cutting-edge optical technology, CardioPrime gives you accurate heart rate readings in real time. 
Heart Rate Variability (HRV) & Stress Tracking: Go beyond heart rate and gain deeper insights into your body’s response to stress with HRV and stress level tracking. These metrics help you understand how your body is adapting to various physical and emotional factors.
Health Trends Visualization: HeartWell allows you to manually log additional health data, such as blood pressure, blood oxygen levels, and body temperature. With intuitive, easy-to-read trend graphs, you can track your health metrics over time and observe how your body changes and improves.
De-Shu Diet Plan: HeartWell includes a heart-healthy meal plan—the De-Shu Diet—designed specifically to help lower blood pressure. This carefully crafted recipe plan promotes balanced nutrition to support cardiovascular health.
Our Mission:
Our mission is to help you stay vigilant about your heart’s well-being and raise awareness of the signals your body sends. By empowering you with actionable data, we hope to inspire a healthier lifestyle and contribute to a longer, more fulfilling life.
We are committed to continually improving CardioPrime and introducing new features with every update. We promise to keep refining our app to ensure it provides the best heart health insights, making it an indispensable part of your wellness journey.
Join us in taking control of your heart health. Download HeartWelltoday and start your journey towards a healthier, more vibrant life!

You can cancel your subscription at any time
If you purchase on an annual basis, your iTunes account will be deducted. Unless you disable auto-renewal, renewal will be automatically charged to your account within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings in the AppStore after purchase.
Payment and Subscription Terms:
Choose from the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features
• Weekly Subscription
• Yearly Subscription
Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone
Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to Account Settings
- Open the Settings app
- Tap your name.
- Tap Subscriptions.
- Tap the subscription you want to manage.
*Important
Our App is not a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. The app is not a medical device and users should always seek the advice of a medical professional before making any medical decisions

bluejetty:00030866:ios.description:
Photocat is your all-in-one creative studio and smart assistant. We believe every photo deserves to shine, but not every shot deserves to stay. We’ve combined pro-level AI editing tools with a revolutionary "Swipe-and-Hold" organizer to rescue your camera roll from chaos.
The best part? Your companion is a virtual CAT who grows with your progress. Create, clean up, and see your furry friend thrive!
▶ UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY: Powerful AI Tools
Don’t let a bad hair day or a passerby ruin a perfect moment. Our suite of AI tools is designed for speed and simplicity — professional results with just one tap:
• AI Enhancer & Restore: Instantly sharpen blurry images and revive old, damaged photos to HD quality.
• AI Retouch: Smooth skin and remove blemishes with one touch for effortless beauty.
• AI Hairstyle: Transform your look in an instant — find your perfect hairstyle with a swipe!
• AI Hair Color: Try bold new colors or subtle highlights in seconds.
• AI Eraser & Remove Passerby: Effortlessly erase unwanted objects or people for clean, distraction-free shots.
• AI Filters: Reimagine your photos with artistic, stylized filters powered by AI. 
• AI Face Swap: Swap faces in seconds — fun, fast, and surprisingly realistic!
• AI Background: Change or blur backgrounds instantly, from studio colors to custom uploads.
▶ THE ULTIMATE FLOW: Swipe & Sort (NEW!)
Most cleaners only help you delete. PhotoCat helps you organize & sort. Our new gesture lets you keep and categorize photos in one fluid motion.
• Keep & Sort in One Go: Swipe right to save, but don't let go! Hold to reveal your pinned albums and drop the photo exactly where it belongs. It’s the fastest way to handle receipts, IDs, and family gems.
• Pinned Efficiency: The system "Favorites" album is always at the top, plus you can pin up to 5 of your own custom albums for lightning-fast sorting.
• Instant Detox: Save up to 47% of storage space by swiping away duplicates and blurry clutter.
▶ SMART EDITING: Custom AI Workflows
Tired of repeating the same edits? Now your feline assistant remembers them for you. Chain your favorite tools — like Remove Passerby → Retouch → Enhance — and apply them all in one go. Whether you’re editing one photo or fifty, your workflow runs automatically for fast, consistent results.
▶ INSTANT ACCESS: Widgets & Shortcuts
Customize your home screen with PhotoCat widgets for ultimate efficiency. Jump straight into "Daily Cleanup" or specific AI tools like Retouch or Enhancer. No more navigating menus; just tap and create.
▶ JOIN THE CLUB (Because Cats Deserve the Best)
Go Premium to unlock the full power of PhotoCat:
• Full access to all AI features
• Priority rendering for Workflows
• Weekly/Yearly coin allowance
• No watermarks & No Ads
• Grow With Your Cat: Your subscription feeds your creativity... and your virtual pet!
