bluejetty:00061207:ios.description:
Based on the principles of Overeaters Anonymous, Food for Thought offers support for compulsive overeaters who want to change their food behaviors and follow a program of abstinence. This inspiring app contains 366 readings, one for each day of the year. Each reading is intended to provide daily encouragement, helping you create a life of balance and break old, self-destructive ways of thinking about food. All readings end with a short prayer.
When the app is opened each day, it will automatically show you that day’s reading. Choose a time for a daily notification reminding you to read, reflect, and meditate on that day’s reading and on your program. Open the app anytime you need to refocus.
Food for Thought will become an essential tool helping you build your program, stay abstinent, and become the person you are meant to be.
Features:
PRESS the “Today” button to access today’s reading.
SWIPE forward or back to easily access more daily readings.
SHARE the daily reading with friends by e-mail or text.
BOOKMARK your favorite readings (press the star in the upper right-hand corner) and easily return to them (press the star in the bottom toolbar).
SEARCH all 366 daily readings.
RECEIVE a notification every day to remind you to read the daily meditation.
JUMP to a specific reading using the calendar button.
SET your font size using your device settings.
CHOOSE between light or dark mode.

bluejetty:00014112:ios.description:
Flock is a powerful business messaging and team collaboration app that brings all your work into one place. 
Today, your team’s communication is scattered across emails, ad hoc messages, and multiple tools. With Flock you can quickly bring people together, discuss ideas, share information, assign tasks, and track team progress, so your team can focus on what they do best. Flock effortlessly adapts to your unique needs whether you are a large enterprise, a small business, or a high-growth startup. 
With Flock you can:
• Communicate with colleagues and entire teams through 1-on-1 chats and group messaging
• Create different channels for projects, departments, or topics for focused communications
• Effortlessly search previous conversations and channels
• Send and share files on-the-go
• Hold video and audio calls with screen sharing capabilities
• Use built-in productivity tools such as to-do’s, reminders, and polls
• Integrate with all your favorite tools and services, including Google 
Drive, Trello, Jira, GitHub, Hubspot, etc.

Flock is free to use for as long as you want. You can upgrade to our paid plans for enhanced features and increased user control.

bluejetty:00077104:ios.name: Kong Island: Farm & Survival
bluejetty:00077104:ios.summary: Kong Island - Farm & Survival is an immersive farm adventure and island games that blends the thrill of deep exploration with the satisfying mechanics of farming and resource management. Stranded on the mysterious, sprawling Kong Island - a
bluejetty:00077104:ios.description:
Kong Island - Farm & Survival is an immersive farm adventure and island games that blends the thrill of deep exploration with the satisfying mechanics of farming and resource management. Stranded on the mysterious, sprawling Kong Island - a land whispered to be untouched by time and home to ancient wonders - you must step into the role of a strong survivor. 
Features:
- Enjoy detailed planting and harvesting processing - making every successful crop feel truly rewarding.
- Control your energy and manage the Advanced Wellness System (Morale and Fatigue) for a more immersive, challenging survival experience.
- Find and grow unique Crops tailored to new island farming regions where skill determines the value and potency of your yield
- Unlock and explore new farmland, each with unique resources and mysteries.
- Collect, gather resources and quality-of-life items that passively boost your Morale and Recovery for peak performance.
Your mission on the Kong Island games is not just to survive, but to thrive: master the island's wilderness, uncover its hidden secrets, and build a sustainable life amidst its exotic dangers.
Build Your Family Farm:
You've found yourself stranded on a deserted island and survival is key. Start by establishing your very own family farm. Cultivate crops, raise animals, and gather resources to transform the wilderness into a self-sufficient paradise. With deep farm games mechanics, you'll always have something to do, from planting seeds to crafting complex tools.
Adventure & Exploration:
In Kong Island game, farm adventure is at its core. Explore dense jungles, unravel the island's secrets, and search for ancient ruins. Meet unique characters and unlock new areas, each hiding its own treasures and challenges.
Kong Island - Farm & Survival extends a compelling invitation to embark on a farm adventure and transform into a brave explorer - pioneer. Will you merely subsist, or will you conquer the wilderness, establish a flourishing civilization, and unlock the legendary secrets of Kong Island?
Download Kong Island today! Harvest crops, produce natural goods, explore and start your island adventure!

bluejetty:00043194:ios.name: Jaib - Digital Wallet
bluejetty:00043194:ios.summary: Jaib is an electronic wallet that works with innovative and intelligent technologies that facilitate various financial transactions through an application that is downloaded to your phone to save your money and use it for electronic payment
bluejetty:00043194:ios.description:
Jaib is an electronic wallet that works with innovative and intelligent technologies that facilitate various financial transactions through an application that is downloaded to your phone to save your money and use it for electronic payments for purchases, to recharge your balance, to make financial transfers, and any other financial transactions. Therefore, Jaib is an electronic cash service, an alternative to cash and the problems of currency damage and other problems that individuals suffer from in their financial transactions.
Jaib provides services that meet all your basic and entertainment needs, most notably:
Financial transfer service:
Transfer your money anytime and anywhere through Jaib wallet.
For more information:
Jaib allows you to send financial transfers to your friends who are subscribed to the wallet from your place with the push of a button, and it also allows you to transfer money between your accounts in different currencies within the wallet.
Transfer to a subscriber: With this service, you can transfer your financial transfers from your account in Jaib to the account of another person who has an account in Jaib wallet.
Transfer between my accounts: With this service, you can transfer your money in different currencies between your different accounts in Jaib wallet.
Bill payment:
With the convenience and security of Jaib wallet, you get rid of waiting lines and pay for your various services
Jaib wallet allows you to pay for different services easily, securely, and comfortably from your home and at any time, such as paying for internet and fixed phone bills and other services.
Recharge your balance:
Jaib provides a service to recharge your mobile balance or that of one of your acquaintances, whether for the package system, prepaid, or billing system for all local telecommunications networks.
Purchase payment service:
Easily, securely, and as an alternative to cash, pay for your many purchases through Jaib wallet.
For more information:
Anyone who is subscribed to Jaib wallet can replace cash payment with electronic payment through Jaib wallet for all their purchases from commercial, service, restaurant, and cafe shops easily and comfortably, by scanning the QR code or entering the point of sale number.
Cash withdrawal service:
Withdraw your cash from Jaib agents and service points located everywhere.
For more information:
It allows you to withdraw your cash through Jaib agents located in different provinces after feeding your account through Jaib agents as well or service points or withdrawing your financial transfers from different networks to your account in Jaib wallet.
Entertainment services:
Jaib wallet offers a range of entertainment services that make it easy for users to interact with games and various entertainment platforms.
Other:
Another list on the Jaib application interface enables you to know the latest operations you have performed and a statement of your financial transactions in the wallet.
* Download the app now
* Get rid of the hassle of cash payment, and facilitate your various financial transactions electronically with complete security.

Hypnozio offers an extensive library of over 100 audio sessions, including tailored 20-minute daily sessions for weight loss, sleep improvement, anxiety relief, and more. Each session is crafted by certified hypnotherapists for impactful, long-term results.
Quick Relief Sessions
Find immediate support during moments of stress or anxiety with Hypnozio’s 10-15 minute Quick Relief sessions, designed to provide instant calming guidance whenever you need it.
Daily Affirmations
Boost your mindset with Hypnozio’s daily affirmations, crafted to encourage positivity, resilience, and self-confidence. Each day brings a new affirmation to inspire growth and support a healthier mental outlook.
Favorites & Offline Access
Build your personal hypnotherapy library by saving your favorite sessions for easy access. Download sessions to enjoy offline, ensuring your journey to wellness continues uninterrupted, whether you’re commuting, relaxing, or traveling.

Fitness Motivation: Stay motivated in your fitness journey with sessions that encourage a positive mindset and discipline.
Addictions: Overcome negative habits by reframing cravings and building resilience through structured hypnotherapy.
Relationship Support: Strengthen connections, move past old relationships, and manage stress with sessions tailored for emotional well-being.

bluejetty:00073595:ios.description:
Focus, relax, and sleep through the power of sound. Endel creates AI-powered sounds designed to support your everyday life. Backed by science, and enjoyed by millions worldwide. 
Endel is powered by its patented core AI technology. It takes inputs like location, environment, and heart rate, to create the optimal personalized soundscape. This happens on the fly and allows Endel to reconnect your state with your circadian rhythm.
Get access to the following classic soundscapes at home, work, or on the move to relax, concentrate, and minimize distractions and brain fatigue:
• Focus – boosts your productivity by helping you concentrate for longer
• Sleep – soothes you into a deep sleep with soft, gentle sounds
• Relax – calms your mind to create feelings of comfort and safety
• Move – feel grounded and present while walking, hiking, or running
ENDEL PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Alongside the classics, the Premium package contains the following Endel Soundscapes and features:
• Colored Noise – choose one of 9 colors of noise to focus, relax, sleep, and mask outside sound
• Study – improves concentration and keeps you calm while studying or working
• Dynamic Focus – get your perfect productivity support with real-time sound tuning
• Hibernation – nourish your ears with cozy sounds for cold-season slumber
• Nature Elements – nurture the mind with sounds of nature, your way
• Rainy Outside – cozy up to the gentle patter of rain, blended with sleep-aiding sounds
• Recovery – revives your wellbeing with sounds engineered to lower anxiety
• Spatial Orbit – venture into a more peaceful dimension with an immersive Spatial Audio experience
• Focus Timer – the famous interval work method, upgraded with science-backed Focus sounds
On top of the much-loved original Endel soundscapes, Endel works with innovative artists and thinkers to create unique experiences. These collaborative Endel Soundscapes are available for Premium users:
• James Blake: Wind Down – prepare your body for sleep with soothing sounds from an award-winning artist
• Grimes: AI Lullaby – supports sleep for babies and adults with original sounds and vocals from Grimes
• Plastikman: Deeper Focus – a deep focus techno soundscape created with Richie Hawtin
• Alan Watts: Wiggly Wisdom – soothing and motivation spoken word soundscape, infused with the playful wisdom from Alan Watts
• Miguel: Clarity Trip – elevate your every step with original sounds from Miguel
Endel Pacific is the patented technology that powers our apps and integrations. All soundscapes are available offline.
Apart from the Premium sounds and features, Endel Premium users get access to the exclusive Apple Podcast shows.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Skip the payment screen by tapping “X” in the top-right corner of the offer. The Free Edition of Endel will start automatically.
You can get access to Endel Premium by subscribing to a recurrent plan of your choice or with a one-time Lifetime purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
For more information:
Terms of Use - https://endel.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360003558200
Privacy Policy - https://endel.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360003562619

Immerse yourself in a beautiful world of grand oper
bluejetty:00141643:ios.description:
Looking for a relaxing yet challenging way to keep your mind sharp? Welcome to Jewel Opera, the ultimate casual match 3 puzzle game designed to train your brain and melt your stress away!
Immerse yourself in a beautiful world of grand opera houses, vibrant colors, and satisfying jewel-crushing fun.
> A Beautiful Journey Down Memory Lane
An elegant, charming Operina returns to a legendary, long-forgotten Opera House. As she steps through the grand entrance, the theatre sparks to life with magical, abstract flashbacks of her glorious youth.
Every puzzle you solve paints the background with her vibrant, nostalgic memories. But look closely—is that a faint, mysterious silhouette watching her from the shadows? Could our lovely heroine have a hidden connection to the theatre's legendary past?
Explore the beautiful rooms, match the glowing gems, and piece together her romantic history in this high-energy puzzle adventure!
> Satisfying Casual Gameplay & Brain Training
Give your brain a fun, comforting workout! Help our fabulous heroine explore thousands of glamorous rooms filled with brilliant treasures and addictive gem matching games.
- Crush & Blast: Swap and pop colorful jewels to trigger dazzling, high-score combos!
- Clear the Stage: Blast through Golden Roses and light up the elegant Candelabras.
- Break the Spell: Crack mysterious Cursed Masks and reveal hidden Love Rune Pendants.
- Summon Magic Bees: Match jewels in a square to spawn clever helpers that clear the board for you!
> How to Play
- Match 3 Jewels of the same color to solve puzzles and earn magical stars.
- Match 4 Gems to create powerful Special Jewels that blast entire rows or columns!
- Match 5 Jewels to unleash the Rainbow Sun—the ultimate mega-booster that starts spectacular, colorful cascades and clears the toughest levels!
> Top Game Features
- Relaxing Brain Game: Thousands of fun, stress-relieving match-3 puzzles designed to keep your mind active and sharp!
- Charming & Nostalgic Story: A beautiful casual narrative that subtly weaves together abstract memories and hidden secrets.
- Daily Rewards & Free Boosters: Claim free gifts every day to help you crush levels and progress through the story.

Get there with The World’s Most Experienced Driver™

REQUES
bluejetty:00175312:ios.description:
Get there with The World’s Most Experienced Driver™
Waymo is on a mission to be the world’s most trusted driver, making it safer, more accessible, and more sustainable to get around—without the need for anyone in the driver’s seat.
REQUEST AUTONOMOUS RIDES
Ready to ride in any of our existing territories? Download the Waymo app and enter your destination to request your first ride.
HOW IT WORKS
Once requested, the Waymo car will pick you up from your current location; all you have to do is hop in, sit back, and buckle up. To begin your trip, tap “Start Ride” on the in-car passenger screen where you can also see what the Waymo Driver sees and contact Rider Support at any time.
DESIGNED WITH YOU IN MIND
Waymo offers the freedom of having a car to yourself without the stress of driving or parking. Day or night, you can request fully autonomous rides that are safe, clean, reliable, and customizable. Whether it’s picking the perfect temperature or streaming your favorite playlists, each ride empowers you to make it your own.
MEET THE WORLD’S MOST EXPERIENCED DRIVER™
Waymo is The World’s Most Experienced Driver™ with millions of miles of experience and a proven safety track record. Every car in our all-electric fleet is operated by the Waymo Driver, an autonomous driving technology built with safety at heart.
Its real-time visibility gives the Waymo Driver the capability to navigate and adapt with ease. Supported by a multilayered suite of sensors—including cameras, radar, and lidar—our systems maintain a constant 360°-view of the car’s surroundings ensuring road safety for all.
YOUR RIDE, EVERY TIME. EXPLORE FEATURES
Ride scheduling
• Set pick up times up to one hour in advance and we’ll be there to get you.
Pick the perfect vibe
• Adjust temperature and select tunes all through the Waymo app or in-car screen display.
Easy door unlock
• Only you can unlock your ride—use Bluetooth to unlock your ride automatically as soon as you’re near. Adjust settings via the My Car Tab in the Waymo app.
Share your trip
• Share live arrival times with friends and family while en route.
Trunk space
• Store your belongings with ample trunk space. Upon exiting the car, the trunk will automatically open to ensure nothing’s left behind.
Multi-stop
• Add multiple destinations to your ride anytime—up to 4 per trip. Or, pull over any time with the tap of a button using the Waymo app or in-car screen.
Eco-friendly
• Do right by the planet when you ride with our all-electric fleet.
The Waymo app is available for download in:
• Australia
• Canada
• France
• Germany
• Great Britain (UK)
• India
• Italy
• Japan
• Mexico
• New Zealand
• Poland
• Singapore
• United States of America

bluejetty:00028413:ios.description:
Most runners only train one thing: running.
That’s why progress stalls, soreness piles up, and injuries keep coming back.
Workouts for Runners is built for runners who want to run faster, feel stronger, and stay healthy without guessing what to do off the road.
If you run, this app fills the gaps that running alone doesn’t cover.
What you will notice
• Runs that feel stronger and more controlled
• Less soreness and fewer nagging aches
• Better stability, balance, and confidence
• Training that actually supports your running
This is not a generic fitness app.
Every workout exists for one reason: to make you a better runner.
What’s inside
Strength training made for runners
Build leg strength, core stability, and upper body support to improve efficiency and protect your joints.
Gym and home workouts
Train anywhere with routines that fit naturally around your running schedule.
Recovery and durability work
Target the muscles and movement patterns runners often neglect. These are the ones most likely to lead to injury.
Clear guidance with video demos
Every exercise includes simple instructions and demonstrations so you know exactly what to do.
Coach Chat
Ask questions, get training advice, and stay motivated with a built in coach whenever you need guidance.
Flexible realistic training
Whether you run a few times a week or train for races, the app adapts to you.
Who this is for
• New runners building a strong foundation
• Experienced runners chasing faster times
• Anyone tired of aches injuries or stalled progress
Looking for the women’s version?

bluejetty:00146808:ios.description:
This app is an essential tool for your phone replacement process, allowing you to efficiently and securely transfer data such as contacts, photos, videos, documents, and more from your old phone to your new one. It is easy to use, supports one-click migration, requires no complex setup, and allows for a seamless transfer with just a few simple steps, making the phone switching process more convenient.
FEATURES
One Click Migration
- With just a simple operation, you can transfer contacts, photos, videos, documents, and other data from your old phone to your new one in one click.
Wi-Fi Transfer
- When both the sending and receiving devices are on the same Wi-Fi network, users can scan a QR code to connect the devices and start the transfer. This method is fast and stable.
Hotspot Transfer
- If Wi-Fi is unavailable, you can create a hotspot to quickly transfer data from your old phone to your new one. Once both phones are connected to the same hotspot, scan the QR code to begin migration.
Comprehensive Support
- Supports the transfer of various data types, including contacts, photos, videos, documents, and other common files, catering to all your needs during phone replacement.
USE CASES
- Easily migrate data when switching phones, with no complicated steps just a few steps to complete the transfer.
- Users who need to quickly transfer large amounts of photos, videos, contacts, and other data.
- No need for a computer transfer data directly from phone to phone.
USAGE SCENARIOS
- When switching phones, quickly transfer data from the old device to the new one to avoid data loss.
- When devices are incompatible, use this app to achieve cross-device data migration.
Download now and experience the most convenient way to transfer data!

bluejetty:00147505:ios.summary:
You're walking home.

My SOS F
bluejetty:00147505:ios.description:
You're walking home.
Your mum slips getting out of the bath.
Your son breaks down on a country road.
A lone worker feels unsafe.
In every one of those moments, the people who love them want to help.
The problem is they don't know.
My SOS Family helps the people you trust know when something's wrong, where you are, and who is already helping.
NOT A CALL CENTRE. NOT A STRANGER. YOUR PEOPLE.
When you need help, My SOS Family alerts the people who actually know you by phone call, text message, email and app notification, all at the same time.
Not a message they might not see for hours.
Not a monitoring centre staffed by someone who doesn't know your name.
A phone call. To your daughter. Your neighbour. Your best friend.
They don't need to download anything. They just need to pick up.
THE ONLY CHAT BUILT AROUND YOUR SAFETY
Every chat app was built for convenience. My SOS Family Chat was built for the people you trust most., in a private space that protects them as much as it connects them.
Private messages and groups — only seen by who you choose.
Your live location shared only when you want, only with who you choose.
Messages automatically deleted. Nothing stored. Nothing left behind.
A chat that disappears when you're ready. A connection that doesn't.
THE FEATURE A CUSTOMER CALLED HER "CHECK I'M NOT DEAD" BUTTON
Before a bath. A walk after dark. Travelling alone. A medical appointment.
Set a countdown.
If everything's fine, cancel it in seconds.
If you can't, My SOS Family automatically alerts your trusted contacts with your location and message.
Because sometimes the emergency isn't that you forgot.
It's that you couldn't.
ONE TAP. HANDS-FREE. EVEN WITHOUT SIGNAL.
Works with Siri and Alexa — activate your alert without touching your phone.
Works from a landline — your contacts don't need a smartphone.
WHEN EVERYONE WANTS TO HELP
The first problem is letting your people know.
The second is stopping the confusion.
Who's calling?
Who's driving?
Who has your location?
Who's already with you?
My SOS Family helps your trusted people co-ordinate, so they can spend less time working things out and more time helping you.
WHO MY SOS FAMILY IS FOR
You don't fit one category. Neither does this app.
The parent whose adult child lives across the country and wonders if they're okay.
The adult child who looks at their parent and quietly worries.
The person who lives alone and loves it — but sometimes the silence is a little too complete.
The woman who walks home at night and sends "I'm leaving" — and the people waiting for "I'm home."
The lone worker who drives between sites and nobody checks in.
The older person who wants independence, not surveillance.
The traveller who wants family to know they're okay, wherever they are.
My SOS Family isn't for people who are afraid. It's for people who are prepared.
YOUR PRIVACY. ALWAYS.
You decide when your location is shared and who can see it.
Chat messages are automatically deleted. Nothing stored beyond what's needed. Nobody watching. Nobody tracking. You control who knows what — always.
NAYA
Naya is an optional AI companion for everyday conversation, available to users aged 18 and over. AI replies can be inaccurate. Naya does not provide medical advice or emergency assistance.
TRY FREE FOR 14 DAYS
Download My SOS Family. Add the people you trust. Test it — set the timer, press the button, see what your people receive.
14 days. 5 activations. No strangers. No call centres.
Just the people who know you.
Download My SOS Family.
Add the people you trust.
Send a test alert.
Hopefully you'll never need it.
But if you do, you'll be glad your people are ready.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.mysosfamily.com/privacy-policy/privacy-policy/

Ball's Adventures in Wonderland, where childhood's dreams are intertwined and touching any objects can completely ch
bluejetty:00145551:ios.description:
Join Blue Ball’s journeys into a joyful and colorful world that gets more and more curious as his fairy adventures unfold.
Ball's Adventures in Wonderland, where childhood's dreams are intertwined and touching any objects can completely change the way they look and play. The motionless grounds can start moving and playing beautiful music, a blue cloud can abruptly turn gray and start raining heavily, ball have fun with rainbow slides and can stretch into an extremely tall version of himself, or transform into something completely different.
In the course of their journey, Ball and his loyal pet will travel through a wide range of fantastical lands. You might be amazed by a whole lot of curious things that go beyond your imagination. What if a flower could talk and show you directions? Would you absolutely trust its instructions or you might be careful of thinking it could be a trick?
Hmmm, as a trusted friend of yours, here is a useful tip I sincerely share with you. !!!! Don’t awaken the sleeping monsters by any means!!!!!. Although they all look harmless when they are sleeping, when they’re awake, the consequences are unimaginable. 
Ball W: Roll to Miracle Island is a 2D physics bounce ball platformer for all ages with lots of wonder level ideas. The Ball makes his way through 200 exciting levels full of challenges and surprises to explore a new land - Wonderland. Control the ball to roll, jump and bounce and skillfully bring the bounce ball to the last destination. There are more and more surprising items and twists that make the ball adventure become more amazing.
Featured
- Ball Adventure Platformer
- Variety of puzzles in 200 platform levels
- Various monsters with ascending powers and skills
- Battles Blue Ball vs Many Epic Bosses in Wonderland
- Red Skin Ball + More than 30 disney skins
- Special skins to buff roller ball skills
- Vivid sound effects
- Awesome mechanics
- Beautiful game graphics
HOW TO PLAY:
+ Use right and left arrow keys to roll the blue ball
+ Use the up key to make the ball jump high, and jump on the monsters head to kill them
+ Defeat monsters to get more scores.
+ Collect all coins
+ Spend coins to buy additional skins/ power ups in the store.
Download Ball W: Roll to Miracle Island now to explore Wonderland with us.
About Subscriptions and Apple Website Subscriptions
1. Pricing & Billing Cycle
Enable “Subscription (Weekly)” within the game for $5.99 a week, which will be billed weekly (every 7 days). (Price may vary depending on your location.)
2. Subscription Content
Subscribers will be eligible for certain perks during the subscription period, including:
- All item rewarded in game is become free
- No interstitial ad any more
- Unlocked premium skins
3. Automatic Subscription Renewal
The App Store subscription is auto-renewed with payment confirmed via your iTunes Account. Users can manage the auto-renew manually through the iTunes/Apple ID Settings Manager. The subscription will auto-renew for the assigned billing period if the auto-renew feature is not turned off 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
4. User Agreement and Privacy Policy
User Agreement https://sites.google.com/view/mgif-studio/
Privacy Statement https://sites.google.com/view/mgif-studio/
5. Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’ and select the subscription for ‘Ball W - Red Wonder Island’ to cancel it.

bluejetty:00022917:ios.summary: Thai Calendar (2443 to 2643) app is a comprehensive tool for managing your schedule while staying connected to traditional Thai culture. It blends modern calendar features with key elements of Thai tradition, festivals, and Buddhist events,
bluejetty:00022917:ios.description:
Thai Calendar (2443 to 2643) app is a comprehensive tool for managing your schedule while staying connected to traditional Thai culture. It blends modern calendar features with key elements of Thai tradition, festivals, and Buddhist events, making it ideal for personal and professional use.
Dual Calendar System
* Displays both the Thai lunar calendar and the Gregorian calendar side by side.
* Includes Buddhist Era (BE) years alongside the Gregorian year for easy reference.
Thai Holidays & Festivals
* Highlights all major Thai public holidays and cultural festivals like Songkran and Loy Krathong.
Buddhist Observances
* Marks key Buddhist holy days (e.g., Makha Bucha, Visakha Bucha).
* Includes reminders for Buddhist holy days, encouraging mindfulness and spiritual connection.
Astrological Insights
* Lunar calendar integration shows waxing, waning, and full moon phases.
Customizable Reminders
* Allows users to set custom reminders for personal events, work tasks, or spiritual practices.
* Notifications for upcoming holidays and special days in Thai culture.
Multi-language Support
* Offers content in Thai and English, catering to both locals and international users.
Design & Usability
* User-friendly Interface: A clean, intuitive design with traditional Thai motifs.
* Color-Coded Events: Quickly identify public holidays, Buddhist days, and personal events through vibrant, color-coded highlights.
This app is not just a calendar; it's a gateway to experiencing and appreciating Thai culture every day.

bluejetty:00115569:ios.description:
Never lose your phone again!
If you've ever experienced the frustration of not being able to find your phone, Find Phone by Clap and Ring is here to help. This simple yet powerful app allows you to locate your lost phone with just a clap, while also offering anti-theft protection.
Find Phone by Clap and Ring is more than just a phone finder. It’s an essential tool that helps you easily locate your device, and keeps it safe from unauthorized access. With customizable settings, you can adjust the sensitivity of the clap detection and choose from a variety of alarm sounds.
---
MAIN FEATURE of Find Phone by Clap and Ring:
- Clap to Find My Phone
Locate your phone instantly with a simple clap. Open the app, clap your hands, and let AI technology find your device.
- Don’t Touch My Phone
When the Moving Alarm is enabled, an alert will sound if anyone attempts to move your phone from its current position.
- Intruder Alarm
Discover who’s been tampering with your phone. The app uses your phone’s camera to capture the intruder and protect your privacy.
- Battery Alarm
Get alerted if someone unplugs your phone while it’s charging.
- Charging Alarm
Receive an alert when your phone is fully charged.
---
Subscription Options:
- Weekly: $2.99
- Lifetime: $9.99
---
Important:
- Cancel Anytime: Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
- Transparent Billing: Subscriptions with a free trial will automatically convert to a paid subscription after the trial period.
---
How to Manage Subscriptions:
1. Open the Settings app.
2. Tap your name.
3. Tap Subscriptions.
4. Choose the subscription you want to manage.
---
Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/termofusefindphonering
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacypolicyfindphonering

bluejetty:00070642:ios.name: Navi - Cornell Essentials
bluejetty:00070642:ios.summary: Introducing Navi, your new campus companion designed for Cornell by fellow Cornellians. More than just a transit app, Navi delivers insider insights and real-time information you won’t find anywhere else; getting you from A to B, and helpin
bluejetty:00070642:ios.description:
Introducing Navi, your new campus companion designed for Cornell by fellow Cornellians. More than just a transit app, Navi delivers insider insights and real-time information you won’t find anywhere else; getting you from A to B, and helping you discover everything in between.
- Live Bus Tracking -
Wondering if your bus is running late or exactly where it is? Navi has you covered with live bus locations and delay updates, powered by the latest dynamic transit data from TCAT.
- Insider Campus Insights -
Navi goes beyond transit with exclusive Cornell-specific info. We have real-time updates on campus events, dining hall hours, and hidden hotspots to help you make the most of your day.
- Search Anywhere -
Find your way to any destination on or near campus. Navi integrates with Google Places for seamless route planning, including walking directions from the nearest bus stop.
- Your Favorites. Just For You -
Bookmark your go-to bus stops, dining spots, and campus locations for quick, one-tap access.
- Made by Cornell AppDev -
Cornell AppDev is an engineering project team at Cornell University dedicated to designing and developing mobile applications. We were founded in 2014 and have since released apps for Cornell and beyond, from Eatery and CourseGrab to newer apps like Resell and Score. Our goal is to produce apps that benefit the Cornell community and the local Ithaca area as well as promote open-source development with the community. We have a diverse team of software engineers and product designers that collaborate to create apps from an idea to a reality. Cornell AppDev also aims to foster innovation and learning through training courses, campus initiatives, and collaborative research and development. For more information, visit our website at www.cornellappdev.com and follow us on Instagram @cornellappdev.

bluejetty:00157595:ios.summary:
Make more informed food choices with Halal AI. Scan a barcode, search for a product or check the ingredients on a label. See what the available information supports, what is uncertain and what to verify next.
CHECK THE LABEL
Photograph up
bluejetty:00157595:ios.description:
Make more informed food choices with Halal AI. Scan a barcode, search for a product or check the ingredients on a label. See what the available information supports, what is uncertain and what to verify next.
CHECK THE LABEL
Photograph up to three parts of a label, review the extracted text and correct it before analysis. You can also type or paste ingredients. AI highlights potential concerns and explains uncertainty; it does not certify products.
EXPLORE THE EVIDENCE
Browse the offline E-code guide, review ingredient sources and see available allergen and nutrition information. Dietary preferences help you notice ingredients relevant to your choices.
BUILD YOUR OWN FOOD LIBRARY
Save results and favorites, add notes and compare products side by side. Keep your saved information and the additive guide available offline. Product search and AI require an internet connection.
FREE EVERYDAY TOOLS
Barcode lookup, search, the guide, saved results and comparison stay free. Each day includes five successful ingredient analyses and five photo-text extractions. An optional subscription increases each daily allowance to 100. Failed AI results do not use a successful-result credit. Usage and abuse limits apply.
YOU CONTROL AI SHARING
Photos and text are sent for AI processing only after your consent and when you request it. Review and edit the text before checking. Manage consent and delete your data in Settings.
Food formulations and source information can change. Check the packaging and contact the manufacturer or a qualified halal authority when evidence is incomplete. The app does not replace allergy advice or guarantee that a food is safe for you.
Subscription prices and renewal terms appear before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://is-it-halal-0kwa.pages.dev/p/is-it-halal/privacy

bluejetty:00118743:ios.description:
Use the Alberta Emergency Alert App to stay informed during emergencies.
The Alberta Emergency Alert App provides vital information about potentially life-threatening situations, such as wildfires, floods, and tornadoes. Alerts include details about the emergency’s location and the actions you should take to stay safe.
Emergencies can happen anywhere, anytime. It’s your responsibility to be prepared.
Key features of the Alberta Emergency Alert App:
• Alerts for life-threatening and emerging situations
• Alerts based on locations you're interested in
• "Follow Me" feature to get alerts near your current location, even when travelling outside Alberta
• View alert areas on a map
• Easily share alerts via social media, email, and text
• Detailed emergency descriptions, impacted areas, and safety instructions
• Simple setup and user-friendly interface
• Choose the types of alerts you want to receive
• Be Prepared content to help you get ready for emergencies before they happen
• Accessibility features for users of all abilities
• Multilingual, with the option to translate alerts into your device's default language

bluejetty:00168248:ios.description:
Introducing 6 Sense, an innovative AI-driven app that opens up a world of exploration right at your fingertips. Designed for nature enthusiasts, pet owners, and the perpetually curious, 6 Sense turns your smartphone into a powerful tool for understanding and interacting with the natural world around you.
**Key Features:**
1. **Plant Identification**: Capture a photo to quickly identify a wide range of plants, complete with detailed information and interesting facts.
2. **Object Identification**: Unravel the mysteries of everyday objects with a simple snapshot, learning about their history and usage.
3. **Insect Identification**: Become an insect expert by identifying different species and delving into their fascinating world.
4. **Rock Identification**: Geology has never been more accessible. Identify rocks and minerals and learn about their formation and significance.
5. **Animal Identification**: Encounter an animal in the wild? Identify it safely with 6 Sense and understand its behavior and habitat.
6. **Pet Translator**: Strengthen your bond with your pets by understanding their emotions and needs through our innovative pet translator.
7. **Bird Identification**: Bird enthusiasts can easily identify species, listen to bird calls, and learn about their migration patterns.
8. **Cat and Dog Breed Identification**: Discover the breeds of cats and dogs with precision, whether they are your own pets or ones you meet.
9. **Environmental Descriptive AI Model**: Enhance your environmental awareness with detailed, AI-generated descriptions of natural landscapes and scenes.
**Why Choose 6 Sense?**
- **Intuitive Design**: Easy to use for all ages and levels of tech-savviness.
- **Accurate and Fast Identification**: Leverage the power of advanced AI for quick and reliable identifications.
- **Educational Tool**: Expand your knowledge about the natural world in an engaging way.
- **Privacy-Focused**: We prioritize your data security and privacy.
6 Sense is more than an app; it's your gateway to understanding the environment, the creatures that inhabit it, and the pets that share our lives. Download 6 Sense today and unleash your inner explorer!
About Subscriptions
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
•You can cancel your subscription by entering the following address: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

bluejetty:00165309:ios.description:
Bring your memories to life with VivaShot, the AI-powered photo animation and enhancement app. Turn still images into moving moments, create videos or Live Photos from your pictures, and improve old or blurry photos with powerful AI tools. Whether you want to animate a cherished portrait, revive a faded family photo, or enhance image quality in one tap, VivaShot makes it simple.
【Key Features:】
- AI Photo Animation: Animate still photos and turn them into vivid moving memories in seconds.
- 20+ Motion Presets: Choose from more than 20 animation styles and movement presets to create the perfect effect for every photo.
- Video & Live Photo Creation: Convert photos into video or Live Photo format for easy saving and sharing on iPhone.
- Live Photo for iPhone Lock Screen: Set your animated Live Photo as your iPhone wallpaper and enjoy seeing it come to life with every touch.
- Bring Old Photos to Life: Make vintage portraits and treasured family pictures feel alive again with natural-looking motion.
- AI Enhancement: Improve clarity, restore detail, and boost overall quality with advanced AI.
- Sharpen Faces: Make faces clearer, sharper, and more defined.
- Light & Sharpness Adjustment: Fix dark, blurry, underexposed, or overexposed photos and reveal hidden detail.
- Portrait Recreation: Recreate heavily damaged portraits and restore meaningful memories.
- Photo Combination: Combine two people from different photos into one image to create new memories from old pictures.
- Anime Enhancement: Improve anime images with better sharpness, richer color, and more visual detail.
【Why VivaShot?】
- More Than Photo Editing: VivaShot helps you do more than enhance photos — it lets you animate them and turn them into living memories.
- Powerful Motion Variety: With 20+ presets, you can create different moods, styles, and movement effects for each image.
- Made for iPhone Users: Save animations as Live Photos and use them on your Lock Screen for a more personal and joyful everyday experience.
- Easy to Use: Designed for everyone, with a fast and intuitive experience from start to finish.
- Fast Results: Animate, enhance, and restore your photos in just a few taps.
- Natural-Looking Effects: Create motion that feels smooth, realistic, and emotionally engaging.
VivaShot is made for the moments that matter most. Animate old photos, revive meaningful portraits, and transform still images into videos or Live Photos you’ll want to see again and again. From photo enhancement to motion creation, VivaShot gives your pictures a new life with modern AI.
Download VivaShot and turn your photos into living memories.

bluejetty:00079371:ios.name: Move Well - Mobility Routines
bluejetty:00079371:ios.summary: MoveWell is designed to help you get stronger, recover from injuries faster and move better. Whether you're an everyday athlete, weekend warrior, confined to a cubicle, or just trying to recover from a common injury, MoveWell can help you b
bluejetty:00079371:ios.description:
MoveWell is designed to help you get stronger, recover from injuries faster and move better. Whether you're an everyday athlete, weekend warrior, confined to a cubicle, or just trying to recover from a common injury, MoveWell can help you break free from your pain and move more comfortably. 
MoveWell provides flexibility, mobility, and recovery routines that are 100% customized for YOU. Pick a routine based on the help that you need most. Prime your body to lift more weight, or work through back pain or an IT band injury with video exercises led by an experienced mobility coach. A timer will count you down through each movement so you spend the right amount of time on each exercise. 
====
OVERVIEW
• Use the MoveWell app to walk you through simple exercises that can help your body feel and move better.
• Pick a routine that focuses on an area YOU want to improve; strengthen your muscles, or rehab an injury–it's up to you!
• Never question what step is next - each routine is led by an experienced mobility coach who will demonstrate each movement.
• A timer will let you know when it's time to move on to the next movement. 
• Is there a routine you'd like to see? Let us know at hello@movewellapp.com!
• Brought to you by the team at IMPOSSIBLE®.
====
WHAT OTHERS ARE SAYING (5 STAR REVIEWS)
"As a Crossfit lover and a runner I find it hard to know just which mobility exercises are best for hitting the spot that hurts. This app is a great solution to that! Looking forward to more routines as they are added!" -missmajachere
"I just did the upper body primer and feel like I lifted so much more. Extra 8 pull-ups and an all around better workout." -Omeadm
"MoveWell is the app that I've been waiting for. Foam rolling & mobility work hurts so much, but I can FEEL the difference in my fitness when I'm doing the routines. So glad that this app makes it all so simple!" -ImpossibleX
"I'm a foam rolling newbie and I've been wanting to learn the correct way to do it, so this is really helpful. Thank you! Beautiful app and very useful. Love the videos." -jenny sansouci
====
MAIN FEATURES
• Choose specific exercises, or pick a full timed routine. Routines last between 5-15 minutes. 
• MoveWell leads you through simple exercises that help release tight muscles and improve flexibility, stability, and muscle strength. 
• Specific movements help you increase your flexibility and range of motion so you can protect yourself from injury in normal day-to-day activities.
• Recover more quickly from common injuries and pain. 
• Follow routines that help prevent you from getting injured in the future. 
• Stop suffering from back pain and other common ailments by following specific routines designed to get you back on your feet and on the go.
====
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What is Foam Rolling?
"Foam rolling" is a self-myofascial release technique (aka self-massage) that athletes use to help speed up the recovery of their muscles. By rolling the affected muscle over a foam roller, you help decrease lactic acid (which is what causes soreness), and break up knots so your muscles can get back to normal. Breaking up these tight spots can be painful, so if you have any questions you'll definitely want to consult with your physician or physical therapist. 
What is a Mobility Workout?
A mobility workout is a short routine designed to improve the functionality of the body. 
What Mobility Equipment Do I Need?
Some exercises require the use of a foam roller, hard ball, or band, to help release knots that are stuck in the muscle. 
====
FEEDBACK
Got feedback? If you enjoy the app, please leave a rating & review to help us help more people move well.
Help us make MoveWell even better! Send us an email at hello@movewellapp.com
Terms of Use: https://movewellapp.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://movewellapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00014399:ios.description:
Lookout for Work is only for employers who have enrolled in the Lookout Enterprise program. Install Lookout for Work on your corporate device to make sure your device stays compliant with your company's corporate policies. If a device is found to be out-of-compliance, you can easily contact your IT department to resolve the situation.
Lookout for Work includes call and message protection features. Call protection blocks incoming calls from numbers on your organization's block list, which is managed by your administrator. Message protection filters SMS, MMS, and RCS messages to detect phishing and fraud threats based on criteria defined by your administrator. bluejetty:00174943:ios.description:
Your privacy should be the default, not a feature. Aloha Browser gives you everything you need to browse privately, block ads and trackers, and download files — in one app, with nothing extra to install.
Hundreds of millions of users trust Aloha because it does what other browsers won't: it puts your privacy first by default, not as an afterthought.
BLOCK ADS AUTOMATICALLY
Ads slow you down and track you across the web. Aloha removes them before they load — every page is faster, cleaner, and distraction-free with no ads. No setup required.
BROWSE WITH A BUILT-IN FREE VPN
Protect your connection on any network with Aloha's integrated VPN. Choose from 80+ server locations worldwide, secured with 256-bit AES encryption and DNS leak protection. VPN traffic is compressed and encrypted to reduce bandwidth usage. One tap to activate — no separate app, no data caps for everyday use.
DOWNLOAD VIDEOS AND FILES
Save videos, music, and documents directly from any web page. Aloha's built-in downloader handles the formats other browsers can't. Play media in the background, manage files with ease, and lock sensitive downloads with biometric protection.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Aloha doesn't log your activity — ever. There's nothing to share because there's nothing stored. Combined with the VPN, automatic ad blocking, and TrafficMask, you get full-stack privacy that goes far beyond what incognito mode offers.
PRIVATE AI — NO SURVEILLANCE
Use AI to summarize, translate, and answer questions without your prompts being logged, profiled, or used to train models. Private by default.
BUILT FOR YOUR DAILY WEB
Tabbed browsing with a clean, fast interface. Sync bookmarks and tabs across devices linked to your Aloha account. Scan QR codes instantly. Explore Web3 domains and dApps with full native support. Everything works together, beautifully.
ALOHA PREMIUM
Upgrade for enhanced VPN country selection, device-wide VPN protection, VPN auto-start, Wi-Fi file sharing, ZIP compression support, and premium themes.
Aloha Premium is available at $7.99/month or $69.99/year (USD). Prices may vary by region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. Any unused free trial portion is forfeited upon purchase.
Privacy policy: https://alohabrowser.com/policy.html
Terms & Conditions: https://alohabrowser.com/terms.html
ABOUT ALOHA
We're a team dedicated to proving that privacy and a great browsing experience aren't mutually exclusive. While other browsers bolt on privacy features as add-ons, we built Aloha from the ground up to keep your data yours — verified by an independent third-party audit from Leviathan Security Group.
Discover more: https://alohabrowser.com
Facebook: https://facebook.com/alohavpnbrowser
X: https://x.com/alohabrowser
For feedback and support, please email support@alohabrowser.com

bluejetty:00187929:ios.description:
The Everyset app is free to download, and it is free to use.
Fast sign-up
Once added to a project by casting, quickly create your account right from your phone or tablet. 
Easily edit information
Whether your billing address has changed or you want to upload a photo of the vintage car you just bought, you can update your profile from anywhere to reflect what you want casting and accounting to know. 
Securely fill out paper
Instead of filling out stacks of paperwork on set, fill out your digital start work as soon as you have been added to a new project. You will arrive on set prepared, with the assurance that your personal information is with only the authorized crew members and not floating around the set.
Conveniently review timecards
When your workday is complete, receive your digital timecard to review directly on your phone or tablet. You can sign and approve it in-app, or dispute it if any corrections are needed. Once it is approved, your information will be securely sent to payroll.
Secure, reliable payment
Because Everyset has eliminated the piles of paperwork and manual processing that most productions deal with, we help you get paid for your work faster. Digital paperwork is securely sent to payroll companies once work is done, removing the risk of personal information floating around. If there is ever a problem with payment, Everyset’s support team is there to help.

Unlock the power of effective communication with SayItRight, the app designed to help you improve your English pronunciation skills effortlessly. Whether you are a beginner or looking to refine your speech, SayItRight offers a comprehensive set of features tailored to your needs.

 • Progress Tracking: Monitor your growth with our intuitive dashboard, displaying your performance stats over different time frames—daily, weekly, and monthly. Discover which days you are most active and set goals to stay on track.
 • Personalized Difficulty Levels: Adjust the sensitivity of speech recognition to match your skill level. With options for Easy, Medium, and Hard, SayItRight adapts to your learning pace, ensuring an optimal practice experience.
 • Audio Playback: Listen to your recordings after each session to evaluate your progress and identify areas for improvement. The app allows you to compare your pronunciation with the correct version effortlessly.
 • Share Your Achievements: Showcase your progress and achievements by sharing your stats with friends, motivating yourself and others on the journey to better pronunciation.
 • User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a sleek and intuitive design that makes practicing pronunciation engaging and straightforward.
With SayItRight, mastering English pronunciation is just a tap away. Join a community of learners and start your journey to confident speaking today!

bluejetty:00067970:ios.description:
Run, jump, and hide in this action packed platformer game! Can you get the high score? 
Take the role of a heroic cube who funrun through difficult geometry puzzles and blockjumps. In a world of black and white geometry shapes, jump free and run towards freedom.
Difficult but rewarding gameplay!
Sqube Darkness is a platformer geometry cube game with dangerous enemies and hard obstacles. Players use their reflexes to jump and run at the correct moments to escape from the attacks of the Eyes. 
Running games are quite popular, but Sqube Darkness doesn’t follow the geometry formula used by other kinds of freeballgames. There is a vast array of unique levels and you will never get tired of run and jump action. 
Different ways to play!
Players can use swipe or on-screen button controls to run and jump. This freerun game is truly free and all cubes can feel block jumping however they like. As a game with beautiful geometry shapes and geometry dashes, you will always feel sharp!
Increase your stats and skills!
Each temple running gives you stat points to develop your heroic cube character. Buy boosters and increase stats to run and jump better and faster. As a free run cube, you will always find something to improve with your geometry cube character. 
Challenge the world!
Set a high score and compare yourself against the other players in the world. Subway surfing might be good at this game, but you can prove to be better at run and jump action. Control your geometry cube perfectly to get into the top spots!
Features:
• Flexible gameplay with two different control methods: Buttons or swipe.
• Difficult but rewarding gameplay.
• It is safe to play and can be labeled as one of the ‘gamesforkids.’
• Beautiful visuals will make you feel like a cube in a geometry world.
• Run and jump better after each playthrough by increasing your skills and buying boosters.
• Completely free game experience.
• No internet required.
• Frequent updates to add new game modes and challenges.
• Fun for all ages: The best game for family & friends’ gatherings!
• Download this funny game for free.
• Great exercise for the brain.
• Simple and highly addictive game play.
• Play without the internet.
• Play offline.
 Have fun!

bluejetty:00178184:ios.description:
Field Service Ministry is a ministry-focused app for Jehovah’s Witnesses who want to stay organized. It helps you manage Bible studies, return visits, and monthly goals in one place.
Features:
- Track Ministry Activity: Record your ministry hours, return visits, and Bible studies with ease. View your monthly field service report anytime.
- Share Your Report: Send the updated 2023 field service report (S-4-E 11/23) directly via Email, WhatsApp, or SMS to your congregation.
- Manage Return Visits: Keep contact details organized and set reminders for Bible studies and return visits.
- Built-In Timer: Use the timer for accurate time tracking, or enter your ministry hours manually.
- Set and Monitor Goals: Define your goals and follow your progress throughout the month.

◆ Watch your garden evolve as you keep showing up for yourself.
◆ Refresh your tasks automatically every day.
◆ Minimalist and relaxing design.
◆ Gentle habit tracking experience.
◆ Focus timer and reminders.
◆ Home screen widgets.

◆ iCloud sync support.

taking care of yourself does not have to feel stressful.
Growth can be quiet.
Progress can be gentle.
And sometimes, simply showing up today is enough.
Little by little, your garden grows with you.

bluejetty:00182598:ios.description:
Meet new people, make new friends, or stay in touch with the friends you already have. Sociable brings live streams, video chat, social games, and shared moments together in one social app. Whether you want to watch, chat, play, or go live, Sociable makes it easy to build new friendships and enjoy your time online. When you are bored or feeling alone, it helps you discover people, entertainment, and shared interests.
What can you do on Sociable?
- Meet new people, make new friends, and stay in touch with the people you already know.
- Watch live streams or start your own. Discover creators, live conversations, live entertainment, and gaming streams, then share the moments you love. With Guest Mode, you can bring viewers on stage. With VS Mode (PK), you can join more dynamic live experiences.
- Start video chats and group conversations. Enjoy 1 on 1 video chats, talk more naturally with friends or new people, and spend time together in group chats with up to 8 people.
- Social games are a big part of Sociable. You can play 20+ games in one app without jumping between different apps. Enjoy Backgammon, Okey, Pool, Ludo, chess, card games, word games, quiz games, trivia, music and karaoke games, popular board games, Rummikub, and match 3 games. Games make conversations easier, help you have more fun with friends, and create a relaxed way to meet new people.
- Play together, compete, and earn rewards. Join tournaments, climb the leaderboards, and compete for prizes. If you enjoy trivia and quiz games, Sociable gives you more ways to have fun while staying social.
- Verified profiles help create a more trusted social space. Talking with real people can make it easier to start conversations, build new friendships, and enjoy more genuine interactions.
- There are more ways to stay social on Sociable. Share stories and reels, make video or voice calls, and use auto translate to talk more easily across languages. It is not just a place to chat. It is also a place to share moments, discover people, and enjoy your day a little more.
Sociable brings live streams, chat, video calls, social games, tournaments, trivia, and friendships together in one place. Meet new people, reconnect with friends, play together, and enjoy a more social, more fun, and less lonely way to spend time online.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If you choose to purchase Sociable Plus, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US, and are subject to change without notice. If you decide not to purchase Sociable Plus, you can simply continue using Sociable for free.

bluejetty:00040234:ios.description:
CBT Self-care Journal is designed to help you take better care of your emotional well-being with proven, easy to use, and self-guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and journaling techniques. 
With the CBT Self-Care app, you can:
- use CBT exercises to identify and reframe your negative thoughts 
- use Relaxation exercises and Mindfulness meditations to release tension and stress, reduce tension, sleep better
- use Positive Psychology exercises to improve your mood and self-esteem 
- track your mood on a daily basis and monitor your progress
- capture your thoughts and feelings in your journal
- master self-care skills that will help you become more emotionally resilient and feel better
The CBT self-care app features:
- 5 highly effective CBT exercises to choose from including A-B-C, Socratic Questioning, De-catastrophizing, Challenging Core Beliefs and Fact-checking
- 7 Positive Psychology articles to improve your mood, self-esteem 
- 20+ of short, well-written, informative articles on mental health and resilience
- Gratitude journal with hundreds of journal prompts
- Progress feature with a daily mood tracker
- Daily wellness check-in
- Share and delete your entries
- Set daily reminder for self-care check in
What is CBT?
CBT methods are widely used in therapy against depression, anxiety and other disorders to help identify troubling situations or conditions in your life, become aware of your thoughts, emotions and beliefs about these problems and identify and reshape your negative or inaccurate thinking. 
Is CBT effective?
The CBT technique used in this app is scientifically proven to be effective against mild to moderate forms of depression, anxiety, stress, PTSD, and Borderline Personality Disorder.
Privacy Policy: 
https://www.mind-matters.co/privacy-policy-mh
Terms of Service:
https://www.mind-matters.co/terms-of-use
Disclaimer: This self-care tool should not be used as a replacement for professional treatment or guidance. You should consult a medical professional if you are concerned that you may be experiencing mental health issues.

bluejetty:00014127:ios.description:
Reading time is fun time with the Booka app for kids aged zero to nine.
Your kids will adore the Booka app, which comes with a huge selection of children's books and narrated novels. With endless reading features such as Booka Reads and Read to Me, Booka is all about creating incredible experiences.
Booka fits perfectly into your kids' existing routines, including getting ready for school, story time, play time, and bedtime.
Raise your kids to love reading. Education and literacy can be a stimulating, stress-free part of your kids' lives. Booka has lots of exciting picture books in every genre, including fiction, non-fiction, poetry, nursery rhymes, animals, people, and countless other fascinating topics.
With its Read to Me and Booka Reads features, the app will select and read an engaging book for your child. Just choose the books you like, and Booka will do the rest.
BOOKA READS – SWIPE AND DISCOVER ENGAGING BOOKS
Your little one will never run out of options with Booka Reads, an automatically-generated feed of picture books based on children's interests.
Kids want to swipe and use phones like grownups do, and Booka can keep your youngster swiping and learning. They can learn about a wide range of subjects, improve their reading and listening comprehension, and broaden their horizons.
You can navigate to the books you like and skip the ones you don’t with a single swipe.
READ TO ME
The new Read to Me feature makes it easier than ever for kids to engage with their favorite books. Your kids' daily bedtime routine will come to life when Booka’s professional narrators read their bedtime stories out loud. Each story is read by professional voice actors and enhanced with gorgeous melodies and stimulating imagery.
100% MOBILE READING
Mobile reading has proven to be an incredibly effective learning tool, especially for children. Booka adapts picture books for your iPhone so you can view images and read text clearly. It features an efficient layout and smooth scrolling, and its interface adapts to various contexts to make your kids' experience even more enjoyable.
We all know that children have very short attention spans, but, thanks to Booka’s unique design, your little one will never get bored or distracted.
WHY CHOOSE BOOKA FOR YOUR CHILD?
1. Booka strives to make the time you spend with your family even more meaningful and joyful. And if you need a break, Booka Reads will make sure your little one is happy, occupied, and learning while you relax and take care of yourself.
2. The Booka Bedtime Collection will make bedtime easier and less stressful for you and your child. The soothing tales in this collection help lull your child to sleep.
3. Booka lets kids swipe like grownups through professionally narrated picture books instead of meaningless or addictive children's content. Thanks to its professionally designed interface, the experience is reminiscent of social media, mobile games, and movies.
WHY DO KIDS LOVE BOOKA?
1. It features a wide selection of engaging books on various subjects that are fun to read while still being informative, compelling, and educational.
2. Kids can enjoy their favorite stories on their own because Booka will read aloud to them whenever they want – even at bedtime.
3. Booka's well-designed layouts help children develop a healthy attitude toward literacy and enjoy reading. With Booka, your child will always want to read because reading time is fun time!
Think, read, and explore with Booka
Download the app now and watch your kids learn, grow, and evolve while having tons of fun!
** We provide free limited access to our catalogue. To gain full access, please subscribe to Booka’s monthly/yearly subscription package. **
Our Subscription includes:
- 7-day free trial period.
- Enable/disable automatic renewal.
- Payment with your linked iTunes account.
Privacy Policy https://appbooka.com/static/en/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use https://appbooka.com/static/en/terms-of-use/

As the largest Lake Ontario fishing forum, the site serves as a hub for fishing reports, discussions, tips, and resources focused on the diverse fisheries of Lake Ontario and its tributaries.
At the heart of LakeOntarioUnited.com is its active fishing forum, where members post up-to-date Lake Ontario fishing reports, share successful techniques, and discuss everything from salmon and trout fishing to bass, walleye, and musky. Anglers can find detailed information on the best Lake Ontario fishing spots, seasonal trends, and effective lures and tackle. The forum also features dedicated sections for fishing tournaments, event announcements, and classified ads for buying and selling fishing gear and boats.
LakeOntarioUnited.com is an essential resource for those planning a fishing trip to Lake Ontario. The site offers insights into Lake Ontario fishing charters, guides, and access points, as well as advice on boat setup and safety for both inshore and offshore fishing. Visitors can browse comprehensive guides on Lake Ontario fishing regulations, stocking updates, and conservation efforts, ensuring responsible and successful angling experiences.

The site’s event calendar highlights upcoming Lake Ontario fishing tournaments, derbies, and community gatherings, fostering a spirit of camaraderie among local and visiting anglers alike.

The platform’s robust search function and organized forums make it easy to find answers to specific questions, from the best trolling techniques to recommendations for fishing gear and electronics.

Join today to connect with fellow fishermen, stay informed on the latest Lake Ontario fishing reports, and make the most of your time on the water. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or a newcomer to Lake Ontario fishing, LakeOntarioUnited.com has the resources, support, and community you need for a successful and enjoyable fishing experience.

bluejetty:00089506:ios.description:
mySleepButton® is a CogSci Apps® invention. Its purpose is to help you fall asleep with the "cognitive shuffle", as featured in the The New York Times, The Guardian, Forbes Magazine, Canadian Government’s Institute of Health Research, The BC Medical Journal online, Popular Science Magazine, Forbes Magazine ("disrupt all patterns and rest in blissful chaos"), LifeHacker ("surprisingly effective"), etc.
It’s so easy: Just lie in bed, touch the “Put Me to Sleep” button, imagine the various descriptions it reads to you, and let yourself fall asleep… pleasantly. That is the Cognitive Shuffle! 
O, The Oprah magazine, calls mySleepButton “An easy little game to trick yourself to sleep.” The Guardian wrote: "My top recommendation remains the visualisation method known as the “cognitive shuffle”: download the MySleepButton app". Quartz says mySleepButton is “a drug-free sleep trick for your restless mind”. International Business Times of London says “mySleepButton App Hijacks Thoughts to Help Sleep”. 
Into mindfulness meditation? mySleepButton also contains a configurable "affective body scan" meditation pack. It taps into the brain's body maps. Still awake after the meditation? Instantly proceed to guided shuffled imagery. 
You can try mySleepButton for FREE! There's no subscription fee. Buy the pack(s) that you like, and shuffle your thoughts to sleep.
The goal of mySleepButton is to keep your mind off your concerns while putting it in an imagery rich state conducive to sleep.
mySleepButton can also be triggered with Air Pods and played on Apple's Home Pod (or other devices) if you don't want an iPhone or iPad in your bed room. It even has Siri shortcuts.
So, why not enjoy a dreamy transition to sleep? “Shuffle Your Thoughts to Sleep” with mySleepButton.

bluejetty:00121969:ios.name: Ruuvi Station
bluejetty:00121969:ios.summary:
Ruuvi Station is an easy-to-use application that allows you to monitor the measurement data of Ruuvi's sensors.
Ruuvi Station collects and visualises Ruuvi sensor data, such as temperature, relative air humidity, air pressure and movement
bluejetty:00121969:ios.description:
Ruuvi Station is an easy-to-use application that allows you to monitor the measurement data of Ruuvi's sensors.
Ruuvi Station collects and visualises Ruuvi sensor data, such as temperature, relative air humidity, air pressure and movement from local Bluetooth Ruuvi sensors and Ruuvi Cloud. Additionally, Ruuvi Station allows you to manage your Ruuvi devices, set alerts, change background photos, and visualise the gathered sensor information through graphs.
How does it work?
Ruuvi sensors send tiny messages over Bluetooth, which can then be picked up by nearby mobile phones or specialised Ruuvi Gateway routers. Ruuvi Station mobile app enables you to collect and visualise this data on your mobile device. Ruuvi Gateway, on the other hand, routes the data over the internet not only to the mobile application but also to the browser application.
Ruuvi Gateway routes the sensor measurement data directly to the Ruuvi Cloud cloud service, which enables you to build a complete remote monitoring solution including remote alerts, sensor sharing and history in Ruuvi Cloud – all available within the Ruuvi Station app! Ruuvi Cloud users can view longer measurement history by using the browser application.
Use our customisable Ruuvi mobile widgets alongside the Ruuvi Station app when data is fetched from Ruuvi Cloud to view selected sensor data at a glance.
Above features are available to you if you are a Ruuvi Gateway owner or have received a shared sensor to your free Ruuvi Cloud account.
To use the app, get Ruuvi sensors from our official website: ruuvi.com
Available in English, Finnish, Swedish, French, and German.

bluejetty:00052529:android.summary: Rediscover the timeless fun of crosswords with a modern touch! Crossword with Images combines the traditional crossword puzzle with engaging visuals, creating a relaxing and enjoyable experience for players of all ages. Each word is linked
bluejetty:00052529:android.description:
Rediscover the timeless fun of crosswords with a modern touch! Crossword with Images combines the traditional crossword puzzle with engaging visuals, creating a relaxing and enjoyable experience for players of all ages. Each word is linked to a unique image, making this game both fun and intuitive.
Why You'll Love Crossword with Images
Over 250 Exciting Levels: Challenge yourself with a wide range of puzzles, featuring 8 to 10 images per level.
Unique Word-Image Connection: Each word is represented by a carefully chosen image, adding a visual element to your puzzle-solving experience.
Multilingual Fun: Play in Spanish or English, making it accessible to a broad audience.
Family-Friendly Content: No inappropriate words or images—safe and suitable for players of all ages.
How to Play
Select the box where you'd like to start writing.
Check the image located to the left or above each row and column.
Click on the image to enlarge it for a closer look. Use it as your clue to solve the puzzle!
A Nostalgic Inspiration, Modernized
Crossword with Images draws its charm from the classic hobby books often sold in bookstores in countries like Venezuela and Colombia. These books were beloved for their creative and accessible puzzles, but they lacked a digital version—until now! This game reimagines those puzzles, blending nostalgia with innovation to bring you a fresh mobile experience.
Whether you're a lifelong crossword enthusiast or just looking for a new way to unwind, Crossword with Images is the perfect blend of creativity and relaxation. Download now and start solving!

bluejetty:00092821:ios.description:
The My GNP app puts the personalized, caring service of your local Good Neighbor Pharmacy close at hand on your mobile device. The newest version of the app is user-friendly and easily lets you find our closest Good Neighbor Pharmacy, refill your prescriptions, and tracks your Med Score. The My GNP mobile app also has the following capabilities:
• Find a pharmacy near your current location or by searching on city/state/zip 
• View a digital circular for monthly sales and specials
• Enter a prescription by typing it in
• View pharmacy hours and other store information 
• Request prescription refills for yourself or family members (no account required)
• View your daily med schedule in the Med Planner
• Schedule multiple medication start times and receive notification reminders
• Automatically notify a Med Buddy when medications are missed
• Track and view your Med Score
• Enter vitals, and immunizations manually
• Available in Spanish (Disponible en Español)
• Available in Korean

bluejetty:00163866:ios.summary:

Your intention-based wellness journey begins with KICApp. We move with you through life, supporting you from your morning
bluejetty:00163866:ios.description:
KIC unites movement, mindset and rituals to help you build confidence, find calm, and move through life, with purpose.
Your intention-based wellness journey begins with KICApp. We move with you through life, supporting you from your morning flow to your evening wind down. To us, wellness is a feeling, not an aesthetic. Strong minds are the foundation for strong bodies, and this strength starts with ourselves.
Is KIC for me?
Mindset practices for every mood: Find your calm with 100+ guided meditations, breath work, deep sleep resets, and value-based goal setting.
Build confidence with guidance: Follow 20+ expert-led PT-style programs for strength and running. We'll coach you from your first 5km to your first deadlift and beyond. Whether you prefer a hybrid approach or want a pregnancy-friendly program, we have you covered.
Move with intention at home: Choose from 1000+ guided fitness classes. With Pilates, strength, HIIT, yoga, and mobility workouts from 5-30 minutes, you can find a class that suits your mood.
Nourish your body and routine: Discover 1000+ dietitian-approved recipes. Filter by your dietary needs and find delicious, simple meals to fuel your energy.
From bump to baby: We support you through pregnancy and beyond with guided pre and postnatal Pilates, educational videos, and calming meditations.
Features you’ll love:
- Expert-led guided videos for fitness, yoga, Pilates, and meditation.
- New recipes dropped weekly.
- Regular community challenges to keep you motivated.
- Chrome cast support to play on your TV.
- Track your runs, walks, and rides with built-in mapping tools.
See why over 1 million people have downloaded the KICApp.
At home, in the gym, or on the go, KIC is made to move with you. Flexible subscription plans available. Cancel at any time.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
Get 7 days free when you choose a monthly, 3-monthly, or annual subscriptions. Free trial cannot be redeemed with sale offers. Your subscription grants access to KIC content on both the KICApp and website. Auto-renewal is optional, and you can manage it in your Apple ID settings. Any unused free trial period will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.
TERMS OF USE:
https://app.kicwellness.com/legal
