bluejetty:00124406:ios.summary: Agrani Bank PLC, a leading state-owned commercial bank in Bangladesh, is a recognized forerunner in providing digital banking services to its esteemed customers. Riding on its strength of 972+ online branches and 600 agent outlets, a large
bluejetty:00124406:ios.description:
Agrani Bank PLC, a leading state-owned commercial bank in Bangladesh, is a recognized forerunner in providing digital banking services to its esteemed customers. Riding on its strength of 972+ online branches and 600 agent outlets, a large customer base Agrani Bank is strategically positioned to add other digital banking services specially through app based internet banking services.
The Agrani Bank Mobile Banking Platform will offer a rich banking experience to discerning customers eager to use banking applications on their smartphones. This state-of-the-art banking application offers 24x7x365 availability.
On downloading the application, during installation the customers will submit their profile and account information through the app for verification by Agrani Bank. Agrani Bank will notify the customer once the customer profile and account is verified. The customer will then visit any branch to sign the necessary documents which will result into the activation of mobile banking account for the customers.
Some of its common features are:
* A/C Balance Check
* A/C Statement & Mini Statement
* Last 25 Transaction
* Agrani Smart App to MFS (bKash, Nagad)
* Deposit Money
* Fund Transfer
i) Agrani Smart App to Agrani Bank Account
ii) Agrani Smart App to Others Bank A/C (BEFTN)
* Agrani Smart Pay-
i) QR cash withdrawal & QR to QR Fund transfer 
* Mobile Recharge (GP, BL, ROBI, Airtel & Teletalk). 
* Beneficiary Management. 
* Exchange Rate
* Agrani Bank Branch Location & Number
* Interest Rate
* Transfer History
* Customer Profile
* Loan Calculator

Looking for your life partner within the Nepali community? Lahmee is the premier Nepali matrimonial app and a dating app designed to help you find meaningful connections with potential life partners, whether you're in Nepal or part of the global Nepali diaspora.
- Busy Nepali professional with no time for traditional matchmaking?
- Helping your son, daughter, or loved one find the perfect Nepali life partner?
- Feeling shy about creating a public profile for Nepali matrimonial connections?
- Ready to start fresh after a breakup or divorce in the Nepali community?
Why Choose Lahmee?
- Privacy First: Your profile is your private space. You control who sees your photos and profile information. Blur your photo for added privacy and only reveal it to those you're comfortable with.
- Cultural Matchmaking: Lahmee goes beyond appearances by focusing on cultural compatibility, shared values, and personal preferences for a long-lasting relationship.
- Advanced Filters & Matching: Looking for a partner from a specific caste, profession, or location? Lahmee's powerful search filters help you find someone who fits your exact criteria.
- Verified Profiles: We take security seriously. All profiles go through strict verification to ensure genuine, quality matches.
- In-App Chat: Start meaningful conversations directly with your matches using our secure in-app messaging system.
- Facilitator Service (Beta): For those who need additional support, Lahmee offers a personalized matchmaking service with dedicated facilitators to guide you through your journey to finding the perfect match.

- Nepali Matrimony Focus: Exclusively for Nepali singles worldwide.
- Commitment to Long-Term Relationships: Designed for those serious about finding a life partner using Nepali matrimony online.

- User-Friendly Design: Easy-to-use interface, making the matchmaking process seamless and stress-free.
Ready to Find Your Perfect Match?
Lahmee is more than just a dating app — it's your path to a culturally aligned, fulfilling marriage. Join the growing community of Nepali singles today and take the first step towards a life of love and happiness.
Lahmee Premium Subscription

- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00128323:ios.description:
Rev Up For Adventure – The Monster Truck Racing Games for Kids!
Get ready, young speedsters! The Wheel Cup Competition season is here, bringing exciting Monster Truck games for kids to life! Dive into a thrilling world of racing games designed specifically for children—filled with action-packed adventures, epic trucks, and endless fun.
Thrilling Racing Games for Kids – Stellar Graphics and Sound
Every level buzzes with excitement—gears spinning, engines roaring, and incredible adventures waiting around every corner! These games for kids take you through three enchanting maps: the bustling factory, mysterious mines, and sunny seaside towns.
Legendary Boss Battles – Next-Level Car Games
These aren't just ordinary truck games; they're legendary racing games! After mastering thrilling routes, face epic boss battles that elevate your racing skills and transform your experience. Prepare to race through unique challenges and test your skills against exciting bosses like the Monster Octopus and more!
12 Cool Monster Trucks – Racing for Kids Vehicles
Choose your favorite from 12 awesome monster trucks! These distinctive trucks make your racing games adventures even cooler. Earn shiny gold coins during your races to upgrade your vehicles—style your trucks and speed ahead in these thrilling car games!
Boosters Galore – The Edge in Truck Games
Enjoy powerful boosters designed for exciting racing games action. With enhanced AI and varied booster systems, these racing for kids experiences stay fresh every time!
Key Features:
• 3 exciting themed maps filled with thrilling racing games adventures for kids.
• Race and explore with 12 uniquely designed monster trucks.
• Challenging boss battles and captivating routes.
• Exciting boosters to enhance every racing games experience.
• Offline play—perfectly safe and uninterrupted games for kids.
• Bring home the excitement of monster truck racing for kids and make every adventure unforgettable!
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00042435:ios.name: Wellhero: Stress & Recovery
bluejetty:00042435:ios.summary:
Stress management and heart health app for better wellness, recovery, and training performance.
We monitor your vital parameters: HRV, Heart Rate, Resting Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen, Wrist Temperature, and Blood Pressure for comprehensive wel
bluejetty:00042435:ios.description:
Stress management and heart health app for better wellness, recovery, and training performance.
We monitor your vital parameters: HRV, Heart Rate, Resting Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen, Wrist Temperature, and Blood Pressure for comprehensive wellness insights.
We measure and analyze your Heart Rate (Pulse) and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) to provide insights into cardiovascular health, nervous system status, stress levels, recovery state, and readiness for training.
Wellhero also analyzes workout data to help you understand how physical activity impacts stress, recovery, and performance. Track training load, intensity, and recovery cost to optimize workouts and avoid overtraining.
Wellhero analyzes data automatically collected by the Apple Watch. By processing this data, we determine stress load on the body, resilience to pressure, and overnight recovery quality.
We also analyze (but do not measure) blood pressure (BP), explaining the significance of the numbers and calculating key cardiovascular metrics. The free version includes 6 blood pressure analysis metrics, with extended analytics available in premium features.
Features:
– Measure heart rate and HRV using your phone camera, Apple Watch, or Bluetooth heart rate monitor
– HRV-based stress level (Baevsky Index)
– Autonomic balance detection (Sympathetic or Parasympathetic activity)
– Recovery score based on Resting Heart Rate, HRV, sleep, and training load
– Workout analytics with strain and TRIMP tracking
– Training load modeling: Strain, ATL, CTL, Workload Ratio, and Training Stress Balance (TSB)
– Heart rate zones and workout intensity analysis
– Recovery impact calculated after every training session
– Science-based daily insights to reduce stress and improve performance
– 9 HRV metrics (RMSSD, SDNN, AMo50, PNNi50, Mean NNi, MxDMn, Mode, CV) with explanations
– 8 blood pressure metrics (Systolic, Diastolic, Heart Rate, MAP, Pulse Pressure, Vegetative Index, CEBC, RPP) with health impact descriptions
– AI-driven analysis of HRV, recovery, and blood pressure trends
– Symptoms and habits tracking linked to Pulse and HRV data
What you get:
– Control your stress levels and daily energy
– Train effectively while avoiding overtraining
– Understand how workouts affect recovery and readiness
– Evaluate how exercise, work, and lifestyle impact HRV and heart health
– Track recovery after physical and mental load
– Mark life events and monitor their effect on your nervous system
– Monitor long-term trends in HRV, Blood Pressure, and stress
– Discover insights about your body through personalized analytics
Integrations:
We use Apple Health data, including Apple Watch heart rate and HRV measurements. Access is requested only with your consent.
Terms of Use:
https://wellhero.co/terms/
Disclaimer:
Wellhero is a fitness and wellness app, not a medical application. It does not replace professional medical diagnosis or advice. Consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns.
Wellhero analyzes blood pressure data but does not measure it. A certified blood pressure monitor is required for measurements.

bluejetty:00073259:ios.name: MilGPS
bluejetty:00073259:ios.summary:
MilGPS is a field navigation tool designed for efficient use by trained navigators using MGRS coordinates. No in-app purchases or subscriptions.
OVERVIEW
- Display your current location and other info in large, clear text on customizable s
bluejetty:00073259:ios.description:
MilGPS is a field navigation tool designed for efficient use by trained navigators using MGRS coordinates. No in-app purchases or subscriptions.
OVERVIEW
- Display your current location and other info in large, clear text on customizable screens.
- Create waypoints using your current location, map crosshairs, distance/direction projection or optimized coordinate entry. Organize waypoints into overlays and navigate to them by following an arrow or on the map.
- Visualize your location and waypoints on a map with smooth scrolling grid lines/labels. Apple and Google online maps are included or supply your own offline maps in raster MBTiles format.
OTHER FEATURES
- Supports MGRS, USNG, UTM, Lat/Lon and OSNG location formats.
- Supports a wide variety of map datums including WGS84, NAD27, OSGB36, AGD66 and ED50.
- Use 3 different datums/location formats for location display and waypoint entry.
- Supports a wide variety of angle, altitude, and distance formats.
- Cell phone signal not required for basic navigation functionality. Online maps require a data connection.
- Supports military date time groups for local/zulu time
- Import and export waypoints via the standard GPX file format. Limited support for KML and CSV formats. Routes and tracks not supported.
- Map ruler tool to measure distance/direction between two points on the map, snaps to waypoints
NOT INCLUDED (YET)
- Route planning
- Track recording
- Online mapping sources other than Apple and Google maps
- Vector offline maps
QUESTIONS
support@milgps.com
NOTES
- WiFi-only iPads are not supported because they don't have a GPS receiver.
- Mapping function requires a data connection. 
- Using GPS will shorten battery life.
- Online maps are provided, hosted and updated by third parties. Maps may be inaccurate or censored. Map types and quality may change without notice.
PRIVACY
Because you can choose to use Google maps in the app, we are required to disclose the data collected by Google in our App Store listing. If you do not use Google maps minimal data is collected. See our privacy policy for details.
WARNING
YOUR USE OF MILGPS IS AT YOUR OWN RISK
MilGPS is an aid to navigation only and is intended to be used in conjunction with other navigation methods and tools.
MilGPS must not be used where relying on MilGPS could result in death, injury or financial loss. This includes use on military operations, live-firing activities, aviation and surveying use.
MilGPS is not tested to military specifications and is not endorsed by the military of any nation. MilGPS is not a substitute for military issue equipment.
Your use of MilGPS is governed by the standard App Store Licensed Application End User License Agreement.

Our app connects to YouTube in real time and lets you play any video with total freedom.
Enjoy YouTube like never before!
No ads, no subscriptions, and exclusive features designed just for you.
- SPECIAL FEATURES
• Floating Playback (PIP): use other apps while watching your videos.
• Locked Screen Mode: keep listening to your video with the screen turned off.
• Sleep Timer: set an automatic shutdown and fall asleep without worries.
• Repeat Mode: play your favorite video on an endless loop.
• History: rewatch what you’ve already enjoyed and delete videos by swiping left.
FyTube is perfect for those who don’t want to miss a single video about their favorite topics.
Explore, play, and enjoy your favorite content to the fullest — interruption-free!
- FLOATING PLAYBACK
1. Enter full-screen mode and tap the PIP button (second icon at the top left).
2. The video will shrink into a floating window inside FyTube.
3. Swipe up from the bottom to exit the FyTube app — the video will remain visible.
4. Floating mode is now active! You can use any app, and your video will keep playing over the screen.
- LOCKED SCREEN PLAYBACK
1. Activate Floating Mode.
2. With the video floating over your apps, lock the screen.
3. Done! The audio will keep playing in the background.
Perfect for listening to music, podcasts, or your favorite tunes while driving or relaxing.

Fall asleep peacefully — your app will stop by itself!
Enable this feature to automatically stop your videos after the time you choose. Perfect for sleeping or napping without worrying about stopping anything.
How to activate it?
Tap the timer button, choose how long you want it to run, and that’s it.
Relax and let the app handle the rest!
- REPEAT MODE
Play your video nonstop.
Activate this feature to loop the same video infinitely. Tap the button again to turn it off.
Perfect for songs, meditations, or any content you love to repeat!
- HISTORY (new)
Rewatch what you’ve already enjoyed.
Access the History icon at the top left of the search screen.
You can search by title or date and delete any video by swiping left.

• No account required
• We don’t store cache, cookies, or personal data without your permission — watch safely
• Interface available in 29 languages

bluejetty:00062358:ios.summary:

You can check your understandi
bluejetty:00062358:ios.description:
LadderTouch is an app to learn the basics of ladder logic, which is a graphical programming language.
This app has three functions.
You can learn about that mechanism by executing some of the prepared samples.
You can check your understanding with questions.
In addition, you can create and execute your own ladder.
Ladder functions of the timer, counter, and logical inverse are provided.
The user interface is designed to be easy to operate. The lines are written by tracing the screen. You can set an element by tapping a cell at which you want to add it. 
---------------ELEMENTS---------------
Input(yellow)
Up to 5 elements.
You can control the input signal by tapping the buttons at the bottom of the display.
Virtual output(red)
Up to 5 elements.
Internal memory(gray)
Up to 20 elements.
Virtual output(red) and internal memory(gray) are the same for logical behavior.
But the difference is in usage. 
The virtual output is the last element in the ladder logic chain.
The Internal memory is for the processing element of the ladder logic chain.
These are an imitation of the actual ladder logic with the output devices.
Timer(blue)
Up to 5 elements.
The timer can be set from 0.1 seconds to 10.0 seconds. The setting unit is 0.1 second.
The timer works only 'on delay'. This app does not include 'off delay'.
On Delay.
 ---++++++++++ source
 -------++++++ destination
Off Delay.
 +++---------- source
 ++++++++----- destination
+ ON
- OFF
Time flows from left to right
Counter(green)
Up to 5 elements.
You can set from 1 to 50.
There is no counter reset element in this app. Many other ladder logic software has it.
The way to reset the counter is to stop running the ladder.
All elements can be inverse in the source area.
However, timers and counters cannot do it in the destination area.
It is difficult to understand the inverse logic of a timer and counter in the destination area.
---------------EDIT---------------
You can edit ladders only with the paid version.
How to write elements or lines
Select the pencil icon.
To add an element: Tap where you want to set the element and select the element.
To draw a line: Draw where you want to write a line.
How to delete elements or lines
Select the eraser icon.
Tap where you want to delete the element.
How to scroll
Select the scroll icon, then you can scroll.
How to remove useless spaces
Select the order icon.
Tap order icon to remove useless spaces.
Line color
Green with complete ladder logic.
Red with something wrong.
--------------Other--------------
There is no function that connects to outer devices.

GoaMiles Taxi service enhances Goa travel for tourists and locals. Offering professional drivers, it ensures a seamless journey with top-notch technology making it the best taxi service available in Goa. Enjoy secure, comfortable rides for work or leisure. 
Vehicle classes: Hatchback (AC), Sedan (AC), SUV/MUV (spacious)
Features:
•	Airport Transfers: Easy app-based rides from Goa's airport to your destination
•	Fast Booking: Simple pickup, drop locations, and vehicle selection for quick confirmations
•	Cashless Transactions: Pay via credit card, debit card, mobile wallet, or UPI within the app
•	24/7 Customer Service: Reach out for support anytime
•	Track Your Ride: Real-time location tracking
•	Emergency Button: A panic button for safety
•	Share Ride Details: Share your journey info with loved ones for added security
•	Access invoice history in the app.
Booking a taxi:
•	Set Locations: Choose pickup and drop spots
•	Payment: Explore fares and payment options
•	Confirm Your Ride: Select a vehicle type and confirm
•	Provide OTP to driver and track your ride. 
GoaMiles App also offers activities booking for Water Sports, Heritage Walks, and Spice Farm visits in Goa, making your stay more enjoyable.
Visit us on: https://www.goamiles.com/
Links to social media 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/goamilesofficial/ 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/goamilesofficial

bluejetty:00062254:ios.description:
Welcome to GEMS Connect, your One-Stop App for Smarter School Management
GEMS Connect puts everything you need to manage your child’s education at your fingertips, with a cleaner, faster, and more intuitive experience. The redesigned interface focuses on speed and simplicity, making it easier than ever to complete essential tasks in just a few taps.
You can explore GEMS Education schools based on curriculum and location, view personalized student information for each child, and access academic records, health details, fee payments, and school services all in one place. A new simplified navigation structure organizes everything under three main sections: School, Transport, and Services, helping you find what you need quickly and easily.
With real-time notifications and alerts, you'll stay updated on your child’s whereabouts, school activities, and important reminders. Managing transport preferences, topping up catering balances, ordering books, and communicating with the school are all just a few clicks away.
The improved GEMS Genie, our built-in AI assistant, now offers even smarter support to help answer your questions and guide you through school processes more effectively.
GEMS Connect brings your child’s entire school experience into one easy-to-use app, designed with parents in mind.

bluejetty:00028080:android.description:
A Timeless Fantasy Unfolds ASTRA: Knights of Veda
Explore a new storyline and venture into new, expanded regions.
■ Ultimate Action Combat at Your Fingertips
ASTRA: Knights of Veda brings back the beloved action
of the side-scroll era in a modern, tactical format.
Harness an array of skills from the Knights of Veda and
unleash the Power of the Stars to strategically defeat monsters.
It's bold and thrilling action at its finest!
■ Fantasy World Brought to Life through Stunning Artwork
ASTRA: Knights of Veda offers a unique artistic experience with
its dark, mesmerizing visuals. Every element, from the smallest prop
to the most imposing boss, is crafted with care to immerse
you in a richly detailed fantasy world.
■ Knights of Veda Stand with you in Battle
Each Knight of Veda brings their own unique
skills and weapons to the battlefield.
Choose a team that matches your playstyle
and take on difficult dungeons.
■ Experience an Action-Packed RPG on Mobile
From Veda's Nightmare, teeming with powerful enemies and bosses,
to Sealed Prison, where wicked prisoners are sealed,
Battlefield of the War Gods, where your 5 Knights of Veda can fight in 5:5 auto battles,
and the Arena where your chosen knights compete against others on the impactful battlefields!
Dive into dynamic waves of action.
■ Immerse Yourself in a Deep and Vibrant Narrative
Dive into a richly woven narrative with expansive cutscenes
that bring an epic journey to life.
The Goddess Veda is ready to guide you on your way.

bluejetty:00072981:ios.summary: Motocross MX : Bike Race Game is a multiplayer racing game with a variety of custom motorbikes and dozens of tracks. Race against other players around the world and earn great in-game rewards. Get ready for an insane bike riding experience
bluejetty:00072981:ios.description:
Motocross MX : Bike Race Game is a multiplayer racing game with a variety of custom motorbikes and dozens of tracks. Race against other players around the world and earn great in-game rewards. Get ready for an insane bike riding experience that tests your bike racing skills and makes you want to play more. It's time to show the world who's the ultimate bike race champion!
CHALLENGE MODE
- Test your bike racing skills and push your limits in electrifying challenge mode
- Race through a series of tracks with its own unique twists and turns
- Perform gravity-defying bike stunts and race against clock to defeat moto racing rivals
PvP MISSILE MODE
- Engage in intense PvP bike race battles and become an ultimate race master
- Equip your bike with powerful missiles and boosts as you progress in bike game
- Launch powerful missiles to outmaneuvre your opponents
- Get ready for a fusion of excitement and xtreme racing adventure!
MULTIPLAYER MODE
- Show off your bike racing skills and race against players from around the world
- Beat the opponents on dozens of new tracks and rise through the ranks
- Get the fastest bike in the race game and dominate the leaderboards
Rush to Fortune: In-Game Rewards
In rush to fortune in-game rewards, take a chance to test your luck. Uncover cards to reveal exciting prizes including new race bikes, dirt bikes, coins, gems, missiles, boosts and much more. Collect your loot prize and make exit whenever you see fit but be cautious of the dreaded bomb card – one wrong flip, and you'll lose all your hard-earned rewards!
Rush to Crush : Motorcycle Game Features
- Single and Multiplayer modes
- 25+ unique bikes in the garage that can be customized
- Upgradable rider’s health and armour
- Dozens of stunning & challenging bike games levels
- Smooth and responsive bike simulator controls
- Amazing racing games physics & bike racing experience
- Featured events to earn epic rewards
- Fresh content with new racing bikes and new levels
- Compete with friends and perform insane bike stunts
- Completely offline gameplay; race whenever and wherever you want
Privacy Policy:
https://dreamlandgames.co/ios-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00134933:ios.description:
Are you looking for merge games, puzzle games, free games, girls games? 
Then "Merge Witches" will surely be a great target for you!
There was a peaceful and mysterious sky city, where the cute witches lived a calm life. However, one day, the evil monsters discovered the sky city. The monsters destroyed their home and calm life, and took their honor away. Since then, dark smog cast a shadow on the sky city. 
There are legends which say that you, our players, who are the most brainly and brave masters, will hold sway the witches to merge brainly, match brainly, solve puzzles brainly, design home brainly, defeat the monsters with merge magic, and use merge magic to bring the honor back and build a calm life in the sky city. 
To complete the target, firstly, you need to collect more cute creatures to help you get more power to disperse the dark smog and design home in this merge puzzle game! The baby witches like to sleep and can not even do so many jobs, so you need to solve merge puzzles to collect, hatch and merge witches to make them stronger and they won’t sleep very long and will help you get better rewards. 
In addition to the cute creatures, there are even also many kinds of objects that can be used with merge magic, like mobile flowers, mobile trees, mobile grass, mobile shrubs, even mobile buildings, etc. Each time the object is merged, the object will be upgraded and better. When a target object is merged many times, it will become like a brilliant fantasy. As the objects are all mobile, you can use your merge magic to collect and discover more and better of them and move them to anywhere to reach your target - design home and build a calm life in this merge puzzle game.
There are also many cute animals. Complete the orders from the target cute animals and you will get special rewards.
Explore the level maps full of puzzles. Drag, merge, and match in the level maps to solve merge puzzles and bring rewards back to your city!
When puzzle game meets merge magic, do you have the confidence to challenge and become one of the best masters and legends? 
Are you ready to enjoy Merge Witches? Discover and collect more cute creatures, discover and collect more beautiful objects, merge and match to solve puzzles, design home, and build a calm life. It's time to rise to the challenge and enjoy the most addictive merge magic!
Merge Witches Features:
● Use merge magic to create all things
● 200+ creatures can be merged, hatched, collected
● 300+ super fun puzzle levels can be beat to win rewards
● 400+ fantastic objects can be merged

bluejetty:00132157:ios.name: Remote for Tesla
bluejetty:00132157:ios.summary:
Add Apple Watch & Siri/Shortcut support to your Tesla vehicle
- Very reliable Siri & Shortcuts support that works even if the car is asleep. Control and get your car stats on the watch or phone without opening the app. You can combine/sched
bluejetty:00132157:ios.description:
Add Apple Watch & Siri/Shortcut support to your Tesla vehicle
- Very reliable Siri & Shortcuts support that works even if the car is asleep. Control and get your car stats on the watch or phone without opening the app. You can combine/schedule/automate commands based on triggers/conditions such as when you're driving, if your charging cable isn't plugged in, when you're sleeping, when you're about to go to work, when you're connected to certain Bluetooth or WiFi connections, when you tap a NFC tag, when your alarm goes off, or a certain time each day. Add Shortcuts as icons on your home screen or widgets for quick access to your car's stats or to control it.
- Fully functional Apple Watch app with vehicle stats complications
- Opens, connects, and issues commands faster than other Tesla apps
- Queued commands. You can close the app after issuing a few commands even if your car is asleep and it'll still do them.
- View your battery stats such as the current/total usable kWh of your car compared to the stated capacity, how much phantom drain your car currently has, and a history of your car's range vs its odometer/time.
- Display battery/power usage even when not charging
- No phantom drain or background usage. This app doesn't use your car's batteries when the app isn't in use.
- See the total miles/kWh added from the last charge session
- Estimated range is displayed (this estimates your battery range based on your past 30 miles of usage)
- Consolidated stats and commands into one screen for quicker access to information. View all three ranges (estimated, rated, ideal/typical, odometer) at the same time and up to the nearest 1/100th mi/km
- See and copy the raw vehicle data returned by Tesla's API servers
- Hold the app icon for quick commands from the Home Screen
- Use HomeLink or Summon your car when not near it and without continuous press needed (autopilot required). Activate keyless start prior to Summon to avoid needing a keyfob nearby.
- Avoid idle fees from Tesla by setting an in-app alarm that alerts you when charging reaches a certain kW or % level
- Camp/Dog Mode allows you to keep the HVAC on in the car even though there is no activity. Normally, the car will turn off HVAC after 30 minutes.
- View how many range miles are being used per hour
- Use the remotes:// URL schema with parameters to issues commands
- Max cool and Max heat buttons to quickly send multiple commands to your car to optimize cooling and heating
- No-Commands Mode lets you log in the app for your family/friends to monitor your Tesla's location without allowing them to control to your car
- Breadcrumb tracking allows you to see the path that the car has recently taken
- Trip statistics shows your current MPGe, kWh used, miles traveled, kWh per 100 miles, cost savings vs. a gas car, cost savings over the car's lifetime, and many more fun stats
- Save trip routes to different save slots and compare the distance, kWh used, cost, and more for each route
- In-app browser can detect commands from javascript so that you can create scheduled, queued or repeated commands
- Change passenger and driver temperature separately
Privacy/Security notice: This app only communicates directly to Tesla's servers when sending login credentials and commands. No identifying information is stored by our company.
Disclaimer: This software and documentation do not come from nor is endorsed by Tesla Inc. Use this app at your own risk. The author does not guarantee its proper functioning. Commands may not work on newer vehicles. Some features require certain vehicle options to work (e.g. HomeLink/Summon require the autopilot options enabled). This app attempts to use the same interface used by the official Tesla apps. However, you are responsible for any changes to your car caused by using this app. Use of this app can move or change settings to your car and we are not liable for any damages to you, your car or any other object in conjunction with the use of this app.

bluejetty:00183828:ios.name: Swiss Bankers
bluejetty:00183828:ios.summary: The Swiss Bankers App lets you adjust your Swiss Bankers Mastercard Prepaid Card to your needs. You can keep track of your expenses, card loads, cash withdrawals, and current card credit balance at any time and be notified after each transa
bluejetty:00183828:ios.description:
The Swiss Bankers App lets you adjust your Swiss Bankers Mastercard Prepaid Card to your needs. You can keep track of your expenses, card loads, cash withdrawals, and current card credit balance at any time and be notified after each transaction via the app or by SMS.
With the Swiss Bankers Send Service you can send money abroad safely with low fees. You can send money directly from the app to various countries with different receiving options, such as to a Swiss Bankers Mastercard, to a Mastercard, to a foreign bank account, to a Digital Wallet or have the sending amount paid out at a pay-out location.
BENEFITS
Customize easily your Card Settings:
• Completely and immediately block the card in case of loss
• Block the card for online purchases or contactless payments
• Block countries in which you do not wish to use your card
• You can cancel all these blockages at any time by yourself.
Full control over your expenses:
• Check your remaining card balance and transactions in real time. Simply and safely view all details regarding your card account.
Fully transparent transactions:
• The Swiss Bankers app lets you take pictures of your purchases and sales receipts and store them. In this way, you will not only know where you used your Swiss Bankers Mastercard Prepaid but also for what purpose.
Notification when the card has been used:
• You may choose to have a Push Notification sent to you for each transaction on your Swiss Bankers Mastercard Prepaid account. Or you may subscribe to the SMS Service so as to be notified even without an Internet connection.
The Mastercard SecureCode / Identity Check for more security:
• Makes your online payments even faster and more secure.
Mobile payments with your smartphone and smartwatch:
• Activate mobile payments in the Swiss Bankers app using Apple Pay, Samsung Pay or a payment method offered by another provider.
Change your PIN code:
• Did you forget your PIN code? No problem, with the Swiss Bankers app you can set a new code without knowing the current one.
The app can be downloaded free of charge and is available in German, French, Italian, and English.

What happens after that is up to both of you.

No forced connection. Your pace, your choice.

bluejetty:00154683:ios.description:
Meet Ray — your AI personal trainer. Voice-guided strength training that listens, adapts, and remembers what works for you. All the benefits of a personal trainer for a fraction of the price.
No more staring at your phone between sets. No more guessing what to do at the gym. Just show up, and Ray handles the rest.
TRAINING THAT FITS YOUR LIFE
Real trainers are effective because they know you — your schedule, your injuries, your goals. But at $100-200/hour, most people can't afford that.
Ray brings that same personalized experience to your phone. Tell Ray your shoulder's bothering you, and your workout adjusts instantly. Running late? Ray will build a shorter session. Traveling with no equipment? Ray creates a bodyweight workout on the spot.
This isn't a workout library. It's a coach that pays attention.
WHAT MAKES RAY DIFFERENT
◆ TALK. RAY LISTENS.
Talk to Ray during your workout. Say "my shoulder hurts" — Ray adjusts the workout instantly. Say "I'm tired" — Ray scales the intensity. No menus. No settings. Just conversation.
◆ VOICE-GUIDED WORKOUTS
Ray coaches you through every rep with clear audio cues. Your phone stays in your pocket — not in your face.
◆ LEARNS AND REMEMBERS
The more you train with Ray, the better Ray gets at knowing what works for you. Your preferences, your progress, your patterns — Ray remembers it all.
◆ COUNTS REPS HANDS-FREE
Ray counts reps for you on supported exercises — so you can focus on form, not math.
◆ KEEPS YOU ACCOUNTABLE
Ray checks in before your workout to make sure you're showing up. Miss a session? Ray helps you reschedule and get back on track.
WORKOUTS FOR EVERY GOAL
- Strength Training & Muscle Building
- Weight Loss & Fat Burning
- HIIT & Conditioning
- Bodyweight & Core
- Mobility & Flexibility
- Gym or At-Home — dumbbells, barbells, machines, bodyweight
BUILT FOR REAL LIVES
Ray integrates with Apple Watch and Apple Health to track your workouts and sync your progress automatically. Your training data stays connected — even when you work out outside the app.
Whether you're returning to lifting after years off or building your first routine, Ray meets you where you are. Real schedules. Real bodies. Real progress.
Stop planning. Start training.
Download Ray and get your first workout today — free.

Meet Ray — your AI personal trainer. Voice-guided strength training that listens, adapts, and remembers what works for you. All the benefits of a personal trainer for a fraction of the price.

No more staring at your phone between sets. No more guessing what to do at the gym. Just show up, and Ray handles the rest.

TRAINING THAT FITS YOUR LIFE

Real trainers are effective because they know you — your schedule, your injuries, your goals. But at $100-200/hour, most people can't afford that.

Ray brings that same personalized experience to your phone. Tell Ray your shoulder's bothering you, and your workout adjusts instantly. Running late? Ray will build a shorter session. Traveling with no equipment? Ray creates a bodyweight workout on the spot.

This isn't a workout library. It's a coach that pays attention.

WHAT MAKES RAY DIFFERENT

◆ TALK. RAY LISTENS.
Talk to Ray during your workout. Say "my shoulder hurts" — Ray adjusts the workout instantly. Say "I'm tired" — Ray scales the intensity. No menus. No settings. Just conversation.

◆ VOICE-GUIDED WORKOUTS
Ray coaches you through every rep with clear audio cues. Your phone stays in your pocket — not in your face.

◆ LEARNS AND REMEMBERS
The more you train with Ray, the better Ray gets at knowing what works for you. Your preferences, your progress, your patterns — Ray remembers it all.

◆ COUNTS REPS HANDS-FREE
Ray counts reps for you on supported exercises — so you can focus on form, not math.

◆ KEEPS YOU ACCOUNTABLE
Ray checks in before your workout to make sure you're showing up. Miss a session? Ray helps you reschedule and get back on track.

WORKOUTS FOR EVERY GOAL
- Strength Training & Muscle Building
- Weight Loss & Fat Burning
- HIIT & Conditioning
- Bodyweight & Core
- Mobility & Flexibility
- Gym or At-Home — dumbbells, barbells, machines, bodyweight

BUILT FOR REAL LIVES

Ray integrates with Apple Watch and Apple Health to track your workouts and sync your progress automatically. Your training data stays connected — even when you work out outside the app.

Whether you're returning to lifting after years off or building your first routine, Ray meets you where you are. Real schedules. Real bodies. Real progress.

Stop planning. Start training.

Download Ray and get your first workout today — free.

Terms of Use: https://www.rayfit.com/terms-service/

As you can create Twitter lists of verified Twitter accounts or someone else's Twitter friends, also you can hide who you follow on Twitter via making a Twitter list of them. Even further, you may create lists of inactive, fake Twitter accounts to remove. 
TWITTER FRIENDS TOOL
- Twitter Audience Insight
- Twitter Followers Tracker
- Find Inactive Twitter Accounts
- Fake Twitter Account Tracker
- Twitter Bot Checker
- Twitter Followers by Language
- Unfollower Tracker (Twitter Follow Track)
- Find Who Doesn’t Follow Back
Use Circleboom Twitter Tracker to check Twitter followers and detect inactive or fake Twitter accounts without having any difficulty at all! 
Has your follower/following ratio got spoiled? Do you have the question, “Who unfollowed me on Twitter?” With the Twitter Unfollower Tracker feature, easily find out your unfollowers on Twitter! You won't need to get worried about who doesn’t follow you back!
TWITTER USER ANALYTICS TOOL
- Twitter Interest Targeting
- Best Time to Post (Best Time to Tweet)
- Tweet Stats
- Twitter Account Analysis
- Twitter follower Growth
- Twitter Followers Analysis
- Twitter Followers Statistics
- Friends & Followers Gender Demographics
- Friends & Followers Language Statistics
Get in-depth analytics about your Twitter followers, friends, and tweets in one place!
TWEET DELETE TOOL (TWEET CLEANER)
- Delete All Tweets
- Delete Tweets by Date
- Delete Tweets by Keyword
- Delete Old Tweets
- Delete Twitter Archive
- Delete Twitter Likes
- Unlike All Likes
- Delete Retweets 
- Delete All Retweets
- Delete Twitter Replies
Further, you can also sort your tweets by retweet or Twitter like counts they got. Hence, it becomes possible to keep your top ones while you can erase tweets that you want to get rid of in one go!
Everything is possible with Circleboom Twitter Tracker!

Circleboom Twitter Tracker analyses all your Twitter followers' activities and renders it an interactive graph. It's easy to find your best times to post on Twitter to skyrocket your tweet engagement!
Acquire detailed Twitter analytics graphs of Twitter followers. Profound insights of your Twitter followers will ease your work in establishing your voice on Twitter.
Tweet statistics allow you to understand your tweet statistics over time better. All information is presented in sophisticated tweet analytics graphs, allowing you to see how your tweets are redistributed over time!
Get a clear vision for your future Twitter marketing campaigns! If you got an international Twitter audience, knowing the languages of your Twitter followers will help you plan your tweets.

bluejetty:00043707:ios.description:
YRIS allows you to create your digital identity in 5 minutes directly on your smartphone. Easily access hundreds of online services, linked to FranceConnect or directly integrating the solution. 
HOW DOES IT WORK?
1 — Enter your mobile phone number. Then set up your personal code to secure your account. 
2 — Confirm your identity by scanning your identity document, and take a photo of your face. We are now sure it is you. 
3 — Connect easily to all partner services by typing your personal code on your mobile for each connection request 
4 — Now, you have a digital identity that coomplies with European security norms. 
YRIS IS EASY
Validate your identity remotely, easily and quickly: with YRIS, the identity verification is done directly on your phone with your identity document and a selfie. 
• No physical meeting needed 
• Compatible with all European and biometric (NFC ready) identity documents 
• Hybrid verification (automatic and human) in 5 minutes 
• A digital identity compliant with substantial level 
YRIS IS HANDY
Prove your identity and prevent usurpation. Sign-in with our partners with you’re a unique security code. Connect with your login details from wherever you are and access your digital identity from a computer or smartphone. 
YRIS IS SECURE
• An identity controlled and verified with a double check (automatic and human) to be able to detect any fraud attempt. 
• A simple et robust authentication method certified by ANSSI (CSPN) with 2 factors (smartphone + code) 
• Compliant with EIDAS and GDPR: our solution meets a wide range of requirements to guarantee a high level of security. 
• Compliant with PVID (ANSSI): our remote identification process has a substantial level of security as defined by ANSSI. 
• Easily and remotely revoke access to this app to avoid having your identity usurped. 
• All data linked to your YRIS digital identity is stored in France (Rennes) in our own data centers.

bluejetty:00044174:ios.description:
The WDAV Public Radio App allows you to listen to WDAV’s classical programming live. Explore On Demand content, learn more about our featured programs, and wake up to WDAV with our alarm clock feature!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off.
• See composer, artist and title information for what is currently playing on air.
• Play WDAV in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails.
• Listen to WDAV while traveling. Start the app and push play. Your classical companion is with you wherever you go.
On Demand
• Read about featured programs and listen to audio of local programming, performance chats and more. 
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease.
Additional features
• Easily tweet, post to Facebook or send us a message via the share buttons.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The WDAV Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at WDAV and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.

No complicated setup. No hours spent editing. Just hit re
bluejetty:00015852:ios.description:
Turn your iPad into a whiteboard that records whatever you draw and write. Annotate, sketch, and talk, and Vittle captures it all as a video you fully own and can share with anyone.
No complicated setup. No hours spent editing. Just hit record and explain, then instantly share.
CREATE A VIDEO, JUST BY WRITING AND SPEAKING
Get your point across, clearly and exactly, every time.
Vittle works like a magic whiteboard that records what you write and say:
 - Annotate images, PDFs, and slides with the ultra-smooth ink of our proprietary Inkflow Engine,
 - Add shapes, arrows, connectors, and text, then align and style them in a tap,
 - Resize and move anything around the page,
 - Zoom in to focus on key points,
 - Put yourself in the picture with the presenter camera,
 - Describe even complex topics in a clear and engaging way.
FLIP YOUR CLASSROOM WITH ENGAGING VIDEO SCREENCASTS
Use Vittle to build a video library on any subject. It is also a powerful tool for collaborating across time and space with any number of people.
Vittle is a powerful tool for flipping your classroom. Turn your lessons into a reusable video library that students can watch and learn from on their own, then use valuable class time to focus on individual coaching.
Or let your students use Vittle to record their thought process as they work through problems. Let them explain everything to each other in short clips to help focus attention and raise engagement.
YOUR VIDEOS, YOUR WAY. NO INTERNET CONNECTION NEEDED.
Vittle produces video files that you own and control. Share them on YouTube, Vimeo, social media, or anywhere else. You can also email videos directly, or securely post them to your company server. No account or third-party service is needed, and everything works offline.
FREE TO START
Vittle is free to download and use. The free edition includes:
 - Up to 3 projects, with up to 3 pages each,
 - Up to 5 minutes of recording per project,
 - Basic shapes, the presenter camera, and the full set of drawing tools.
Videos made with the free edition include a small "Made with Vittle" watermark.
UPGRADE TO VITTLE PRO
When you are ready for more, upgrade to Vittle Pro in the app:
 - Unlimited projects and pages,
 - Unlimited recording length - hours and hours if you like,
 - No watermark on your videos,
 - The full library of shapes, arrows, and symbols,
 - Photo backgrounds for the presenter camera.
Choose the plan that suits you:
 - Monthly or Yearly subscription, with a free trial for new subscribers,
 - Lifetime: pay once and keep Vittle Pro forever, no subscription.
Schools and organizations that buy through Apple School Manager or Apple Business Manager can get Vittle Pro as a separate app for volume purchase.
THE FUTURE OF CREATIVITY
We strongly believe that the iPad is a powerful creativity device. Vittle is a new kind of tool that's designed specifically with the iPad in mind. We can't wait to see what you'll do with it!
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Vittle Pro subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.qrayon.com/home/privacy/

Dive into the untamed wilderness and embark on a thrilling journey with "Wild Deer Hunt: Open World Gangster Animal"! Prepare yourself for an adrenaline-fueled adventure where you'll experience the thrill of the hunt and the danger of the wild in an expansive open-world environment.
In this action-packed game, you'll step into the shoes of a skilled hunter tasked with exploring a vast and immersive open world teeming with diverse wildlife. From majestic deer and fierce wolves to cunning bears and elusive rabbits, the wilderness is alive with creatures both beautiful and deadly. It's up to you to track, hunt, and survive in this dynamic ecosystem where every decision counts.
But the wild is not the only danger you'll face. Gangs of ruthless gangsters and poachers roam the landscape, seeking to exploit the natural resources for their own gain. As you navigate the open world, you'll encounter these dangerous adversaries and must use all of your wits and skills to outmaneuver and outgun them.

Whether you're stalking prey through dense forests, engaging in epic battles with rival gangs, or simply marveling at the beauty of nature, there's always something new to discover in this immersive world.

Explore a massive open world filled with diverse environments and wildlife.
Hunt a wide variety of animals, each with their own behaviors and challenges.
Engage in intense battles with rival gangs and poachers as you fight to protect the wilderness.
Upgrade your weapons, gear, and skills to become the ultimate hunter.
Immerse yourself in stunning graphics and realistic sound effects that bring the wild to life.
Experience dynamic weather and day-night cycles that impact gameplay and immersion.
Complete a variety of challenging missions and side quests to earn rewards and unlock new content.
Customize your character and equipment to suit your playstyle and preferences.
Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer modes for even more excitement and adventure.
Are you ready to embark on the hunt of a lifetime? Download "Wild Deer Hunt: Open World Gangster Animal" now and experience the ultimate open-world hunting adventure!

bluejetty:00177487:ios.summary:
The unofficial Tesla Gen 3 and Universal Wall Connector app, the only app to help you monitor your Wall connector.
Wall Monitor is the only app to connect to and monitor your Gen 3 and Universal Tesla Wall Connector, see real time reading
bluejetty:00177487:ios.description:
The unofficial Tesla Gen 3 and Universal Wall Connector app, the only app to help you monitor your Wall connector.
Wall Monitor is the only app to connect to and monitor your Gen 3 and Universal Tesla Wall Connector, see real time readings, temperatures, lifetime statics and more.
Quickly see the temperature of your Wall Connector and handle while charging, get firmware update and weak Wi-Fi alerts and more.
Private & Secure:
This app does not need access to your Tesla account to function.
See what Tesla won't show you:
Wall Monitor surfaces all available data from your Wall Connector, to help you see what your Wall Connector is doing.
Any Electric Car:
Monitor charing for any electric car that uses your Wall Connector, not just Teslas!
Error Codes:
Don't just guess what those flashing lights mean, Wall Monitor will give you an error code and detailed description of all errors.
Export:
Export Wall Connector data in JSON or CSV formats.
Unlimited Wall Connectors:
Add an unlimited about of Wall Connectors to the app (when not in load sharing mode)
Firmware Tracker & Alerts:
See Wall Monitors firmware tracker and get alerted to new versions and updates.
Diagnose connections issues:
Get Wi-Fi Reports and see when your Wall Connector has weak Wi-Fi,
Estimated Cost:
Wall Monitor will estimate how much your current charging session will cost and your lifetime changing cost!
Note:
Some features require a one-time in-app purchase to use.
This app only works with Tesla's Gen 3 Wall Connector or Universal Wall Connector running the latest firmware, and while connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

bluejetty:00116046:ios.description:
Horizon Walker is a turn-based RPG with a unique storyline and captivating graphics. 
Join forces with stunning characters from beyond the dimensions and fight against the gods.
[Story Overview]
Mankind’s thriving civilization was brought to a halt by the sudden appearance of dimensional “Rifts.”
From these Rifts, divine beings emerged, ruthlessly destroying and pillaging civilizations. Mankind called them the "Forsaken Gods."
Despite resistance, mankind could not find a way to counter the barriers created by these "Forsaken Gods" and the Oblivia phenomenon, which turned humans into abominations.
Fear and despair engulfed the world, and hope vanished.
As mankind hopelessly awaited its destruction, a miraculous rumor spread—someone had killed an Abandoned God and stolen their power.
People honored him as the Human God and offered their devotion.
This is the tale of a remarkable Human God born in the East Asian Federation.
[Key Features]
▶ Unique and Distinctive Characters
Join forces with stunning characters from beyond the dimensions and fight against the Forsaken Gods.
▶ Tactical Real-Time Strategy System
Dominate time and space as both the commander of the battlefield and a Human God to save humanity!
▶ Special Events with Diverse Charms
Experience various stories created with different characters as you grow and gain experience together!
▶ Gripping and Unique Worldview and Storyline
Experience a dark world where you, as a Human God, save humanity from its fate.
Minimum Device Requirements: iOS 16 or higher, iPhone 13 Pro or later, 6GB RAM
Recommended Device Specs: iOS 16 or higher, iPhone 15 Pro or later, 8GB RAM

bluejetty:00122770:ios.description:
My Kind of Bank
My Kind of Bank is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Bill Discovery: The app will automatically identify bills within your list of transactions and display a reminder to you when upcoming bills are due.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact FNB Henning customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking by using advanced encryption technology. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access. This setting can be turned on or off in the preferences of the app.

bluejetty:00127141:ios.description:
pCloud Pass is the secure password manager for your passwords and personal data. Log in to websites with a single tap and use the password generator to make your passwords more secure. Protect more than just passwords! Save your credit card details and use secure notes to write down document IDs, bank account numbers, pin codes and more.
FEATURES:
◆ Store unlimited passwords, credit card details or encrypted notes
◆ Autofill passwords and instantly log in to the apps and websites you use every day
◆ Instantly fill payment forms with your credit card details
◆ Share passwords and other items securely
◆ Generate strong & unique passwords
◆ Easily unlock using Touch ID or Face ID
◆ Access your passwords and personal data across all your devices, anywhere you go
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
pCloud Pass was built with your privacy in mind. With our zero-knowledge privacy approach, the data you save is encrypted and only you can decrypt it with your Master Password. We do not have access to your data and we do not use, share or sell it to anyone.
ENHANCED ENCRYPTION
pCloud Pass uses client-side encryption to secure your data. Everything you save gets encrypted on your device, before it's uploaded to our servers. We use 256 AES encryption, PBKDF2 key strengthening and more to ensure your passwords and personal data are protected from all kinds of attacks.
TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
Over 16 million people worldwide have chosen pCloud as their service provider. Let pCloud Pass become your go-to Mac and iPhone password manager.

bluejetty:00027176:ios.description:
Disc Golf is a fast, battery-efficient scorecard, GPS rangefinder, and disc tracking app built so you can focus on your round. Track scores, measure distances, manage courses, review stats, and use Apple Watch support right from the course.
1. GPS Rangefinder for Disc Golf – Get fast distance readings to the basket with efficient GPS designed for all-day play.
2. Apple Maps & Google Maps Support – Switch map providers for better satellite views, course layouts, and rangefinder accuracy.
3. Wind-Aware Shot Planning – View wind information in the rangefinder to help plan smarter throws.
4. Disc Distance Tracking – Record throws, track disc distances, and build a better understanding of every disc in your bag.
5. Disc Recommendations – Use your saved disc distance data to help choose the right disc for the shot.
6. Driving Range / Disc Calibration – Find an open field, throw multiple discs, and record each distance to calibrate your bag.
7. Advanced Score Entry – Track score, putts, fairway hits, wind, and other round details with a fast scoring flow.
8. Colorful Digital Scorecard – Birdies, pars, bogeys, and double bogeys are clearly marked with colors and shapes.
9. Powerful Round Statistics – Review charts and trends for scoring, putting, fairway accuracy, and overall performance.
10. Search 15,000+ Courses – Find courses by GPS location, name, city, or state.
11. Create and Edit Courses – Build your own course and customize GPS points, tees, holes, and course details.
12. Smart Hole Auto-Advance – Automatically move to the next hole in both GPS rangefinder and score entry views.
13. Apple Watch Support – Check GPS yardage, use rangefinder features, and enter scores from your wrist.
14. HealthKit Step Support – Add walking step counts to saved rounds when HealthKit data is available and permission is granted.
15. Lightweight and Battery Efficient – Built to stay fast, smooth, and efficient through full rounds.
…and much more for you to explore.
Terms of the in-app purchases:

Payment for in-app upgrades will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the original subscription amount. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. Privacy Policy and Terms of Service are located at: http://www.infotalkcorporation.com/privacypolicy.html.

1. GPS Rangefinder for Disc Golf – Get fast distance readings to the basket with efficient GPS designed for all-day play.

2. Apple Maps & Google Maps Support – Switch map providers for better satellite views, course layouts, and rangefinder accuracy.

3. Wind-Aware Shot Planning – View wind information in the rangefinder to help plan smarter throws.

4. Disc Distance Tracking – Record throws, track disc distances, and build a better understanding of every disc in your bag.

5. Disc Recommendations – Use your saved disc distance data to help choose the right disc for the shot.

6. Driving Range / Disc Calibration – Find an open field, throw multiple discs, and record each distance to calibrate your bag.

7. Advanced Score Entry – Track score, putts, fairway hits, wind, and other round details with a fast scoring flow.

8. Colorful Digital Scorecard – Birdies, pars, bogeys, and double bogeys are clearly marked with colors and shapes.

9. Powerful Round Statistics – Review charts and trends for scoring, putting, fairway accuracy, and overall performance.

10. Search 15,000+ Courses – Find courses by GPS location, name, city, or state.

11. Create and Edit Courses – Build your own course and customize GPS points, tees, holes, and course details.

12. Smart Hole Auto-Advance – Automatically move to the next hole in both GPS rangefinder and score entry views.

13. Apple Watch Support – Check GPS yardage, use rangefinder features, and enter scores from your wrist.

14. HealthKit Step Support – Add walking step counts to saved rounds when HealthKit data is available and permission is granted.

15. Lightweight and Battery Efficient – Built to stay fast, smooth, and efficient through full rounds.

…and much more for you to explore.

Welcome to 1800Flowers! Discover the fastest and easiest way to send last-minute flowers, plants, gift baskets, and more with just a few taps using the 1-800-Flowers.com app! 
Trust us, we know flowers and personalized gifts. Our same-day flower and gift delivery service options make it simple to show friends and family you care, no matter the occasion or distance. From anniversary gifts to fall bouquets, you can ensure your personalized and thoughtful gesture arrives on time. 
1800 FLOWERS FEATURES
FLOWERS FOR EVERY OCCASION:
* Autumn gifts
* Anniversary 
* Graduation 
* Sympathy 
* Funerals
* Get-well soon
* Prom
* Congratulations
* Housewarming
* New baby
* Just because
* And many more!
FLOWER ARRANGEMENTS BY SEASON:
* Uncommon Flowers: Explore a selection of exotic blooms, from romantic anemones to elegant peonies. 
* Seasonal Flowers: Gift or baskets with blooming Summer arrangements, sunflowers, and our 2025 Flower of the Year, the vibrant ranunculus! 
* Shop by Events or Holidays: Flower arrangements can be found for every season of life. 
SAME-DAY DELIVERY FOR GIFTS AND FLOWERS:
Personalized gifts and flowers needed today? Same-day delivery is just a click away! 
* Treat Someone Last Minute: Anniversary bouquets, birthday gifts, fall gifts, & low-maintenance plants that are sure to bring a smile to any face. 
* Fresh Florals: Same-day delivery allows for fresh gifts that leave a lasting impression, even when life gets busy.
ONE-STOP SHOP FOR FLOWERS AND PERSONALIZED GIFTS:
* Personalized Gifts and Flowers: Shop for everyday moments, autumn gifts, special occasions, holidays, or an anniversary. 
* Add A Contact: Upload a contact from your phone to find flowers and gifts available in their area. 
* Flower Shop with A Photo: Find matching gift options when you snap a photo of a flower or Fall plant that you love...wherever you find it! 
* Gift Reminders: Set reminders so you never forget to purchase flowers or a gift for special moments, birthdays, weddings, and anniversaries! 
FIND MORE WAYS TO SHOP FOR FLORALS AND GIFTS:
* Flower Subscriptions: Subscribe to monthly flower deliveries for any occasion with our Flower Subscription Service. 
* 1-800-Flowers Marketplace: Discover personalized gifts from emerging sellers for that extra special touch. 
* International Delivery: Our international flower delivery service ensures worldwide coverage. 
Unlock exclusive benefits with our Celebrations Passport program. Enjoy FREE shipping and no service charge on flowers and gifts from our Family of Brands available to deliver as soon as today, all year-round. 
Every flower delivery comes with our 100% smile guarantee. Our dedicated and award-winning service team is here to assist you and welcomes your feedback. 
Join the conversation and share your stories with #MadeMeSmile on social media!

bluejetty:00114183:ios.description:
Welcome to TreeWorld – your ultimate digital potted plant companion and a realistic tree-raising simulation game designed for relaxation and casual enjoyment.
Escape the hustle and bustle of daily life and immerse yourself in the peaceful world of virtual gardening. As a dedicated plant parent, you’ll take care of your saplings from the very beginning: water them regularly to keep them hydrated, apply fertilizer to boost their growth, and watch them transform from tiny shoots into lush, mature trees – just like real-life planting, but without the hassle of soil or weather constraints.
Key Features
Realistic Plant Growth Simulation: Experience the authentic process of tree development with dynamic growth stages. Each tree has its own unique growth rhythm, making every nurturing journey one-of-a-kind.
Casual & Stress-Relieving Gameplay: No time limits, no competitive pressure. Tend to your digital plants at your own pace – perfect for a quick break during work, a relaxing moment before bed, or a way to pass the time on your commute. Let the gentle act of watering and fertilizing wash away your stress.
Digital Potted Plant Collection: Unlock a variety of tree species to grow and collect, creating your own personalized virtual forest. Each tree brings a unique visual style and a new sense of accomplishment.
Your plants will wait for you, and you can resume your nurturing journey whenever you want.
Pure & Distraction-Free Experience: We prioritize your relaxation with no forced advertisements or disruptive content. A safe and family-friendly game suitable for players of all ages.
TreeWorld is more than just a game – it’s a pocket-sized sanctuary for your mind. Cultivate patience, enjoy the simple pleasures of growth, and find your inner peace with every tap.
Download TreeWorld today and start your peaceful virtual gardening journey!
If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us via the in-app feedback feature. We are committed to continuously improving your TreeWorld experience.

You are a flawed but fascinating character in Jail Break: Barry Survival. Unlike others seeking freedom, you aren't innocent—you're guilty of the crime that landed him behind bars. Yet, your determination to escape burns brighter than ever, driven by a personal mission beyond the prison walls.
- Background
A former thief with a sharp mind and a troubled past, you regret the choices that led you to jail. However, life in confinement has only fueled your resolve to make things right. You are not escaping to evade justice—you're escaping to protect someone you love or recover something you lost.
- Skills and Traits
Street-Smart Strategist: You know how to read people and situations, using your cunning to outwit guards and find the best escape routes.
Fearless Risk-Taker: Guilt has made you courageous. You will tackle any challenge, no matter the danger.
Will your guilt push you to redemption or lead to your downfall? The answer unfolds in Jail Break: Barry Survival!

bluejetty:00098485:ios.description:
Welcome to Connect Master – Match Puzzle, a vibrant visual logic puzzle game where observation, focus, and strategy come together.
- Your goal is simple yet clever:
Find the hidden connections between expressive, cute characters and group them into perfect sets of four.
Look closely — each group shares a secret visual trait.
It might be hair color, glasses, outfit style, facial expression, or even the overall vibe.
Swap tiles, study patterns, and rearrange the board until every group is correctly matched.
The gameplay is intuitive, relaxing, and deeply satisfying, making it easy to start playing while offering meaningful mental challenge.
- How to Play
Tap character cards and swap them to form complete rows of four
Each row must contain four cards sharing one visual trait
Use the Hint button to reveal two connected cards when you’re stuck
Just pure puzzle solving
- Features
Addictive visual match puzzle gameplay
Hundreds of unique characters with expressive, charming designs
1000+ handcrafted levels
Special story puzzle levels to explore
Global leaderboards to compete with other players
Smooth swipe controls and polished animations
Clever visual traits that reward sharp observation
- New Content
New levels are added regularly, keeping the experience fresh and engaging.
Easy to learn, yet challenging to master.
- Perfect For
Players who enjoy:
Match puzzles and logic games
Brain training and visual challenges
Relaxing puzzle games with no stress
Clean, aesthetic game design
Casual games with depth
Whether you play for a few minutes or a full hour, Connect Master – Match Puzzle offers the perfect balance between relaxation and mental engagement.
Are you ready to master the art of visual matching? Download now and start connecting.

bluejetty:00131417:ios.description:
Upward. The dating app built for modern courtship, where shared values, clear intentions, and real effort can lead to marriage.
Join a values-first community of singles who know what they want and aren’t afraid to say it.
If you’re over casual dating and ready for a relationship with real direction, you belong here. Upward brings together values-driven singles who are ready to build something lasting.
Our mission is simple: Bring back courtship and conviction. A way of dating where people lead with their values, show genuine interest, and follow through.
Because love is worth courting.
Whether you lead with faith, family, loyalty, integrity, or simply a clear sense of what matters most, Upward helps you meet someone who wants the same kind of future.
Modern courtship, made clear
Create your dating profile and share what matters most to you from day one.
Choose your Core Values so potential matches can see what shapes your life, your relationships, and the future you want to build.
Add your Marriage Timeline to be clear about your goals and meet people moving toward the same kind of future.
Turn on Chivalry Mode for a more intentional way to connect. Men take the lead by making the first move. Women choose what happens next. Both show up with clear intention.
Meet singles who are dating with intention and looking for a lasting relationship that can lead to marriage.
Swipe right to like someone or left to pass.
Make a mutual connection and chat with like-minded singles near you for FREE!
Marriage is the goal
Find someone who shares your values, matches your effort, and wants to build a life together.
Download Upward today and find the one who’s Wanted for Life.
Go Premium and you can also:
• Send 5 Super Likes per week to stand out from the crowd and let people know that you're really interested 
• Rewind on people to give them a second chance
• Boost your profile each month to be one of the top profiles in your area for 30 minutes
• Send unlimited likes to other singles who share your values and relationship goals
• Enjoy an uninterrupted experience with no ads!
Become Elite and you can:
• Get all of the Premium benefits PLUS 
• Remove the mystery and See Who's Liked You for instant matches!
Check us out every day — we're growing fast and there's someone new to connect with every day, making it easier to find values-based relationships built on what truly matters.
Here we grow! Share Upward with your family and friends.
Privacy Policy: https://www.upward-app.com/en/privacy-policy Terms & Conditions: https://www.upward-app.com/en/terms-of-use
All photos are of models and used for illustrative purposes only.

bluejetty:00174872:ios.name: Network Analyzer Pro: IP Tools
bluejetty:00174872:ios.summary: Network Analyzer Pro is a complete network toolkit that turns your iPhone or iPad into a powerful diagnostic instrument. Whether you are troubleshooting a slow connection, tracking down unknown devices, or exploring how the internet routes
bluejetty:00174872:ios.description:
Network Analyzer Pro is a complete network toolkit that turns your iPhone or iPad into a powerful diagnostic instrument. Whether you are troubleshooting a slow connection, tracking down unknown devices, or exploring how the internet routes your traffic, it puts professional-grade tools right in your pocket - no desktop or extra hardware required.
Discover every device on your LAN, watch your traceroute unfold on a world map, measure your real download and upload speeds, work out any subnet with the IP calculator, and diagnose any host with ping, traceroute, port scanning, DNS lookup, and whois. From home users to IT professionals, Network Analyzer Pro delivers everything you need in one polished app.
LAN scanner:
- Fast and reliable detection of all devices on Wi-Fi, VPN, and personal hotspot networks
- IP addresses, MAC addresses, and vendors of all discovered devices
- NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour), LLMNR, DNS, SNMP, and WS-Discovery names
- Reachability (ping) test, IPv6 availability, and IPv6 addresses
- Custom device names and vendors, scan history, and favorites
- Quick actions: open the web interface, browse Bonjour and UPnP services, or wake the device
- Wake on LAN (WOL) including remote WOL
- Scan of custom IP ranges, filtering, and search in the device list
Ping & traceroute:
- Round-trip delay, IP address, and hostname for every node
- Selectable ICMP, UDP, and TCP ping and ICMP/UDP traceroute probes
- Configurable probe delay, payload size, TCP port, and don't-fragment flag
- Audible ping
- Geolocation (latitude, longitude, country, city, time zone), AS number, and network name
- Complete traceroute visualization on the map
- Real-time graphical ping statistics
Port scanner:
- Scan common ports, custom ranges, or the complete port range
- Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports
- Descriptions of known port services
- Editable common port list and adjustable scan rate
Whois:
- Look up domains, IP addresses, and AS numbers
- Classic whois and the modern RDAP protocol, with custom servers
DNS lookup:
- Functionality similar to nslookup or dig
- Query all record types at once or a single type
- A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, HINFO, LOC, MX, NAPTR, NS, PTR, SOA, SPF, SRV, SSHFP, and TXT records
- DNSSEC records: DNSKEY, CDNSKEY, RRSIG, NSEC3PARAM, NSEC, NSEC3, DS, CDS, TLSA
- Custom DNS server and port, no-recursion option, all response sections
Internet speed:
- Download, upload, and server latency measurement
- Graphical speed test view
- History with full results including graphs, custom names, and notes
IP calculator:
- Details about any IPv4 or IPv6 address, range, or subnet
- Network, broadcast, masks, address count, type, class, IANA block, reverse DNS, supernet, subnet splitting, membership test
- Binary, decimal, hex, and IPv6 forms (expanded, 6to4, NAT64, Teredo, EUI-64)
MAC address browser:
- Vendor lookup (IEEE MA-L, MA-M, MA-S), address type, administration, SLAP quadrant, and known use
- Custom name and vendor assignment used throughout the app
Network information:
- Default gateway, DNS server, HTTP proxy, external IP (v4 and v6) with hostname, AS number, and AS name
- Wi-Fi details: SSID, BSSID, router vendor, security type, IP address, and subnet mask
- VPN, USB Ethernet, and personal hotspot connection details
- Cell network type, with dual SIM support
- Wi-Fi, cell, and VPN data usage since the last boot
Local service discovery:
- Bonjour and UPnP/DLNA browsers
Siri, Shortcuts, and controls:
- Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts app support for every tool
- Control Center, Lock Screen, and Action button controls
- Share extension: query any website from Safari
- Home screen quick actions
More:
- No ads
- Light and dark theme
- Full IPv6 support everywhere, with selectable IPv4/IPv6
- History of all performed tasks, with favorites
- Export by email, AirPrint, and AirDrop
- Copy/paste support
- Detailed help
- Regular updates

bluejetty:00014287:ios.description:
Humanforce – Get Ready For The Next Shift
The intelligent platform for your shift based workforce. 
Enjoy the power and functionality of Humanforce from the convenience of your mobile device. 
Humanforce helps employers get ready for the next shift:
• Stay on top of your mobile workforce with a single operational view from your mobile device, easily check late starters and fill absent worker shifts
• Stay up to date, approve employee leave and availability on the go
• Easily offer shifts to employees based on their skills and availability
• Quickly fill open shifts by sending alerts to your mobile workforce 
• Approve and manage timesheets on the go 
• Manage employee communication with one-one or one-to team messaging
• Broadcast important communications to your teams 
Humanforce helps employees get ready for their next shift:
• Quickly clock in and out of work from your mobile device
• Submit leave requests and manage your availability
• View your timesheets for the shifts and hours you’ve worked in a pay period
• Have the flexibility to bid on shifts that suit you 
• Manage all your shifts using your calendar 
• Receive notifications when shifts are offered to you
• Easily stay on top of shift changes with alerts and notifications 
• Receive rostered shifts straight to your mobile as soon as they’re published 
• Stay up to date with company or team announcements 
• Stay in touch with your colleagues with one-one or one-to team messaging
About Humanforce app
Almost every shift has its no-shows, late arrivals, and special requests, but, you’ve also got to deal with the big shifts in how people work – everything from new employee expectations to new technologies, new regulations, and other major changes.
Humanforce brings a whole new approach to managing your teams and the way you work where you can simplify the process, see everything at once, and stay ahead of the curve. That’s why thousands of businesses of all sizes – hotels to hospitals, resources to recreation, stadiums to shops and more – use Humanforce to get ready for the next shift.
Visit humanforce.com
