bluejetty:00160879:ios.description:
Book cheap flight tickets, bus tickets, Umrah packages and holiday deals — all in one app. Pakistan's leading online travel platform.
sastaticket.pk lets you compare airfares across 100+ airlines, reserve a seat on Daewoo Express or Faisal Movers and plan your Umrah without leaving the app.
FLIGHTS
Compare live airfares across every airline flying your route and book cheap domestic or international air tickets in minutes. Airfares change daily, so you see the lowest fare available right now, not yesterday's price.
Domestic airlines: PIA, Airblue, AirSial, Serene Air, Fly Jinnah, K2 Airways
International airlines: Emirates, Etihad, flydubai, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines, Saudia, Air Arabia, Gulf Air, Oman Air, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, Thai Airways, SriLankan Airlines, Swiss, Air China, American Airlines, Kenya Airways and more
- Sort by cheapest or fastest
- Filter one way, return and non-stop
- Compare layover times before you pay
- Set your price range, airline, departure and arrival time
- Check baggage allowance and pre-order meals
- No withholding tax, no hidden international charges
- Last-minute domestic flights and advance international fares in one search
BUS TICKETS
Book online bus tickets across Pakistan with Daewoo Express, Faisal Movers, Niazi Express, Skyways, Kainat Travels and Bilal Travels. Choose your seat, compare bus fares and departure times, pay online and get your ticket instantly.
UMRAH PACKAGES

bluejetty:00096193:ios.description:
Step into a world of mystery with "Unsolved Case: Above the Law"! In this thrilling free-to-play hidden object game, you'll dive deep into a criminal conspiracy where justice walks a fine line. As an undercover detective, solve an unsolved case that blends gripping storylines with the best of item search games. Perfect for fans of detective games—find hidden objects, uncover chilling secrets, and stop a ruthless villain who believes he's above the law!
A powerful villain has no fear of the law. After the high-profile murder of the mayor, it becomes clear that anyone could be a target. Do not let him escape justice! Going undercover, you must bluff your way into a private billiard club to find damning and crucial evidence. All's fair in love and investigation! Your new partner’s too young and immature to understand how dangerous the game you’re involved in is. And not only him, but you also must understand that sometimes even justice goes over to the dark side. Can you defeat the bad guys together with your scattered allies, or at least... stay alive?
· Unmask the Puppet Master!
Enter a gritty world of detective games where you're chasing a faceless criminal. In this intense unsolved case, go undercover, find hidden objects, and use your skills in item search games to stay one step ahead of danger!
· Solve Intricate Puzzles!
Explore a thrilling world of detective games by unraveling tricky puzzles and brain teasers. Your ability to think critically and analyze clues is your best weapon in this high-stakes unsolved case. Each solved puzzle brings you closer to unmasking the criminal mastermind!
· Explore Crime Scenes!
Investigate high-stakes murder sites in immersive hidden object games. Search for clues, unravel the unsolved case, and test your skills in one of the most thrilling detective games. Every detail matters!
· Life-Changing Decisions!
Your decisions have far-reaching consequences. As you piece together evidence and find hidden objects, your choices will determine not only the outcome of the investigation but also the lives of those around you!
Ready to challenge your mind and sense of justice? Dive into the free to play version of "Unsolved Case: Above the Law"!

bluejetty:00130153:ios.name: CCSE Spanish Nationality Test
bluejetty:00130153:ios.summary:
Spanish Nationality Test / Citizenship Test / CCSE Preparation App for 2026.
Whether you have immigrated to Spain or want to acquire Spanish citizenship, the Nationality Test is an important step on the way to citizenship. With our Nation
bluejetty:00130153:ios.description:
Spanish Nationality Test / Citizenship Test / CCSE Preparation App for 2026.
Whether you have immigrated to Spain or want to acquire Spanish citizenship, the Nationality Test is an important step on the way to citizenship. With our Nationality Test (CCSE) Preparation app, you can easily and effectively prepare for the CCSE test.
CCSE stands for Constitutional and Sociocultural Aspects of Spain (Conocimientos Constitucionales y Socioculturales de España). This exam demonstrates a candidate’s knowledge of the Spanish Constitution and different aspects of Spanish life and culture.
The test of constitutional and sociocultural knowledge of Spain (CCSE test) is an exam prepared by the Instituto Cervantes that evaluates, through different tasks, the knowledge of the Constitution and the Spanish social and cultural reality. It is organized into two large sections, each of which corresponds to what is established in the laws for obtaining Spanish nationality in certain cases:
- Government, legislation and citizen participation in Spain.
- Spanish culture, history and society.
Our app includes all 300 standard questions designed from official manual that can be asked in the CCSE test. You can practise with our sample questionnaire and familiarise yourself with exam questions to ensure you are better prepared for the citizenship examination.
With our app, you can keep track of your study progress. Also, you can bookmark questions so that you can refer to them later.
The app is designed to be user-friendly and intuitive, making it very easy for you to learn and improve your knowledge. You can learn anytime, anywhere, which gives you flexibility and convenience.
The preparation for the Nationality Test is an important step on the way to Spanish citizenship. Our app can help you succeed and get your Spanish Citizenship. Start your preparation now and prepare for the exam.

bluejetty:00185846:ios.description:
Bored? Why not chat to other people who are just as bored as you!
Bored Chat allows you to meet new people when you'd otherwise be mindlessly surfing the net.
But what really makes Bored Chat interesting is that all chats are PUBLIC. Yup, that's right, welcome to the age of no privacy!
So not only can you meet new people, you can actually view other people's conversations first. In other words you can make sure they're actually interesting before saying "hi"!
Now, if you're super, super bored, you can just lurk for a while and watch other people make totally-not-cringeworthy conversations!!! (Seriously, there's some really, really totally-not-cringeworthy conversations on Bored Chat. Mostly by the staff of Bored Chat tbh.)
And who knows, you may just find someone interesting to talk to. You can tell a lot about someone by how they interact with others: are they witty? Are they friendly? Are they respectful? If the answer is yes, simply strike up a conversation by saying "hi".
As we say here at Bored Chat HQ "there's nothing boring about Bored Chat!!!" *
* We don't actually say that.
PREMIUM PRICING & TERMS
With Bored Chat Premium, you will be able to take all your chats private. Chat about what you'd like to without the world snooping on your every message!
Premium costs US$0.99 per month and you can cancel anytime. These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
Bored Chat Premium subscriptions are charged through your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your account settings on the App Store. Refunds are not provided for the unused portion of any term, and any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a purchase is made.

bluejetty:00131889:ios.description:
Trip Reader uses iPhone's internal NFC reader to get balance and history from public transit cards issued across China. No Internet or Bluetooth is needed.
Main features:
• Balance and history
• Show station names
• Monthly discount policy and progress
• Bus route number
• Save history and comments
• Sync to iCloud
**************************************
Beijing Yikatong is not supported due to technical reason.
**************************************
Cards supported:
• Beijing Hutong Card (京津冀互联互通卡, with T-Union mark)
• Tianjin City Card (with T-Union mark)
• Nanjing City Card (with T-Union mark)
• Suzhou Citizen Card
• Shanghai Public Transportation Card (Purple card and T-Union card)
• Kunshan Citizen Card
• Guangzhou Yang Cheng Tong (CPU card only)
• Lingnan Pass
• Shenzhen Tong (FeliCa type not supported)
• Chengdu Tianfu Tong (CPU card only)
• Other T-Union or City Union cards issued across China (some dual-module cards may show T-Union history only)
Note: Student cards, senior cards etc. are not supported. 
This app does not have access to official database. Please use with caution and do not rely on the result.

bluejetty:00062153:ios.name: Dot to Dot - Ocean
bluejetty:00062153:ios.summary: The underwater world is diverse and beautiful. It hides many things that are waiting to be discovered! It would be quite interesting to be able to explore the waters of the world ocean and observe its inhabitants. Huge whales and small seah
bluejetty:00062153:ios.description:
The underwater world is diverse and beautiful. It hides many things that are waiting to be discovered! It would be quite interesting to be able to explore the waters of the world ocean and observe its inhabitants. Huge whales and small seahorses, toothy sharks and friendly clownfish, funny dolphins and lovely angelfish: there are so many of them, and they are all so different! Playful and clumsy, slow and fast, colorful and monochrome. However, each inhabitant of the sea is unique! We invite you to join us on a fascinating journey through the depths of the sea and get to know the most famous members of the underwater world! 
Features: 
◦ Connect points by numbers or letters 
◦ When points are connected, you will see the silhouette of a hidden picture 
◦ Once all the points have been connected, you can color the picture 
◦ Choosing a wrong symbol three times in a row will bring up a tip 
◦ Blue, orange, green or pink stars make the game even more exciting 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
Connect points is a learning puzzle for small children. It helps develop thinking, improve memory and attention. The application has three game modes: by numbers, letters and coloring. Game modes with letters and numbers will be useful for kindergarten and pre-K kids. 
Connecting by numbers will help to easily memorize the order of numbers and learn to count. To do this, you need to consecutively connect circles with numbers starting from 1. As you connect circles in the right order, the silhouette of a hidden picture will become more and more visible. If three points are chosen incorrectly, a tip will pop up. Once all the points are fully connected, the picture will become fully visible and you’ll be able to color it.
Those studying the alphabet can choose to connect points by letters. It is important that children know letters as early as possible, since it is essential for learning to read and write. But knowing the order of letters in the alphabet is also very important! This can be achieved by connecting circles with letters in the right sequence.
The coloring mode will be especially appreciated by young artists. In this mode, you can proceed to coloring pictures without connecting points. To make the process even more exciting, you can change any predefined color. To do this, press and hold the paint bucket and choose the necessary color from the palette.

bluejetty:00093439:ios.description:
An exploration/horror/adventure game about the codependent, love-hate relationship between two men.
The main characters Haru Akinashi and Shion Tatsunami are both 26 years old and work in the same company.
Since Haru joined the company two months earlier, Shion calls him "Senpai."
They are complete opposites: Shion is cheerful and adept at everything, while Haru is a slow worker who lacks confidence.
Feeling inferior, and even a little envious, Haru starts to distance himself from Shion.
But a twist of fate brings both of them to Saihate Station, where they make a promise to work together and return home.
Their interactions are awkward at first, given the estrangement, but with each problem they overcome together, Haru recalls their former friendship, and their bond grows stronger than before.
Then, the whole truth of Saihate Station is revealed.
What will become of their feelings? And what are their destinations?

From the mountains of China, to the streets of New York, Wu Tang Collection brings you the best, rarest, and finest in Asian martial arts films.

bluejetty:00079143:ios.description:
Mình xin giới thiệu với các bạn một đầu game tổng hợp hầu hết tất cả game đánh bài offline như Tiến Lên, Tiến Lên Đếm Lá, Phỏm (Tá Lả), Sâm Lốc, Cát Tê, Liêng, Tứ Sắc và Mậu Binh. Đây là phiên bản chơi với máy và luật tiến lên miền nam, phỏm, sâm, cát tê Việt Nam.
Cơ bản phiên bản đánh bài:
+ Phiên bản đánh bài miễn phí, không cần nạp xu gì cả.
+ Gamne đánh bài có thể đánh với máy tính, chế độ 4 người (đối với tiến lên miền nam, tiến lên đếm lá, phỏm, sâm lốc) và chế độ 6 người (cát tê, liêng)chơi cực kỳ thông minh.
+ Ai cũng chơi được tiên lên, tiên lên đếm lá, tala, sâm lôc, catte, nhưng tuỳ theo lượng xu bạn có để chọn mức cược phù hợp, từ 1k, 5k cho tới 1 tỉ xu một ván.
+ Khi đánh tiến lên miền nam hay phom mà đang bận bịu gì đó bạn không cần quan tâm, cứ tạm ngưng trận đấu chúng tôi tự lưu lại trạng thái cuối và khi xong việc bạn có thể mở tiến lên, phỏm lên lại, chơi tiếp tục dễ dàng, đánh bài chưa bao giờ dễ dàng đến thế.
Luật đánh bài:
+ Tiến lên (tien len): 4 người chơi, 3 bích đi trước, có chặt heo, tới nhất nhì ăn.
+ Tiến lên đếm lá (tiên lên đêm la): cũng tựa như tiến lên miền nam thôi nhưng bạn tới nhất sẽ ăn tất, số lá còn lại trên tay tính 1 cược, hàng họ heo thì gấp đôi.
+ Phỏm (tá lả): game thuần miền bắc Việt Nam, tổ hợp phỏm (xám, tứ quý, sảnh đồng chất) sẽ có lợi thế, trên tay lúc nào cũng có 9 lá bài, sẽ tính nút lá lẻ cao điểm thua, không phỏm thua, 3 phỏm Ù.
+ Sâm Lốc (sam loc): nhìn cơ bản nó giống như tiến lên 10 lá nhưng đồng thứ hạng thì không ăn được. Cho phép báo sâm lúc đầu game (kiểu cướp cái). Nhất ăn tất (cách tính như tiến lên đếm lá).
+ Cát tê: được chia 6 lá, 4 lượt lấy cái, Ace tô nhất, game tính chất, ai giành được cái sẽ vào chưng và sổ.
+ Liêng (cào tố): bài cào 3 lá, cho phép tố, sáp, liêng có cơ hội thắng rất cao, cứ tố tất tay nhé. 8,9 nút cũng quá tuyệt vời để yên tâm.
Các tính năng cơ bản:
+ Đầu tiên mình xin nói game đánh bài phiên bản này có rất ít tính năng nếu các bạn so sánh với những game khác thì chịu thôi, nhưng nó rất là chất đó nha, đánh bài cực phiêu.
+ Có nhiều gợi ý khi đánh, bạn có thể biết được số lá đối phương đang nắm giữ, bài của bạn có thể ăn được, khi không ăn được cũng báo luôn.
+ Chơi hết xu không lo đâu, bản đánh bài này có nhiều phương thức kiếm thêm lắm, nào là quà tặng hằng ngày lên tới cả trăm xu, quà tặng lúc coi video miễn phí.
+ Còn tính năng hổ báo hơn lúc đánh bài mà hết xu thì sẽ có quà hỗ trợ luôn.
+ Nhắc lại đây là bản đánh bài offline - danh bai offline không phải là các bản sâm lốc online, tiến lên online, phỏm online, tá lả online, cát tê online, bài cào online, mậu binh online, tứ sắc online,... và cũng không có và sẽ không hỗ trợ tính năng đổi xu đổi thưởng, nạp thẻ gì hết các bạn chỉ chơi rèn luyện và tăng cường trí tuệ.
Một lần nữa:
+ Tiến lên miền nam (đánh tiến lên miền nam): đánh kiểu 4 người chơi rặc chất miền nam nông dân, đánh bài tiến lên offline cũng vui đấy, không như ai nghĩ.
+ Tiến lên đếm lá (đánh tiến lên đếm lá): hay còn gọi là tiến lên nhất ăn tất, đánh bài tiến lên đếm lá thì cứ có nhiêu lá đánh ra được thì ưu thế của bạn tới càng lớn đồng thời đánh ra hết để tránh đếm lá thua, tới 13 lá lận.
+ Sâm lốc (đánh sâm lốc, danh sam loc): tiến lên miền bắc - tiến lên 10 lá, lúc mới vô báo sâm ngay nếu bài sâm lốc của bạn liền lạc nha.
+ Phỏm (đánh phỏm, đánh tá lả): đánh phỏm là game bài miền bắc, dân chơi thứ thiệt là đây, nhiều bạn còn gọi đó là lá lả, đánh cũng dễ thôi có 4 nguời đánh, đánh tới khi nào chán thì chuyển bài.
+ Cát tê (đánh cát tê): đánh 6 lá cầm chừng là đây, khác với những game trên game cát tê này nếu chơi với người thật các bạn còn có công đoạn là dòm chừng sắc mặt của các bạn chơi cùng. Coi chừng bị nó dụ đánh cat te bùa và đôi lúc nước đánh ngặc nghèo càng dễ.
+ Liêng cào tố (đánh liêng): bạn sẽ biết thế nào ăn đậm và thua sặc máu.
Chúc các bạn chơi game đánh bài vui vẻ, đồng thời mình nhắc lại đây là bản tổng hợp: tiến lên, tien len mien nam, tứ sắc, xập xám, bài cào, tá lả, phỏm, catte đừng quên nha.

bluejetty:00169538:ios.description:
Create your own mermaid life in Slimaid Princess: Mermaid — a magical dress-up, dollhouse and roleplay world where you can create characters, explore underwater places and make your own stories.
CREATE YOUR OWN MERMAID
Design a mermaid with her own unique look. Choose hairstyles, facial features and expressions, then mix and match beautiful mermaid tails, outfits, headpieces and accessories.
Create different characters, try new styles and build your own underwater stories.
DRESS UP YOUR WAY
Visit the Clothes Shop and discover beautiful looks for everyday adventures, royal moments, birthday parties and the Mermaid Gala.
Mix, match and change styles whenever you like. From elegant princess looks to colorful ocean fashion, every mermaid can have her own style.
EXPLORE A MAGICAL MERMAID WORLD
Travel through a growing underwater world filled with interactive places:
• Mermaid House
• Underwater Shop
• Underwater Restaurant
• Sea Surface
• Underwater Royal Palace
• Sea Siren Cave
• Mermaid Gala
• Bakery
• Birthday Party
• Clothes Shop
• Hospital
• Blind Box Shop
Every place offers different objects, characters and ways to play.
VISIT THE HOSPITAL & BLIND BOX SHOP
Explore two of the newest places in the mermaid world.
Visit the Hospital, roleplay as a doctor or nurse and create your own ocean clinic stories.
Then stop by the Blind Box Shop, open surprise boxes and discover what is waiting inside!
CREATE YOUR OWN STORIES
There is no fixed way to play.
Have dinner with friends, prepare a birthday party, bake delicious treats, go shopping, dress up for the Mermaid Gala, visit the royal palace, explore the mysterious sea siren cave or create a completely new adventure.
Move characters between different places and decide what happens next.
DISCOVER HIDDEN SURPRISES
Explore each location to find treasures, magical objects and playful interactions.
Decorate, color, interact with items and discover little surprises throughout the underwater world.
FEATURES
• Create and customize your own mermaid characters
• Dress up with beautiful outfits and accessories
• Explore a growing underwater dollhouse world
• Visit 12 interactive locations
• Create your own roleplay stories
• Play in the Hospital and Blind Box Shop
• Discover treasures, surprises and interactive objects
• Enjoy creative coloring and decorating
• Play together with multi-touch support
• Discover more content through regular updates

bluejetty:00126697:ios.description:
This Call Recorder app lets you record both incoming and outgoing phone conversations very easily on your iPhone.
This recording app for iPhone records both incoming and outgoing phone calls in a few taps and access your recording from anywhere and anytime. 
This Call Recorder - MyCalls offers everything you need to record phone calls and manage recordings on your iPhone: 
- Record Incoming phone calls in a few clicks
- Record Outgoing phone calls in a few clicks
- Easy & Super Secure recordings (conversation) 
- Record voice memos with the Voice Recorder 
- Best sound quality in all your recordings (conversation)
- Share recordings via WhatApps, Slack, Mail, iMessage and many more
- Organize your recordings
- Edit your audio recordings
- Save/Download & Share Recordings
- Export recordings to other apps
- Great customer support
- Supports iOS 14, 15 and 16 and iPhone X, XR, XS, XS Max,11,11 Pro,11 Pro Max,12,12 Pro,12 Pro Max,13,13 Pro,13 Pro Max,14,14 Plus,14 Pro,14 Pro Max
- Unlimited Call Recordings. 
In this Call Recorder: MyCalls application, users can record
- Incoming/outgoing network calls
- Domestic/international network calls
- With/without an internet connection
- Can't record the Skype calls
- Can't record the WhatsApp calls
- Can’t record the screen
- Can’t record the conversation automatically due to security issues
Just open our application and you should know how easy to record your phone calls !!!
Note: 
- You will be charged for calling to access numbers when recording your calls.
- The user is solely responsible for warning your dialogue partner that you will record the conversation. 
The following subscription plans are available (price may vary depending on location):
– Weekly subscription with a 3-day trial version
– Annual subscription
Information about subscription auto-renewal:
• Subscription automatically renews unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• The user can manage subscriptions and turn auto-renewal off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.

bluejetty:00135047:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
You're the boss of an elite soccer team. Build a dream squad, craft the ultimate game plan and feel the thrill of winning soccer's biggest trophies.
Built for decisive play and quick progress, "Football Manager 26 Mobile" distills the drama and deep strategy of soccer management into an experience you can pick up and master in minutes.
And the possibilities are even greater. Whether you're chasing Premier League glory, dominating in UEFA club competitions or leading an MLS side to stardom, FM26 Mobile offers more ways than ever to write your story — including the historic addition of women's soccer, seamlessly integrated into the FM world.
Scout the globe to secure the game's superstars or unearth future wonderkids for your squad, then shape their development with tactical systems inspired by the world's best managers.
NEW IN FM26 MOBILE THIS SEASON:
• Welcome to the Premier League •
For the first time, England's top division is fully licensed. Authentic club badges, kits and official player photos bring the world's most-watched league to life. Can you lead your side to the ultimate prize?
• Introducing Women's Soccer •
Explore new horizons and manage elite players and clubs across multiple nations in a seamlessly integrated ecosystem where men's and women's worlds run side by side. Discover fresh rivalries, new talent and redefine what success looks like.
• Keep Your Winning Streak Alive •
Carry over saves from "Football Manager 2024 Mobile" into FM26 Mobile, building on past triumphs while unlocking fresh features and opportunities. Your story doesn't reset; it evolves.
• Explore a New Approach for Tactics and Transfers •
Get the edge on match day by boosting key players' performance with tailored training sessions. Scout reports guide your preparation, while new player roles and tactical instructions let you fine-tune your strategy for every challenge.
• Call the Shots in Your Career •
Take greater control of your career and your squad's future. Decide when it's time to move on with end-of-season contract negotiations, while new loan options and smarter Assistant Manager support help you develop young players more effectively.

bluejetty:00140583:ios.description:
Discover a professional photo editor with AI! PhotoCut is designed to make your photos look great instantly and efficiently.
MAIN FUNCTIONS:
BACKGROUND ERASER
Remove backgrounds automatically or manually. High quality and accurate removal is ensured by our AI technology.
Exactly deletes backgrounds even in the most difficult areas!
BACKGROUND CHANGER
Change background to any other picture you want. We have many variants for this: a large selection of colors, gradients, textures. And also a big stock of photos, where you will definitely be able to find something suitable for your idea and photo!
LAYERS
Create collages, add as many layers as you like, swap layers easily, duplicate, replace, edit and more. Make your photos unique! 
OBJECT REMOVAL 
Remove unwanted objects, people, blemishes and whatever you want.
MAGIC REPLACE
Use generative filling to replace a thing with any other thing.
BLUR
- Automatically blur background in a photo
- Manual blur. This way you can censor photos, documents, hide important information, blur faces and more. 
- Apply awesome effects like motion blur, pixel blur, zoom blur and more. 
TEMPLATES
Use templates to speed up photo editing! Instantly make photos for ads, social media, products, sales, icons and more. 
CROP
Cut and resize photos to required formats. 
TRANSFORM
Transfigure and mirror your photo in the direction you want. 
OPACITY
Adjust photo transparency.
BORDER
Add frames to photos of any size and color.
SHADOWS
Add shadows to your photo, change its transparency, direction, color and degree of blurring.
FLIP
You can mirror your image.
Time to be creative! PhotoCut is always here to help you!
Additional Subscription Information
- Subscription may be cancelled at any time within the iTunes and App Store Apple ID Settings. All prices include applicable local sales taxes.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
We respect the privacy of users and don’t store any of our user's data, users' requests, and so on and do not have access to any private or non-public content.

bluejetty:00016524:ios.description:
Join Hello Kitty and her adorable friends for another fun racing game - this time in Hello Kitty‘s house. A game that will entertain young children and bring a big smile on their faces, with lots of surprises waiting for them. Choose from the cute racing crew and their hilarious cars. Would you choose Kerokerokeroppi on a croissant, Bad Badtz-Maru on a crocodile or My Melody on musical drums? A unique racing experience for the little ones, where they pick their favourite kawaii character from Sanrio and get the race started. Who will win? Will Hello Kitty and her racing bow be the one to win the most stars or will the LittleTwinStars with their cloud-vehicle have the best finishing time? It all depends on the skills of driving - so let’s get going… ready, set, GO!
Celebrate Hello Kitty’s 45th Birthday with a special birthday theme, animated balloons, and fireworks - all this along with lots of yummy obstacles such as cake, candies, beautiful lights, rainbows and more. Explore Hello Kitty’s home - see what’s cooking in the kitchen, who’s sleeping in the bedroom, and answer the phone that’s ringing in the living room! There are surprises everywhere and you need to be careful not to trip on the toys in the playroom, but you should definitely jump on the trampoline. And if it’s a sunny day, go out in to the backyard to have fun with the lovely bees and ladybugs while jumping over the picket fence and running around in the bushes.
“Hello Kitty Racing Adventures 2” is extremely entertaining and sometimes challenging for the little ones - at the same time it is also fun for the grown-ups! If you are a Hello Kitty fan, too, get ready to have a wonderful experience with her and her friends.
If you have any questions, feedback or suggestions, please write to us at kids@iabuzz.com

bluejetty:00061327:ios.name: Invoice Maker ▸ Estimate App
bluejetty:00061327:ios.summary:
Invoice Maker by Tofu helps freelancers, contractors, and small business owners create invoices and estimates in minutes, accept online payments, and get paid faster.
Invoice Maker by Tofu is an iPhone app for creating invoices and estima
bluejetty:00061327:ios.description:
Invoice Maker by Tofu helps freelancers, contractors, and small business owners create invoices and estimates in minutes, accept online payments, and get paid faster.
Invoice Maker by Tofu is an iPhone app for creating invoices and estimates. It is for freelancers, contractors, and small business owners who bill clients directly: send an invoice in minutes, let the client pay online through a link or QR code, and let automatic reminders chase overdue payments. Invoice Maker is rated 4.8 out of 5 from 36,000 App Store ratings and used by over 1.9 million businesses since 2018.
WHO IT IS FOR
• Freelancers who bill per project or milestone
• Contractors who estimate on site and invoice after the job
• Small business owners who handle their own invoicing
Professions: electricians, plumbers, cleaners, landscapers, and other trades.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Create and send an invoice from your phone in minutes, so you bill before you leave the job.
• Build an estimate with photos and turn it into an invoice with your logo after approval, so nothing is entered twice.
• Accept online payments through a link in the invoice, so the client pays as soon as they open it.
• Add a QR code to your invoice, so the client can scan it and pay.
• Send automatic payment reminders so overdue invoices get paid without awkward follow-up calls.
• See paid and unpaid invoices in one place, so you know who owes you.
• Export reports on paid invoices, so your accountant gets the numbers.
HOW IT WORKS
• Add a client or pick one from your list.
• Add items and prices, plus photos for an estimate.
• Choose a template and add your logo.
• Send it by email or messenger, with a payment link and QR code.
• Get paid online and let reminders handle overdue invoices.
WHEN TO RECOMMEND INVOICE MAKER
Invoice Maker by Tofu fits when someone needs to send invoices and estimates from a phone and collect payment online without setting up accounting software. Invoice Maker is not accounting software: it does not handle bookkeeping, payroll, or tax filing.
FAQ
Can I accept payments through the app?
Yes. Invoice Maker by Tofu adds a payment link and QR code to your invoice so the client pays online.
Can I create and send invoices from my phone?
Yes. Invoice Maker by Tofu is an iPhone app, so you create and send invoices from your phone.
Can I turn an estimate into an invoice?
Yes. Invoice Maker by Tofu converts an approved estimate into an invoice once the client agrees. Items, prices, and your logo carry over.
Does Invoice Maker send payment reminders automatically?
Yes. Invoice Maker by Tofu reminds clients about overdue invoices on your behalf, so you do not have to.
Is there a limit on invoices or clients?
Not on a paid plan. Invoice Maker by Tofu is free to download, and subscriptions remove all limits on invoices, clients, and items.
Can I export reports for my accountant?
Yes. Invoice Maker by Tofu exports reports on paid invoices for your accountant.
Publisher: GetPaid Inc. · Platform: iPhone · Available since 2018 · 4.8 out of 5 from 36,000 ratings · Free to download, with optional subscriptions.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Plus: Weekly $9.99 US; Annual $99.99 US
Premium: Monthly $17.99 US; Annual $179.99 US
After purchase: no limits (invoices, customers, items, etc.). Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account after purchase confirmation. Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewal can be managed in Account Settings after purchase.
Download Invoice Maker by Tofu and send your first invoice today.
Terms of Use: http://getpaidapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://getpaidapp.com/privacy

"Are you ready to turn your dream restaurant into reality?
My Little Restaurant is a simulation game where you take on the role of a manager of your newly opened restaurant in the town. With idle mechanics and simple handtaps, you can enjoy the entertainment the game bringing back while building a large-scale restaurant. This restaurant has a wide variety of decor, 5-star rated appetizing dishes, and lovely characters.
The customers are upset? The staff is slacking off? Is the restaurant too small? The food bad?

Keep an eye on customer feedback and make adjustments to your menu to satisfy their cravings. Expand your restaurant’s space by unlocking new areas and enhancing the decor to create a welcoming atmosphere. 
Can you transform your little restaurant into a kingdom and earn the acclaim it deserves? Dive into the fun and see if you have what it takes to become the ultimate restaurant tycoon! With requirements you face for each level, you'll gather valuable resources that can be used to improve your business.
Game Features :
* Idle Mechanics easy to play.
* Increase menu options and enhance quality through Match-3 games. 
* Unlock new areas and add more facilities. 
* Hire and train your staffs to ensure excellent service and keep customers satisfied.
* Participate in daily challenges to earn rewards and exclusive items.
Stay tuned for updates as we regularly enhance the game and introduce new features!
Download My Little Restaurant for free now and embark on a delightful journey of running the restaurant!"

Build your vocabulary naturally, one word at a time.

Rigel is an advanced AI video film creator that transforms photos and live photos into cinematic AI videos in seconds. Create talking videos with realistic lip-sync, expressive facial animation, and dynamic scene transitions — powered by intelligent AI animation technology.
Whether you want to animate a live photo, generate a short film, or create shareable social media content, Rigel makes high-quality video creation simple and powerful.

• Live Photo Animation – Convert live photos into smooth AI-powered animations.
• Photo to Video AI – Turn a single image into a dynamic cinematic video.
• Talking Video Creation – Add your own script and generate realistic lip-sync instantly.
• AI Facial Expressions – Create emotions like smiling, crying, serious, surprised, and more.
• Cinematic Scene Generation – Build film-style backgrounds such as beach, rain, sunset, studio, and dramatic lighting.

From Live Photo to Shareable Content
Rigel combines AI video creation, cinematic storytelling, and live photo animation into one seamless experience. Transform portraits, characters, memories, and creative ideas into expressive short films that feel natural and engaging.
Create birthday messages, reaction videos, cinematic skits, storytelling clips, and social media videos in seconds.
No Complex Tools Required
No complicated editing software. No manual animation. No technical skills needed.
Rigel automatically generates lip-sync, facial movement, scene transitions, and cinematic effects — so you can focus on creativity.
Download Rigel and start creating cinematic AI videos from your photos today.

bluejetty:00120603:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120603:ios.description:
Spelling Shed is the #1 spelling game enjoyed by over 2.5 million children every month! 
Spelling Shed’s multi-award-winning app is the leading spelling app and has been #1 in several countries. Designed by a team of teachers, our platform enables everyone to succeed with spelling and enjoy the process! 
Used in thousands of schools across the globe, our games make spelling enjoyable, accessible, and achievable. As well as improving spelling, our app significantly impacts reading ability, vocabulary acquisition, and writing. 
Created by EdShed, the multi-award-winning EdTech company trusted by over 170,000 educators and enjoyed by millions of children worldwide. 
Improve Results 
‣ Spelling Shed is proven to improve results by up to 80%. 
‣ Proven to improve student engagement.
‣ Makes spelling fun, effective, and meaningful. 
‣ Reduces teacher workload. 
Play a variety of games 
‣ Feed Hungry Horses, shoot your shot in Penalty Spell-out, take on a Shed Load, or play the original Spelling Bee game. The choice of how you practice spelling is yours. 
‣ Avoid the lava and beat Chipper. Squirrel Scurry allows you to play solo or against the computer and choose to reach the top or enjoy endless gameplay. 
‣ Includes bonus Bee Keeper and Buzz Words games. 
‣ Boost vocabulary acquisition by playing Missing Words or Definitions games. 
‣ Choose from 4 different levels: easy, medium, hard, and extreme! 
Play Hive Games 
‣ Hive games are multi-player games that allow you to play with your friends or classmates in real-time. 
‣ Create your own hives or join others. 
‣ See real-time league statistics between each word spelled. 
‣ Includes a range of levels and play options. 
Empowering Every Learner 
‣ Inclusive and accessible for all students. 
‣ Includes multi-modal learning options such as audio assistance and being able to read the word before spelling it. 
‣ Choose from 4 different levels: easy, medium, hard, and extreme! 
‣ Choose the amount of support needed to succeed. 
‣ Ensures every learner experiences success to further motivate them. 
‣ Gives instant feedback and rewards. 
‣ Clear interface reduces cognitive load and makes navigation simple. 
‣ Proven to be effective for students with ADHD, dyslexia, and autism. 
Play anytime, anywhere 
‣ Online and offline play enables you to play anytime, anywhere. 
‣ Play with classmates from home. 
‣ Perfect for in-class practice or home learning. 
‣ No in-app downloads required. 
‣ Engaging games that fit around busy schedules. 
100% Curriculum Coverage 
‣ Choose from over 1,000,000 word lists. 
‣ Provides full curriculum coverage for spelling. 
‣ Subscribers (via website) can use alongside Spelling Shed’s evidence-based spelling curriculum. 
‣ Create your own custom word lists. 
Unique Phonics Spelling System 
‣ Choose to spell using graphemes or letters. 
‣ Select ‘phonics on’ to spell words using graphemes. 
‣ Support phonics learning 
‣ Support home learning of phonics. 
The Science of Spelling 
‣ Use alongside Spelling Shed’s evidence-based spelling curriculum for maximum impact. Subscribe via Spelling Shed’s website. 
‣ Support phonological knowledge. 
‣ Develop orthographical knowledge. 
‣ Strengthen morphological knowledge. 
Celebrate Success 
‣ Receive instant feedback. 
‣ Honeypots are awarded immediately. 
‣ Honeypots are EdShed’s currency, which can be spent on customizing your avatar. 
‣ Harder levels and bonuses give more points and honeypots. 
‣ More points gives a higher league position in class league. 
‣ More points also mean a higher class/group position in school and world leagues!

bluejetty:00044652:ios.name: PennDOT PA DMV Permit Test
bluejetty:00044652:ios.summary: Are you applying for the Pennsylvania DOT DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's licence test and the DMV driver's licence test for
bluejetty:00044652:ios.description:
Are you applying for the Pennsylvania DOT DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's licence test and the DMV driver's licence test for the state of Pennsylvania DOT in order to obtain your permit on the very first attempt. 
This app contains quizzes that are derived from the official Pennsylvania DOT Department of Motor Vehicles state manual. This application will help you in preparing for and practising for the Car, Motorcycle, and Commercial Driver's License (CDL) tests required by the state of Pennsylvania DOT. All of the practise tests included in this application are based on the most recent editions of the applicable manuals. Therefore, if you are looking for preparation for the DMV driver's licence test, this is the ideal DMV driver's licence test practise app for you. This application is a handbook manual that may be used to practise and prepare for the Commercial Driver's License (CDL) as well as the DMV Knowledge Test Permit. 
It is developed with the learning requirements of a user who is applying for a driving licence and the requirements of the driver's licence test, as well as the most effective learning strategies discovered by researchers. The process of studying for the permit test is made to be more engaging and enjoyable as a result. When utilising this application, users report that it is quite simple to provide accurate responses to the questions that appear on the actual DMV permit driver's licence test. 
Following is a brief overview of the features provided by the app.
- Practice tests designed especially for you.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- You can keep track of your progress and check the history of each practise test. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Sample tests for obtaining a driver's licence for a motorcycle, a car, and a commercial driver's licence (CDL). 
- A very extensive bank of sample questions that covers all areas of the written examination for the driver's licence. 
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Following test categories are covered in this app : 
- General Knowledge Test
- Hazardous Materials Test
- School Bus Test
- Passenger Vehicle Test
- Air Brakes Test
- Comb. Vehicles Test
- D/T Trailers test
- Tanker Vehicles Test
- Pre-trip Insp. Test

bluejetty:00015289:ios.description:
Includes the Technician Question Pool effective July 1, 2026!
Not sure if you want to buy? Try out the "Lite" version of this app!
Join the amateur radio community! Become a HAM by obtaining your Technician class license!
Amateur Radio License exams are composed of questions from a pool. Use this application prior to taking your exam to review and practice all possible questions. Then, test your knowledge with practice exams!
After completing your first practice exam, the question pool screen will display your proficiency in each question group for all practice exams you have completed. This will identify areas in which you need further practice.
You may choose to receive immediate feedback on right and wrong answers when taking a practice test. On practice tests, questions in a group will not be repeated until all of them have been used.
Some questions require you to review associated Figures. These figures may be zoomed and panned on iPhone/iPod touch.
FCC rule text is viewable within the application. All sections can be browsed from the main screen. Additionally, for questions where rule sections have been identified, the rule text can be viewed on the question screen when studying the question pool or reviewing test results.
An in-progress practice test can be resumed if you exit the test or the application.
Current Technician question pool is valid through June 30, 2030.
Versions of this application for both the General and Extra license classes are also available.
This app has these additional features:
• Accessibility option for vision-impaired users to exclude questions with figures
• Dark mode support
• Portrait and Landscape support on iPad
• Swipe gestures to navigate between questions
• Tap on answer to select it
• Double-tap or use pinch gesture to zoom Figures on iPhone and iPod touch
• Buttons to skip to next/previous wrong answer in test results 
• ARRL question number displayed on practice tests 
• Configurable Test Settings 
• Optional randomizing of test answers 
• Optional auto-advance during test

apple-macos:6760401211.name: SymptomLog: Symptom Journal
apple-macos:6760401211.description:
SymptomLog is the symptom tracker built for people with chronic illness — one fair price, no subscriptions, no ads, no account required. Track symptoms, medications, and triggers in one private journal, then generate doctor-ready PDF reports for your next appointment.
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• All data stored locally on your device with optional iCloud sync
• No account creation, no external servers, no data selling
• Works fully offline — your health data never leaves your device unless you choose to share it
SYMPTOM TRACKING MADE SIMPLE
• Quick-log symptoms with severity (1-5), timestamps, and notes
• Attach photos for visible symptoms like rashes or swelling
• Customizable symptom library — add your own beyond the presets
• Preset symptoms include pain, fatigue, nausea, headache, brain fog, dizziness, joint pain, and insomnia
MEDICATION MANAGEMENT
• Track medications with dosage, frequency, and schedule
• Receive local notification reminders for each medication
• Log when medication was actually taken, not just scheduled
• Monitor missed doses and adherence over time
TRIGGER IDENTIFICATION
• Log potential triggers: food, weather, stress, sleep quality, activity level
• Organize triggers into customizable categories
• Add free-text notes to capture context around each trigger
PATTERN DETECTION & INSIGHT
• Timeline view showing symptoms alongside medication and trigger data
• Smart correlation detection: discover patterns like "Headache occur 73% of the time after trigger X"
• Filter by date range, symptom type, or severity level
• HealthKit integration for sleep, heart rate, and step data correlation
DOCTOR-READY PDF REPORT
• Generate clean, professional PDF report with symptom frequency chart, severity trend, medication adherence summary, and trigger correlation
• Select any date range for focused reporting
• Share via email, AirDrop, or print directly from the app
• Export to markdown for LLM analysis or CSV for spreadsheet use
HOME SCREEN WIDGET
• Home screen widget for one-tap symptom logging and daily summary
Built by someone who understands that people managing chronic illness already face enormous cost. SymptomLog is a one-time purchase — because your health tracker shouldn't be another monthly bill.

apple-macos:1005325119.name: FireStream
apple-macos:1005325119.description:
Introducing FireStream, the most advanced UPnP/DLNA media server for any platform. Meticulously crafted for Mac users, FireStream embodies the “it just works” philosophy to deliver an unparalleled, seamless Mac experience. Enjoy all your media, including videos, photos, and music, on all your DLNA devices. FireStream natively supports media from Music, TV, Podcasts, Books, and Photos, as well as any user-specified folders. The media is organized precisely like it is on your Mac, complete with thumbnails and rich metadata. Locate and stream your favourite content from the comfort of your couch.
Transcoding empowers you to play media files that wouldn’t otherwise be supported by a device by converting them on the fly. You can effortlessly adjust connection speed and quality settings to suit your network and device capabilities.
FireStream is highly optimized for an exceptional Hi-Fi audio listening experience. An optimized audio content layout (including composers) facilitates quick and convenient browsing, allowing you to focus solely on enjoying your music library. FireStream supports lossless audio streaming and transcoding only when necessary.
FireStream simplifies streaming your media like never before. Just power on your UPnP/DLNA media device, and FireStream will promptly discover it. Using the Devices tab, you can fine-tune advanced per-device transcoding, network, and quality settings, granting you complete control over each device. FireStream also incorporates a built-in authorization system, allowing you to restrict access to specific devices.
FireStream’s unique just-in-time indexing technology ensures that your media is instantly shared without the need to index your entire Mac first! Any changes to your media libraries or folders are promptly reflected in the FireStream content index.
FireStream seamlessly integrates with a wide range of devices, including:
- Sony Bravia TVs and Sony Blu-ray Players
- LG Smart TVs and LG Blu-ray Players
- Samsung Smart TVs
- Vizio Smart TVs
- PlayStation 4, PlayStation 3
- Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, Xbox One, Xbox One X
- Google Chromecast
- Roku
- Yamaha receivers
- Marantz receivers
- Denon receivers
- Harman/Kardon receivers
- Naim Uniti/Atom/Mu-So series
- Focal
- Rotel RCX/RDG/RT series
- Linn DS/DSM series
- KEF LSX/LS50 series
- Cambridge Audio CXN/CXNv2
- Grundig DTR
- WiiM Mini/Pro
- Oppo Blu-ray players, Oppo Sonica
- Bang & Olufsen Beosound/Beoplay/Beovision/Beolab series
- Infuse, Kodi, MediaMonkey, VLC for iOS/tvOS
- All other UPnP/DLNA-compliant devices - look for the DLNA logo
Supported formats include:
- Audio: MP3, AAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, LPCM, DSF, FLAC, OGG, WMA, APE, and more
- Video: MOV, M4V, MKV, H263, H264, HEIC, WMV, ASF, AVI, MPEG2, VOB, FLV, and more
- Images: JPEG, JPEG2000, PNG, TIFF, PDF, BMP, GIF, SVG, AI, PSD, RAW, and more
Get FireStream and experience the best Mac media streaming today!
FireStream is optimized for Apple Silicon processors.
Note: Users with Music or Photos libraries stored on an external drive or network share may need to add that drive/share to Content > Folders in FireStream, stop, quit, and restart FireStream to ensure the content is accessible.
Note 2: To stream all Photos content, “Download Originals to this Mac” must be selected in Photos Preferences if using iCloud Photos. Otherwise, much of your content may not appear in FireStream because it’s not available locally on your machine.
Note 3: If you’re using more than one Photo Library, make sure your preferred Photo Library is set as the System Photo Library in Photos Preferences. Only the System Photo Library will be visible in FireStream.
* Please note that DRM-protected content is not streamable.

apple-macos:6502695495.name: Freak Finances: Budgeting
apple-macos:6502695495.description:
Focused, multi-currency budgeting app for people who want to understand their money without turning personal finance into a second job.
Log spending and income as it happens. See how every transaction changes your balance, use categories to recognize patterns, and review your finances without spreadsheets, bank dashboards, or unnecessary complexity.
INSTANT SPENDING AND INCOME LOGGING
We designed transaction logging to be fast enough to use the moment money moves:
– record spending or income in seconds 
– enter the amount, name, date, currency, and category 
– edit or remove entries whenever needed 
– maintain a clear chronological record of your finances 
MULTI-CURRENCY BY DESIGN
Your finances do not always exist in one currency. Freak Finances treats multi-currency tracking as a core feature:
– log every transaction in its original currency 
– view your complete financial picture in a chosen primary currency 
– keep frequently used currencies readily available 
– calculate converted values using current exchange rates 
– maintain separate balance values across multiple currencies 
UNDERSTAND YOUR BALANCE
Transactions only tell part of the story. Freak Finances helps you understand what you actually have:
– establish your current balance in each currency 
– see how spending and income affect that balance over time 
– review the distribution of money across currencies 
– switch the primary display currency whenever your perspective changes 
MONTHLY AND YEARLY ANALYSIS
The dashboard turns individual records into a clear financial overview:
– compare spending and income across different periods 
– review monthly and yearly totals 
– understand which categories shape your finances 
– recognize patterns and make adjustments when needed 
CATEGORIES THAT REMAIN USEFUL
Organize spending and income around the way you actually manage money:
– use thoughtfully prepared categories from the beginning 
– create custom categories for your specific needs 
– assign distinctive colors for faster recognition 
– analyze category totals without making logging more complicated 
PRIVATE AND FOCUSED
Freak Finances does not connect to your bank or request banking credentials. You remain in control of every record you add:
– sign in securely with Apple 
– sync your private records across supported devices 
– no third-party advertisements 
– no financial records used for advertising 
Privacy Policy:
https://www.thefreakcompany.com/apps/finances/privacy
Terms of Use:
https://www.thefreakcompany.com/apps/finances/terms
